14.39.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
yattvayā kīrtitaṃ brahmanpūrvaṃ devaiḥ prasāditaḥ ..
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa sthirarūpo maheśvaraḥ .. 1 ..
14.39.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
यत्त्वया कीर्तितं ब्रह्मन्पूर्वं देवैः प्रसादितः ..
लिंगं संस्थापयामास स्थिररूपो महेश्वरः .. 1 ..
14.39.m: Yayāti said: / What you have proclaimed, O holy one, that formerly, propitiated by the gods, / Maheśvara installed a liṅga, remaining in a fixed form— (1)

14.39.s:
kasmāttatpātitaṃ liṃgaṃ vālakhilyairmahātmabhiḥ ..
kasmāttatrācalo jāto devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 2 ..
14.39.d:
कस्मात्तत्पातितं लिंगं वालखिल्यैर्महात्मभिः ..
कस्मात्तत्राचलो जातो देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 2 ..
14.39.m: Why was that liṅga felled by the great-souled Vālakhilyas? / Why did Maheśvara, the god of gods, become immovable there?

14.39.s:
etanme kautukaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi ..
tasmindṛṣṭe ca kiṃ puṇyaṃ narāṇāṃ tatra jāyate .. 3 ..
14.39.d:
एतन्मे कौतुकं सर्वं यथावद्वक्तुमर्हसि ..
तस्मिन्दृष्टे च किं पुण्यं नराणां तत्र जायते .. 3 ..
14.39.m: You ought to tell me all of this wonderful tale properly. / And what merit accrues to men when it is beheld there?

14.39.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
maheśvarasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu pārthivasattama ..
atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrvavṛttaṃ kathāṃtaram .. 4 ..
14.39.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
महेश्वरस्य माहात्म्यं शृणु पार्थिवसत्तम ..
अत्र ते कीर्तयिष्यामि पूर्ववृत्तं कथांतरम् .. 4 ..
14.39.m: Pulastya said: / Listen to the māhātmya of Maheśvara, O best of kings. / In this regard, I shall relate to you an ancient event, another story.

14.39.s:
yadā pañcatvamāpannā satī satyaparākramā ..
apamānena dakṣasya yajñe na ca nimaṃtritā .. 5 ..
14.39.d:
यदा पञ्चत्वमापन्ना सती सत्यपराक्रमा ..
अपमानेन दक्षस्य यज्ञे न च निमंत्रिता .. 5 ..
14.39.m: When Satī, possessed of true prowess, met her demise, / [feeling] dishonoured by Dakṣa, and not having been invited to the sacrifice,

14.39.s:
tadā kāmo drutaṃ gṛhya puṣpacāpaṃ tamabhyagāt..
kandarppaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā sandhiteṣuṃ sudurjayam .. 6 ..
14.39.d:
तदा कामो द्रुतं गृह्य पुष्पचापं तमभ्यगात्..
कन्दर्प्पं सहसा दृष्ट्वा सन्धितेषुं सुदुर्जयम् .. 6 ..
14.39.m: then Kāma swiftly took up his flower-bow and approached him. / Seeing Kandarpa suddenly with his arrow fitted, exceedingly hard to conquer,

14.39.s:
āpatantaṃ bhayāttasya praṇaṣṭastripurāṃtakaḥ ..
sa tadā bhramamāṇaśca itaścetaśca pārthiva .. 7 ..
14.39.d:
आपतन्तं भयात्तस्य प्रणष्टस्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
स तदा भ्रममाणश्च इतश्चेतश्च पार्थिव .. 7 ..
14.39.m: the destroyer of Tripura fled in fear as he rushed forward. / Wandering here and there at that time, O king,

14.39.s:
vālakhilyāśramaṃ prāptaḥ puṇyaṃ sadvṛkṣaśobhitam ..
sa tatra bhagavāṃsteṣāṃ dārairdṛṣṭaḥ surūpavān.. 8 ..
14.39.d:
वालखिल्याश्रमं प्राप्तः पुण्यं सद्वृक्षशोभितम् ..
स तत्र भगवांस्तेषां दारैर्दृष्टः सुरूपवान्.. 8 ..
14.39.m: he reached the hermitage of the Vālakhilyas, holy and adorned with fine trees. / There the handsome Lord was seen by their wives.

14.39.s:
digvāsāḥ supriyālāpastatastāḥ kāmamohitāḥ ..
tyaktvā putragṛhādyaṃ ca sarvāstatpṛṣṭhasaṃsthitāḥ ..
babhūvuścāniśaṃ rājanmāṃ bhajasveti cābruvan .. 9 ..
14.39.d:
दिग्वासाः सुप्रियालापस्ततस्ताः काममोहिताः ..
त्यक्त्वा पुत्रगृहाद्यं च सर्वास्तत्पृष्ठसंस्थिताः ..
बभूवुश्चानिशं राजन्मां भजस्वेति चाब्रुवन् .. 9 ..
14.39.m: Naked [and] speaking charmingly, thereupon they were infatuated with desire. / Abandoning their sons, homes, and everything, all stood behind him, / and they continuously said, O king: "Accept me!"

14.39.s:
cakrurāliṃganaṃ kāściccumbanaṃ ca tathāparāḥ ..
anyāstasya hi liṃgaṃ tatspṛśaṃti ca muhurmuhuḥ .. 7.3.39.10 ..
14.39.d:
चक्रुरालिंगनं काश्चिच्चुम्बनं च तथापराः ..
अन्यास्तस्य हि लिंगं तत्स्पृशंति च मुहुर्मुहुः .. 7.3.39.10 ..
14.39.m: Some embraced him, while others kissed him; / yet others touched that liṅga of his again and again.

14.39.s:
sa cāpi bhagavāñchambhurniṣkāmaḥ parameśvaraḥ ..
jagadvyāptiṃ samāśritya sarvaprāṇiṣu vartate .. 11 ..
14.39.d:
स चापि भगवाञ्छम्भुर्निष्कामः परमेश्वरः ..
जगद्व्याप्तिं समाश्रित्य सर्वप्राणिषु वर्तते .. 11 ..
14.39.m: And yet the Lord Śambhu, the supreme ruler, was free from desire; / pervading the universe, he abides in all living beings.

14.39.s:
sa cāpi bhagavācchaṃbhustāsāṃ sarati prāṅmukhaḥ ..
bhrāṃtastatrāśrame teṣāṃ dārānkāmena pīḍayan .. 12 ..
14.39.d:
स चापि भगवाच्छंभुस्तासां सरति प्राङ्मुखः ..
भ्रांतस्तत्राश्रमे तेषां दारान्कामेन पीडयन् .. 12 ..
14.39.m: And that Lord Śambhu moved forward, facing east from them; / wandering there in their hermitage, tormenting their wives with desire.

14.39.s:
atha te munayo dṛṣṭvā vikṛtiṃ dārasaṃbhavām ..
ajānanto mahādevaṃ ruṣṭāstasya mahātmanaḥ .. .. 13 ..
14.39.d:
अथ ते मुनयो दृष्ट्वा विकृतिं दारसंभवाम् ..
अजानन्तो महादेवं रुष्टास्तस्य महात्मनः .. .. 13 ..
14.39.m: Then those sages, seeing the perturbation arising in their wives, / unaware of the great-souled Mahādeva, became enraged with him.

14.39.s:
daduḥ śāpaṃ susaṃtaptāḥ kalatrārthe paraṃtapa ..
patatāṃ patatāṃ liṅgametatte pāpakṛttama .. 14 ..
14.39.d:
ददुः शापं सुसंतप्ताः कलत्रार्थे परंतप ..
पततां पततां लिङ्गमेतत्ते पापकृत्तम .. 14 ..
14.39.m: Deeply distressed for the sake of their wives, O scorcher of foes, they uttered a curse: / "Let it fall, let this liṅga of yours fall, O worst of evildoers!

14.39.s:
viḍambayasi no dārānajasraṃ cāsya darśanāt ..
tataścaivāpatalliṃgaṃ tatkṣaṇāttatpuradviṣaḥ .. 15 ..
14.39.d:
विडम्बयसि नो दारानजस्रं चास्य दर्शनात् ..
ततश्चैवापतल्लिंगं तत्क्षणात्तत्पुरद्विषः .. 15 ..
14.39.m: You deceive our wives continually through the sight of it." / And then the liṅga of the foe of Tripura fell instantly

14.39.s:
brahmavākyena rājarṣe cakampe vasudhā tataḥ ..
śīrṇāni giriśṛṃgāṇi cukṣubhurmakarālayāḥ .. .. 16 ..
14.39.d:
ब्रह्मवाक्येन राजर्षे चकम्पे वसुधा ततः ..
शीर्णानि गिरिशृंगाणि चुक्षुभुर्मकरालयाः .. .. 16 ..
14.39.m: by the word of the brahmins, O royal sage. Thereupon the earth trembled, / the mountain peaks shattered, and the oceans churned.

14.39.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve bhayatrastā narādhipa ..
akāle pralayaṃ matvā trailokye paryavasthitam .. 17 ..
14.39.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे भयत्रस्ता नराधिप ..
अकाले प्रलयं मत्वा त्रैलोक्ये पर्यवस्थितम् .. 17 ..
14.39.m: Then all the hosts of gods, terrified with fear, O lord of men, / thinking that an untimely dissolution was imminent upon the three worlds,

14.39.s:
tata pitāmahaṃ jagmu stasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayan ..
pralayasyeva cihnāni dṛśyante parameśvara .. 18 ..
14.39.d:
तत पितामहं जग्मु स्तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन् ..
प्रलयस्येव चिह्नानि दृश्यन्ते परमेश्वर .. 18 ..
14.39.m: went then to the Grandfather and reported everything to him: / "Omens like those of a dissolution are seen, O supreme lord!

14.39.s:
kiṃ nimittaṃ suraśreṣṭha na jānīmo vayaṃ prabho ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā pitāmahaḥ .. 19 ..
14.39.d:
किं निमित्तं सुरश्रेष्ठ न जानीमो वयं प्रभो ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा चिरं ध्यात्वा पितामहः .. 19 ..
14.39.m: What is the cause of this, O best of the gods? We do not know, O Lord!" / Having heard those words of theirs, and meditating for a long time, the Grandfather

14.39.s:
abravītpātitaṃ liṃgaṃ vālakhilyaiḥ pinākinaḥ ..
tenaite dāruṇotpātāḥ saṃjātā bhayasūcakāḥ .. 7.3.39.20 ..
14.39.d:
अब्रवीत्पातितं लिंगं वालखिल्यैः पिनाकिनः ..
तेनैते दारुणोत्पाताः संजाता भयसूचकाः .. 7.3.39.20 ..
14.39.m: said: "The liṅga of Pinākin has been felled by the Vālakhilyas. / Because of that, these dreadful portents signifying danger have arisen.

14.39.s:
tasmānmayā samāyuktāḥ sarve tatra divaukasaḥ ..
vrajaṃtu yena talliṃgaṃ sthāne saṃsthāpayecchivaḥ ..21..
14.39.d:
तस्मान्मया समायुक्ताः सर्वे तत्र दिवौकसः ..
व्रजंतु येन तल्लिंगं स्थाने संस्थापयेच्छिवः ..21..
14.39.m: Therefore, let all the gods of heaven, accompanied by me, / go there, so that Śiva may install that liṅga in its place,

14.39.s:
yāvanno jāyate loke pralayo' kālasaṃbhavaḥ ..
evaṃ saṃmaṃtrya te sarve tato'rbudamupāyayuḥ .. 22 ..
14.39.d:
यावन्नो जायते लोके प्रलयो' कालसंभवः ..
एवं संमंत्र्य ते सर्वे ततोऽर्बुदमुपाययुः .. 22 ..
14.39.m: before an untimely dissolution takes place in the world." / Having thus deliberated, they all went to Arbuda,

14.39.s:
vālakhilyāśrame yatra talliṃgaṃ nipapāta ha ..
tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ sūktairvedoktairvinayānvitāḥ .. 23 ..
14.39.d:
वालखिल्याश्रमे यत्र तल्लिंगं निपपात ह ..
तुष्टुवुर्विविधैः सूक्तैर्वेदोक्तैर्विनयान्विताः .. 23 ..
14.39.m: to the hermitage of the Vālakhilyas where that liṅga had indeed fallen. / Filled with humility, they praised him with various hymns proclaimed in the Vedas.

14.39.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
namaste devadeveśa bhaktānāṃ cābhayaṃkara ..
namaste sarvavāsāya sarvayajñamayāya ca .. 24 ..
14.39.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
नमस्ते देवदेवेश भक्तानां चाभयंकर ..
नमस्ते सर्ववासाय सर्वयज्ञमयाय च .. 24 ..
14.39.m: The gods said: / Homage to you, O lord of the gods, who grant fearlessness to devotees! / Homage to you, who dwell in all and who consist of all sacrifices!

14.39.s:
sarveśvarāya devāya paramajyotiṣe namaḥ ..
namaḥ sphuṭatara jñānagamyāya vedhase .. 25 ..
14.39.d:
सर्वेश्वराय देवाय परमज्योतिषे नमः ..
नमः स्फुटतर ज्ञानगम्याय वेधसे .. 25 ..
14.39.m: Homage to the god who is the lord of all, the supreme light! / Homage to the creator, attainable through clearly defined knowledge!

14.39.s:
tryaṃbakāya ca bhīmāya pinākavarapāṇaye ..
tvayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva .. 26 ..
14.39.d:
त्र्यंबकाय च भीमाय पिनाकवरपाणये ..
त्वयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव .. 26 ..
14.39.m: To Tryambaka, the terrible, whose hand holds the excellent Pināka! / All this is strung upon you like clusters of gems upon a cord.

14.39.s:
saṃsāre vibudhaśreṣṭha jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam ..
na tadasti triloke'sminsusūkṣmamapi śaṃkara ..
yattvayā na prabho vyāptaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇāt .. 27 ..
14.39.d:
संसारे विबुधश्रेष्ठ जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् ..
न तदस्ति त्रिलोकेऽस्मिन्सुसूक्ष्ममपि शंकर ..
यत्त्वया न प्रभो व्याप्तं सृष्टिसंहारकारणात् .. 27 ..
14.39.m: In this cycle of existence, O best of the immortals, the animate and inanimate world— / there is nothing in this triple world, even the most minute, O Śaṃkara, / that is not pervaded by you, O Lord, as the cause of creation and destruction.

14.39.s:
pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tvayā sṛṣṭāni kāmataḥ ..
yāsyaṃti tāni bhūyo'pi tava kāye jagatpate .. 28 ..
14.39.d:
पृथिव्यादीनि भूतानि त्वया सृष्टानि कामतः ..
यास्यंति तानि भूयोऽपि तव काये जगत्पते .. 28 ..
14.39.m: The elements, beginning with earth, were created by you at your will; / they will enter your body once again, O lord of the universe.

14.39.s:
prasīda bhagavaṃstasmālliṃgametatsureśvara ..
sthāne sthāpaya bhadraṃ te yāvanna syātprajākṣayaḥ .. 29 ..
14.39.d:
प्रसीद भगवंस्तस्माल्लिंगमेतत्सुरेश्वर ..
स्थाने स्थापय भद्रं ते यावन्न स्यात्प्रजाक्षयः .. 29 ..
14.39.m: Be gracious, O Lord, O lord of the gods! Therefore, install this liṅga / in its place—may good betide you—before the destruction of creatures occurs.

14.39.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
nirvikārasya malliṃgaṃ vālakhilyaiḥ prapātitam..
kathaṃ bhūyaḥ pragṛhṇāmi yāvacchuddhirna jāyate .. 7.3.39.30 ..
14.39.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
निर्विकारस्य मल्लिंगं वालखिल्यैः प्रपातितम्..
कथं भूयः प्रगृह्णामि यावच्छुद्धिर्न जायते .. 7.3.39.30 ..
14.39.m: The Holy Lord said: / My liṅga, belonging to the changeless one, has been felled by the Vālakhilyas. / How can I take it back again until purification is effected?

14.39.s:
śakto'haṃ vālakhilyānāṃ nigrahaṃ karttumañjasā ..
kintu me brāhmaṇā mānyāḥ pūjyāśca surasattamāḥ .. 31 ..
14.39.d:
शक्तोऽहं वालखिल्यानां निग्रहं कर्त्तुमञ्जसा ..
किन्तु मे ब्राह्मणा मान्याः पूज्याश्च सुरसत्तमाः .. 31 ..
14.39.m: I am capable of subduing the Vālakhilyas instantly, / but brahmins are to be respected and worshipped by me, O best of gods.

14.39.s:
acalaṃ liṃgametaddhi noddharttuṃ śakyate vibho ..
eka evātra nirdiṣṭa upāyo nāparaḥ smṛtaḥ .. 32 ..
14.39.d:
अचलं लिंगमेतद्धि नोद्धर्त्तुं शक्यते विभो ..
एक एवात्र निर्दिष्ट उपायो नापरः स्मृतः .. 32 ..
14.39.m: Indeed, this liṅga is immovable; it cannot be lifted up, O all-pervading one. / One single remedy is indicated here; no other is taught:

14.39.s:
yadi me tvaṃ purā liṃgaṃ pūjayethāḥ pitāmaha ..
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve tato viprāstato'pare .. 33 ..
14.39.d:
यदि मे त्वं पुरा लिंगं पूजयेथाः पितामह ..
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे ततो विप्रास्ततोऽपरे .. 33 ..
14.39.m: If you, O Grandfather, worship my liṅga first, / then all the hosts of gods, then the brahmins, and then others,

14.39.s: tato nau śāṃtimāgacchejjagatsthāvarajaṃgamam .. 34 ..
14.39.d: ततो नौ शांतिमागच्छेज्जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् .. 34 ..
14.39.m: then peace may come to us and to the world, animate and inanimate.

14.39.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāñchaṃkareṇa nṛpottama ..
tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa brahmā pūrvaṃ subhaktitaḥ .. 35 ..
14.39.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः स भगवाञ्छंकरेण नृपोत्तम ..
ततस्तं पूजयामास ब्रह्मा पूर्वं सुभक्तितः .. 35 ..
14.39.m: Pulastya said: / Thus addressed by Śaṃkara, O best of kings, / Brahmā then worshipped it first with great devotion.

14.39.s:
brahmaṇo'nantaraṃ viṣṇustataḥ śakra stato'pare ..
vālakhilyādayo viprā mantraiśca śatarudriyaiḥ .. 36 ..
14.39.d:
ब्रह्मणोऽनन्तरं विष्णुस्ततः शक्र स्ततोऽपरे ..
वालखिल्यादयो विप्रा मन्त्रैश्च शतरुद्रियैः .. 36 ..
14.39.m: After Brahmā, Viṣṇu [worshipped it], then Śakra, then the others, / [and] the brahmins, the Vālakhilyas and the rest, with the Śatarudrīya mantras.

14.39.s:
tataste dāruṇotpātā upaśāṃtāśca tatkṣaṇāt ..
abhavatsumukho loko vṛtto gandhavaho mṛduḥ .. 37 ..
14.39.d:
ततस्ते दारुणोत्पाता उपशांताश्च तत्क्षणात् ..
अभवत्सुमुखो लोको वृत्तो गन्धवहो मृदुः .. 37 ..
14.39.m: Thereupon those dreadful portents subsided that very moment. / The world became joyful, and a gentle fragrant breeze blew.

14.39.s:
athovāca mahādevaḥ sarvāṃstāṃstridaśālayān..
vṛṇudhvaṃ suvaraṃ sarve matto yanmanasīpsitam .. 38 ..
14.39.d:
अथोवाच महादेवः सर्वांस्तांस्त्रिदशालयान्..
वृणुध्वं सुवरं सर्वे मत्तो यन्मनसीप्सितम् .. 38 ..
14.39.m: Then Mahādeva said to all those gods: / "Choose an excellent boon, all of you, from me, whatever is desired in your minds."

14.39.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
tava liṃgasya saṃsparśādapi pāpakṛto narāḥ ..
svargaṃ yāsyaṃti deveśa nāśaṃ yāsyati kilbiṣam ..
vratadānāni sarvāṇi tīrthayātrāyutāni ca .. 39 ..
14.39.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
तव लिंगस्य संस्पर्शादपि पापकृतो नराः ..
स्वर्गं यास्यंति देवेश नाशं यास्यति किल्बिषम् ..
व्रतदानानि सर्वाणि तीर्थयात्रायुतानि च .. 39 ..
14.39.m: The gods said: / Even by touching your liṅga, men who have committed sins / will go to heaven, O lord of the gods; their sin will be destroyed, / [as will the fruits of] all vows, gifts, and myriad pilgrimages to sacred fords.

14.39.s:
tasmādvajreṇa devendrastavaitalliṃgamuttamam..
chādayiṣyati sarvatra yadi tvaṃ manyase prabho .. 7.3.39.40 ..
14.39.d:
तस्माद्वज्रेण देवेन्द्रस्तवैतल्लिंगमुत्तमम्..
छादयिष्यति सर्वत्र यदि त्वं मन्यसे प्रभो .. 7.3.39.40 ..
14.39.m: Therefore, the lord of gods will cover this excellent liṅga of yours / on all sides with a diamond, if you deem it proper, O Lord.

14.39.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
abhiprāyo mamāpyeṣa vartate hṛdi padmaja ..
evaṃ karotu devendraḥ sarvadharmavivṛddhaye .. 41 ..
14.39.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
अभिप्रायो ममाप्येष वर्तते हृदि पद्मज ..
एवं करोतु देवेन्द्रः सर्वधर्मविवृद्धये .. 41 ..
14.39.m: The Holy Lord said: / This intention is in my heart too, O lotus-born one. / Let the lord of the gods do so for the increase of all righteousness.

14.39.s:
pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ saṃchādayāmāsa vajreṇa tridaśādhipaḥ ..
talliṃgaṃ sarvamartyānāṃ yathā'dṛśyaṃ vyajāyata .. 42 ..
14.39.d:
पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततः संछादयामास वज्रेण त्रिदशाधिपः ..
तल्लिंगं सर्वमर्त्यानां यथाऽदृश्यं व्यजायत .. 42 ..
14.39.m: Pulastya said: / Then the lord of the thirty [gods] covered that liṅga / with a diamond, so that it became invisible to all mortals.

14.39.s:
adyāpi vajrasaṃsparśāttatsānnidhyaṃ gato naraḥ ..
ājanmamaraṇātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. .. 43 ..
14.39.d:
अद्यापि वज्रसंस्पर्शात्तत्सान्निध्यं गतो नरः ..
आजन्ममरणात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. .. 43 ..
14.39.m: Even today, by touching the diamond, a person who has attained its presence / is freed from sin from birth to death; of this there is no doubt.

14.39.s:
māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ yasmāttalliṃge śaṃkareṇa tu ..
vastreṇācchāditaṃ caiva śakreṇaiva dharātale .. 44 ..
14.39.d:
माहात्म्यं कीर्तितं यस्मात्तल्लिंगे शंकरेण तु ..
वस्त्रेणाच्छादितं चैव शक्रेणैव धरातले .. 44 ..
14.39.m: Because the māhātmya of that liṅga was proclaimed by Śaṃkara, / and it was covered with a cloth by Indra on the earth,

14.39.s:
tataḥprabhṛti liṃgasya marttye pūjā vyajāyata ..
purāsīcchaṃkaraḥ pūjyo yathānye tridaśālayāḥ .. 45 ..
14.39.d:
ततःप्रभृति लिंगस्य मर्त्त्ये पूजा व्यजायत ..
पुरासीच्छंकरः पूज्यो यथान्ये त्रिदशालयाः .. 45 ..
14.39.m: from then on, the worship of the liṅga arose in the mortal world. / Formerly, Śaṃkara was worshipped just as other abodes of the gods [were].

14.39.s:
evametatpurāvṛttamarbude parvatottame ..
liṃgasya patanātpūjāṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ pari pṛcchasi .. 46 ..
14.39.d:
एवमेतत्पुरावृत्तमर्बुदे पर्वतोत्तमे ..
लिंगस्य पतनात्पूजां यन्मां त्वं परि पृच्छसि .. 46 ..
14.39.m: Such is this ancient account on the best of mountains, Arbuda, / concerning the worship arising from the falling of the liṅga, about which you ask me.

14.39.s:
phālgunāntacaturddaśyāṃ naivedyaṃ nūtanairyavaiḥ ..
yo dadātyacaleśāya sa bhūyo neha jāyate .. 47 ..
14.39.d:
फाल्गुनान्तचतुर्द्दश्यां नैवेद्यं नूतनैर्यवैः ..
यो ददात्यचलेशाय स भूयो नेह जायते .. 47 ..
14.39.m: He who offers a food-offering of fresh barley to the Lord of the Mountain on the fourteenth day at the end of Phālguna / is not born here again.

14.39.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayedyastu bhaktyā tasminnavairyavaiḥ ..
yavasaṃkhyāpramāṇāni yugāni divi modate .. 48 ..
14.39.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयेद्यस्तु भक्त्या तस्मिन्नवैर्यवैः ..
यवसंख्याप्रमाणानि युगानि दिवि मोदते .. 48 ..
14.39.m: And he who feeds brahmins with devotion with fresh barley on that day, / rejoices in heaven for as many yugas as the number of grains of barley.

14.39.s:
tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsanti saktūnāṃ munisattamāḥ ..
nūtanānāṃ mahārāja yataḥ proktaṃ purāriṇā .. 49 ..
14.39.d:
तत्र दानं प्रशंसन्ति सक्तूनां मुनिसत्तमाः ..
नूतनानां महाराज यतः प्रोक्तं पुरारिणा .. 49 ..
14.39.m: There, the best among sages praise the donation of barley-meal, / of fresh [barley-meal], O great king, because it was declared by the Enemy of Pura:

14.39.s:
kiṃ dānairvividhairdattaiḥ kiṃ yajñaiśca suvistaraiḥ ..
kiṃ tīrthairvividhaihomaistapobhiḥ kiṃ ca kaṣṭadaiḥ .. 7.3.39.50 ..
14.39.d:
किं दानैर्विविधैर्दत्तैः किं यज्ञैश्च सुविस्तरैः ..
किं तीर्थैर्विविधैहोमैस्तपोभिः किं च कष्टदैः .. 7.3.39.50 ..
14.39.m: "What [use are] various gifts given? What [use are] very extensive sacrifices? / What [use are] diverse sacred fords, oblations, and austerities that cause hardship?

14.39.s:
phālgunāntacaturddaśyāṃ sumaheśvarasannidhau ..
dharmāṇyetāni sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm.. 51 ..
14.39.d:
फाल्गुनान्तचतुर्द्दश्यां सुमहेश्वरसन्निधौ ..
धर्माण्येतानि सर्वाणि कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम्.. 51 ..
14.39.m: On the fourteenth day at the end of Phālguna, in the presence of the great Maheśvara, / all these religious merits are not worth a sixteenth part [of it]."

14.39.s:
śṛṇu rājanpurā vṛttaṃ tatrāścaryaṃ yaduttamam ..
kaścitpāpasamācāraḥ kuṣṭhī kṣāmatanurnaraḥ .. 52 ..
14.39.d:
शृणु राजन्पुरा वृत्तं तत्राश्चर्यं यदुत्तमम् ..
कश्चित्पापसमाचारः कुष्ठी क्षामतनुर्नरः .. 52 ..
14.39.m: Hear, O king, an ancient event, an excellent wonder that took place there: / A certain man of sinful conduct, a leper, his body emaciated,

14.39.s:
bhikṣārthamāgatastatra lokairanyaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
tena bhikṣārjitaṃ tatra saktūnāṃ kuḍavaṃ nṛpa .. 53 ..
14.39.d:
भिक्षार्थमागतस्तत्र लोकैरन्यैः समन्वितः ..
तेन भिक्षार्जितं तत्र सक्तूनां कुडवं नृप .. 53 ..
14.39.m: came there for the sake of alms together with other people. / By begging, he earned a kuḍava measure of barley-meal there, O king.

14.39.s:
tato roga parikleśādbhojanaṃ na cakāra saḥ ..
dāghārdito jale tasminsnāto bhaktivivarjitaḥ ..
saktūnkṛtvopadhāne tānsa ca supto niśāgame .. 54 ..
14.39.d:
ततो रोग परिक्लेशाद्भोजनं न चकार सः ..
दाघार्दितो जले तस्मिन्स्नातो भक्तिविवर्जितः ..
सक्तून्कृत्वोपधाने तान्स च सुप्तो निशागमे .. 54 ..
14.39.m: Then, owing to the affliction of his disease, he did not take food. / Tormented by heat, he bathed in that water devoid of devotion; / making a pillow of that barley-meal, he fell asleep when night arrived.

14.39.s:
tato nidrābhibhūtasya sārameyo jahāra ca ..
bhakṣayāmāsa yukto'nyaiḥ sārameyairbubhukṣitaḥ .. 55 ..
14.39.d:
ततो निद्राभिभूतस्य सारमेयो जहार च ..
भक्षयामास युक्तोऽन्यैः सारमेयैर्बुभुक्षितः .. 55 ..
14.39.m: Then, as he was overcome by sleep, a dog carried it off; / joined by other dogs, hungry, he devoured it.

14.39.s:
athāsau vismayādrājanpaṃcatvaṃ samupasthitaḥ ..
tato jātismaro jāto vidarbhādhipatergṛhe .. 56 ..
14.39.d:
अथासौ विस्मयाद्राजन्पंचत्वं समुपस्थितः ..
ततो जातिस्मरो जातो विदर्भाधिपतेर्गृहे .. 56 ..
14.39.m: Then he, out of astonishment, O king, met his death. / Thereupon, remembering his past birth, he was born in the house of the king of Vidarbha

14.39.s:
bhīmonāma nṛpaśreṣṭha damayantīpitā hi yaḥ ..
taṃ prabhāvaṃ hi vijñāya saktūnāṃ tatra parvate .. 57 ..
14.39.d:
भीमोनाम नृपश्रेष्ठ दमयन्तीपिता हि यः ..
तं प्रभावं हि विज्ञाय सक्तूनां तत्र पर्वते .. 57 ..
14.39.m: named Bhīma, the best of kings, who was indeed the father of Damayantī. / For having realized that power of barley-meal on that mountain,

14.39.s:
phālgunāṃtacaturdaśyāṃ varṣe varṣe jagāma saḥ ..
kṛtvā caivopavāsaṃ tu rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā .. 58 ..
14.39.d:
फाल्गुनांतचतुर्दश्यां वर्षे वर्षे जगाम सः ..
कृत्वा चैवोपवासं तु रात्रौ जागरणं तथा .. 58 ..
14.39.m: he went year after year on the fourteenth day at the end of Phālguna, / and having fasted, and likewise kept vigil through the night,

14.39.s:
acaleśvarasānnidhye dadau saktūṃstato bahūn ..
sahiraṇyāndvijendrāṇāṃ paśupakṣimṛgeṣu ca .. 59 ..
14.39.d:
अचलेश्वरसान्निध्ये ददौ सक्तूंस्ततो बहून् ..
सहिरण्यान्द्विजेन्द्राणां पशुपक्षिमृगेषु च .. 59 ..
14.39.m: he gave there abundant barley-meal in the presence of Acaleśvara / accompanied with gold to the best of brahmins, and also to beasts, birds, and deer.

14.39.s:
atha te munayaḥ sarve gālavapramukhā nṛpa ..
papracchuḥ kautukāviṣṭāḥ saktudānakṛte nṛpam .. 7.3.39.60 ..
14.39.d:
अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे गालवप्रमुखा नृप ..
पप्रच्छुः कौतुकाविष्टाः सक्तुदानकृते नृपम् .. 7.3.39.60 ..
14.39.m: Then all those sages, headed by Gālava, O king, / seized by curiosity, questioned the king on account of the gift of barley-meal.

14.39.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
hastvaśvarathadānānāṃ śaktirasti tavādbhutā ..
kasmātsaktūnpramuktvā tvaṃ nānyaddātumihecchasi .. 61 ..
14.39.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
हस्त्वश्वरथदानानां शक्तिरस्ति तवाद्भुता ..
कस्मात्सक्तून्प्रमुक्त्वा त्वं नान्यद्दातुमिहेच्छसि .. 61 ..
14.39.m: The ṛṣis said: / "You have the marvelous ability to make gifts of elephants, horses, and chariots. / Leaving aside barley-meal, why do you not wish to give anything else here?"

14.39.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
athā'sau kathayāmāsa pūrvametatsamudbhavam ..
saktudānasya māhātmyaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām .. 62 ..
14.39.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
अथाऽसौ कथयामास पूर्वमेतत्समुद्भवम् ..
सक्तुदानस्य माहात्म्यं मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् .. 62 ..
14.39.m: Pulastya said: / Then he related this previous event, / the māhātmya of the gift of barley-meal, to the sages of cultivated minds:

14.39.s:
pūrvaṃ bhaktyā vihīnasya śunā vai saktavo hṛtāḥ ..
tatprabhāvādiyaṃ prāptirmama jātā dvijottamāḥ .. 63 ..
14.39.d:
पूर्वं भक्त्या विहीनस्य शुना वै सक्तवो हृताः ..
तत्प्रभावादियं प्राप्तिर्मम जाता द्विजोत्तमाः .. 63 ..
14.39.m: "Formerly, when I was devoid of devotion, the barley-meal was indeed taken by a dog; / through the power of that, this attainment has occurred to me, O best of brahmins.

14.39.s:
sāṃprataṃ bhaktida ttānāṃ kiṃ syājjānāmi no phalam..
etasmātkāraṇāddānaṃ saktūnāṃ prakaromyaham ..
tīrthe'sminbhaktisaṃyuktaḥ satyenātmānamālabhe .. 64 .. ..
14.39.d:
सांप्रतं भक्तिद त्तानां किं स्याज्जानामि नो फलम्..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्दानं सक्तूनां प्रकरोम्यहम् ..
तीर्थेऽस्मिन्भक्तिसंयुक्तः सत्येनात्मानमालभे .. 64 .. ..
14.39.m: What might be the fruit now of [meals] given with devotion? I do not know. / For this reason, I perform the donation of barley-meal / endowed with devotion in this sacred ford; I touch my self with truth."

14.39.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataste munayo hṛṣṭāḥ sādhusādhviti cābruvan..
cakruścaivātmaśaktyā te saktūnāṃ dānamuttamam .. 65..
14.39.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततस्ते मुनयो हृष्टाः साधुसाध्विति चाब्रुवन्..
चक्रुश्चैवात्मशक्त्या ते सक्तूनां दानमुत्तमम् .. 65..
14.39.m: Pulastya said: / Then those sages were delighted, and said, "Well done! Well done!" / And according to their own capacity, they performed the excellent donation of barley-meal.

14.39.s:
eṣa prabhāvo rājarṣe saktudānasya kīrttitaḥ ..
maheśvarasya māhātmyaṃ satyaṃ cāpi prakīrttitam .. 66 ..
14.39.d:
एष प्रभावो राजर्षे सक्तुदानस्य कीर्त्तितः ..
महेश्वरस्य माहात्म्यं सत्यं चापि प्रकीर्त्तितम् .. 66 ..
14.39.m: This power of the gift of barley-meal has been proclaimed, O royal seer, / and the true māhātmya of Maheśvara has also been proclaimed.

14.39.s:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā kathyamānaṃ dvijānanāt ..
ahorātra kṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 67 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śivaliṃga maheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃpuraḥsara saktudānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 39 ..
14.39.d:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयाद्भक्त्या कथ्यमानं द्विजाननात् ..
अहोरात्र कृतात्पापान्मुच्यते नात्र संशयः .. 67 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे शिवलिंग महेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंपुरःसर सक्तुदानमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 39 ..
14.39.m:
And he who listens to this with devotion as it is spoken from the mouth of a brahmin, / is freed from sin committed during a day and night; there is no doubt about this.
Thus ends the thirty-ninth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the māhātmya of the Gift of Barley-meal Preceded by the Description of the māhātmya of the Śivaliṅga and Maheśvara', in the Arbudakhaṇḍa, the third [section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the Śrī Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.40.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ kāmeśvaraṃ gacchettatra kāmapratiṣṭhitam ..
yasmindṛṣṭe sadā martyaḥ surūpaḥ suprabho bhavet .. 1 ..
14.40.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततः कामेश्वरं गच्छेत्तत्र कामप्रतिष्ठितम् ..
यस्मिन्दृष्टे सदा मर्त्यः सुरूपः सुप्रभो भवेत् .. 1 ..
14.40.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Kāmeśvara, installed there by Kāma, / upon seeing which a mortal becomes handsome and of brilliant radiance forever.

14.40.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
tvayā proktaṃ purā śaṃbhuḥ kāmabāṇa bhayātkila ..
vālakhilyāśramaṃ prāpto yatra liṃgaṃ papāta ha .. 2 ..
14.40.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
त्वया प्रोक्तं पुरा शंभुः कामबाण भयात्किल ..
वालखिल्याश्रमं प्राप्तो यत्र लिंगं पपात ह .. 2 ..
14.40.m: Yayāti said: / You said that formerly Śambhu, out of fear of Kāma's arrow, / reached the hermitage of the Vālakhilyas where the liṅga fell.

14.40.s:
sa kathaṃ pūjitastena śaṃbhurme kautukaṃ mahat ..
vada sarvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kāmeśvaraniveśanam .. 3 ..
14.40.d:
स कथं पूजितस्तेन शंभुर्मे कौतुकं महत् ..
वद सर्वं द्विजश्रेष्ठ कामेश्वरनिवेशनम् .. 3 ..
14.40.m: How was that Śambhu worshipped by him? It is a great wonder to me. / Speak all, O best of brahmins, concerning the dwelling of Kāmeśvara.

14.40.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
muktaliṃge'pi deveśe na smarastaṃ mumoca ha ..
darśayannātmano bāṇaṃ tasyāsau pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitaḥ .. 4 ..
14.40.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
मुक्तलिंगेऽपि देवेशे न स्मरस्तं मुमोच ह ..
दर्शयन्नात्मनो बाणं तस्यासौ पृष्ठतः स्थितः .. 4 ..
14.40.m: Pulastya said: / Even when the Lord of the gods released the liṅga, Smara did not let him go; / showing his own arrow, he stood behind him.

14.40.s:
tato vārāṇasīṃ prāptastadbhayāttripurāṃtakaḥ ..
tatrā'pi ca tathā dṛṣṭvā dhṛtacāpaṃ manobhavam..5..
14.40.d:
ततो वाराणसीं प्राप्तस्तद्भयात्त्रिपुरांतकः ..
तत्राऽपि च तथा दृष्ट्वा धृतचापं मनोभवम्..5..
14.40.m: Then, out of fear of him, the Destroyer of Tripura reached Vārāṇasī. / Even there, he saw the mind-born [Kāma] holding his bow.

14.40.s:
tataḥ prayāgamāpannaḥ kedāraṃ ca tataḥ param..
naimiṣaṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca jaṃbūmārge tripuṣkaram ..6..
14.40.d:
ततः प्रयागमापन्नः केदारं च ततः परम्..
नैमिषं भद्रकर्णं च जंबूमार्गे त्रिपुष्करम् ..6..
14.40.m: Then he arrived at Prayāga, and further on to Kedāra, / Naimiṣa, and Bhadrakarṇa, and to Tripuṣkara on the path to Jambū;

14.40.s:
gokarṇaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca puṇyaṃ ca kṛmijāṃgalam..
gagādvāraṃ gayāśīrṣaṃ kālābhīṣṭaṃ vaṭeśvaram ..7..
14.40.d:
गोकर्णं च प्रभासं च पुण्यं च कृमिजांगलम्..
गगाद्वारं गयाशीर्षं कालाभीष्टं वटेश्वरम् ..7..
14.40.m: and to Gokarṇa, Prabhāsa, holy Kṛmijāṅgala, / Gaṅgādvāra, Gayāśīrṣa, Kālābhīṣṭa, and Vaṭeśvara.

14.40.s:
kiṃ vā tena bahūktena tīrthānyāyatanāni ca ..
asaṃkhyāni gato devaḥ kāmaṃ ca dadṛśe tathā .. 8 ..
14.40.d:
किं वा तेन बहूक्तेन तीर्थान्यायतनानि च ..
असंख्यानि गतो देवः कामं च ददृशे तथा .. 8 ..
14.40.m: Or what is the use of speaking much about that? To innumerable sacred fords / and sanctuaries the god went, and saw Kāma likewise.

14.40.s:
yatrayatra mahādevastadbhayānnṛpa gacchati ..
tatratatra punaḥ kāmaṃ prapaśyati dhṛtāyudham.. 9 ..
14.40.d:
यत्रयत्र महादेवस्तद्भयान्नृप गच्छति ..
तत्रतत्र पुनः कामं प्रपश्यति धृतायुधम्.. 9 ..
14.40.m: Wherever the Great God went out of fear of him, O king, / there and there again he saw Kāma holding his weapon.

14.40.s:
kasyacittvathakālasya punaḥ prāpto'rbudaṃ prati ..
tatrāpaśyattathā kāmamākarṇākarṣitāyudham..
ākuṃcitaikapādaṃ ca sthiradṛṣṭiṃ nṛpo ttama .. 7.3.40.10 ..
14.40.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथकालस्य पुनः प्राप्तोऽर्बुदं प्रति ..
तत्रापश्यत्तथा काममाकर्णाकर्षितायुधम्..
आकुंचितैकपादं च स्थिरदृष्टिं नृपो त्तम .. 7.3.40.10 ..
14.40.m: Then after some time, he arrived at Arbuda again. / There he saw Kāma with his weapon drawn to his ear, / with one foot bent, and with a steady gaze, O best of kings.

14.40.s:
athā'sau bhagavāñchāṃtaḥ priyāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ ..
krodhaṃ cakre viśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭvā taṃ purataḥ sthitam.. 11 ..
14.40.d:
अथाऽसौ भगवाञ्छांतः प्रियादुःखसमन्वितः ..
क्रोधं चक्रे विशेषेण दृष्ट्वा तं पुरतः स्थितम्.. 11 ..
14.40.m: Then the Lord, who had been calm, possessed by grief for his beloved, / became especially angry upon seeing him standing before him.

14.40.s:
tasya kopābhibhūtasya tṛtīyānnayanānnṛpa ..
niścakrāma mahājvālā yayā'sau bhasmasātkṛtaḥ .. 12 ..
14.40.d:
तस्य कोपाभिभूतस्य तृतीयान्नयनान्नृप ..
निश्चक्राम महाज्वाला ययाऽसौ भस्मसात्कृतः .. 12 ..
14.40.m: From the third eye of him who was overcome with anger, O king, / a great flame burst forth, by which he was reduced to ashes,

14.40.s:
sacāpaḥ saśaro rājaṃstasminparvatarodhasi ..
śaṃkaro roṣaparyaṃtaṃ gatvā saukhyamavāptavān.. 13 ..
14.40.d:
सचापः सशरो राजंस्तस्मिन्पर्वतरोधसि ..
शंकरो रोषपर्यंतं गत्वा सौख्यमवाप्तवान्.. 13 ..
14.40.m: along with his bow and along with his arrows, O king, on that mountain slope. / Śaṃkara, having reached the limit of his fury, attained happiness.

14.40.s:
kailāsaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ jagāma surapūjitaḥ ..
dagdhe manobhave bhāryā ratirasya pativratā ..
vyalapatkaruṇaṃ dīnā patiśokapari plutā .. 14 ..
14.40.d:
कैलासं पर्वतश्रेष्ठं जगाम सुरपूजितः ..
दग्धे मनोभवे भार्या रतिरस्य पतिव्रता ..
व्यलपत्करुणं दीना पतिशोकपरि प्लुता .. 14 ..
14.40.m: He, worshipped by the gods, went to Kailāsa, the best of mountains. / When the Mind-born was burned, his faithful wife Rati, / overwhelmed with grief for her husband, lamented piteously and miserably.

14.40.s:
tato dārūṇi cāhṛtya citiṃ kṛtvā narādhipa ..
ārurohāgnisaṃdīptāṃ citiṃ sā patiduḥkhitā..
tāvadākāśagāṃ vāṇīṃ śuśrāva ca yaśasvinī.. 15..
14.40.d:
ततो दारूणि चाहृत्य चितिं कृत्वा नराधिप ..
आरुरोहाग्निसंदीप्तां चितिं सा पतिदुःखिता..
तावदाकाशगां वाणीं शुश्राव च यशस्विनी.. 15..
14.40.m: Then, having gathered wood and made a funeral pyre, O king, / she, grieving for her husband, mounted the funeral pyre blazing with fire. / Just then the renowned woman heard a voice coming from the sky: 15

14.40.s:
vāguvāca..
mā putri sāhasaṃ kārṣīstapasā tiṣṭha sundari..
bhūyaḥ prāpsyasi bharttāraṃ kāmeṃ tuṣṭena śaṃbhunā..16..
14.40.d:
वागुवाच..
मा पुत्रि साहसं कार्षीस्तपसा तिष्ठ सुन्दरि..
भूयः प्राप्स्यसि भर्त्तारं कामें तुष्टेन शंभुना..16..
14.40.m: The voice said: / 'Do not act rashly, my daughter; remain engaged in austerity, O beautiful one. / You will obtain your husband Kāma again when Śambhu is pleased.' 16

14.40.s:
sā śrutvā tāṃ tadā vāṇīṃ samuttasthau samumadhyamā..
devamārādhayāmāsa divānaktamataṃdritā..
vratairdānairjapairhomairupavāsaistathā paraiḥ..17..
14.40.d:
सा श्रुत्वा तां तदा वाणीं समुत्तस्थौ समुमध्यमा..
देवमाराधयामास दिवानक्तमतंद्रिता..
व्रतैर्दानैर्जपैर्होमैरुपवासैस्तथा परैः..17..
14.40.m: Having heard that voice then, she of slender waist arose. / She worshipped the god day and night without wearying, / through vows, gifts, recitations, fire-offerings, and other fasts. 17

14.40.s:
tato varṣa sahasrāṃte tuṣṭastasyā maheśvaraḥ ..
abravīdvada kalyāṇi varaṃ yanmanasi sthitam .. 18 ..
14.40.d:
ततो वर्ष सहस्रांते तुष्टस्तस्या महेश्वरः ..
अब्रवीद्वद कल्याणि वरं यन्मनसि स्थितम् .. 18 ..
14.40.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, Maheśvara was pleased with her / and said, 'State, O blessed woman, the boon that is in your mind.' 18

14.40.s:
.. ratiruvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva bhagavam̐lloka bhāvanaḥ ..
akṣatāṃgaḥ punaḥ kāmaḥ kāṃto me jāyatāṃ patiḥ .. 19 ..
14.40.d:
.. रतिरुवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि मे देव भगवम्̐ल्लोक भावनः ..
अक्षतांगः पुनः कामः कांतो मे जायतां पतिः .. 19 ..
14.40.m: Rati said: / 'If you are pleased with me, O God, O Lord who creates the worlds, / let Kāma, my beloved husband, be born again with his limbs unhurt.' 19

14.40.s:
evamukte tayā vākye tatkṣaṇātsamupasthitaḥ ..
yathā supto mahārāja tadvadrūpaḥ sa harṣita .. 7.3.40.20 ..
14.40.d:
एवमुक्ते तया वाक्ये तत्क्षणात्समुपस्थितः ..
यथा सुप्तो महाराज तद्वद्रूपः स हर्षित .. 7.3.40.20 ..
14.40.m: When this speech had been uttered by her, at that moment he appeared, / as if [merely] asleep, O great king, in that same form, delighted. 20

14.40.s:
ikṣuyaṣṭimayaṃ cāpaṃ puṣpabāṇasamanvitam ..
bhṛṃgaśreṇimayyā maurvyā śobhitaṃ sumanoharam .. 21 ..
14.40.d:
इक्षुयष्टिमयं चापं पुष्पबाणसमन्वितम् ..
भृंगश्रेणिमय्या मौर्व्या शोभितं सुमनोहरम् .. 21 ..
14.40.m: He held a bow of sugarcane accompanied by flower-arrows, / adorned with a bowstring made of a swarm of bees, exceedingly enchanting. 21

14.40.s:
tato ratisamāyuktaḥ praṇipatya maheśvaram..
anujñātastu tenaiva svavyāpāre'bhyavarttata .. 22 ..
14.40.d:
ततो रतिसमायुक्तः प्रणिपत्य महेश्वरम्..
अनुज्ञातस्तु तेनैव स्वव्यापारेऽभ्यवर्त्तत .. 22 ..
14.40.m: Then, joined with Rati, having bowed to Maheśvara / and being permitted by him, he returned to his own duty. 22

14.40.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā śivamāhātmyaṃ śraddhāṃ kṛtvā nṛpottama ..
śivaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa parvate'rbudasaṃjñite .. 23 ..
14.40.d:
स दृष्ट्वा शिवमाहात्म्यं श्रद्धां कृत्वा नृपोत्तम ..
शिवं संस्थापयामास पर्वतेऽर्बुदसंज्ञिते .. 23 ..
14.40.m: Having seen the greatness of Śiva, and having developed faith, O best of kings, / he established Śiva on the mountain named Arbuda. 23

14.40.s:
yasmindṛṣṭe mahārāja nārī vā yadi vā naraḥ ..
saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva na daurbhāgyamavāpnuyāt .. 24 ..
14.40.d:
यस्मिन्दृष्टे महाराज नारी वा यदि वा नरः ..
सप्तजन्मांतराण्येव न दौर्भाग्यमवाप्नुयात् .. 24 ..
14.40.m: When that [liṅga] is seen, O great king, whether by a woman or a man, / for seven future lives they will never meet with misfortune. 24

14.40.s:
evametanmayā khyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
kāmeśvarasya māhātmyaṃ kāmadāha savistaram .. 25 ..
14.40.d:
एवमेतन्मया ख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
कामेश्वरस्य माहात्म्यं कामदाह सविस्तरम् .. 25 ..
14.40.m: Thus has been proclaimed by me what you asked of me, / the māhātmya of Kāmeśvara and the burning of Kāma in full detail. 25

14.40.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 40 ..
14.40.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे कामेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 40 ..
14.40.m: Thus ends the fortieth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Kāmeśvara,' in the Arbuda section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsa section, in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. 40

14.41.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha mārkaṃḍeyasya cāśramam..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ mārkaṃḍena mahātmanā .. 1 ..
14.41.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ मार्कंडेयस्य चाश्रमम्..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं मार्कंडेन महात्मना .. 1 ..
14.41.m: Pulastya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the hermitage of Mārkaṇḍeya, / where formerly austerity was performed by the great-souled Mārkaṇḍa. 1

14.41.s:
mṛkaṇḍo brāhmaṇonāma purā''sīcchaṃsitavrataḥ ..
ante vayasi saṃjātastasya putro'tisundaraḥ .. 2 ..
14.41.d:
मृकण्डो ब्राह्मणोनाम पुरा'ऽसीच्छंसितव्रतः ..
अन्ते वयसि संजातस्तस्य पुत्रोऽतिसुन्दरः .. 2 ..
14.41.m: Anciently there was a brahmin named Mṛkaṇḍu who strictly observed his vows. / At an advanced age, a very handsome son was born to him, 2

14.41.s:
sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ śāṃtaḥ sūryasamaprabhaḥ ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya tasyāśramapade nṛpa .. 3 ..
14.41.d:
सर्वलक्षणसंपूर्णः शांतः सूर्यसमप्रभः ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तस्याश्रमपदे नृप .. 3 ..
14.41.m: endowed with all auspicious marks, tranquil, possessing the radiance of the sun. / Then, after some time, O king, at the precinct of his hermitage 3

14.41.s:
āgato brāhmaṇo jñānī kaścitsāmudravicchubhaḥ ..
tato'sau krīḍamānastu bālakaḥ paṃcavārṣikaḥ .. 4 ..
14.41.d:
आगतो ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानी कश्चित्सामुद्रविच्छुभः ..
ततोऽसौ क्रीडमानस्तु बालकः पंचवार्षिकः .. 4 ..
14.41.m: came a wise, auspicious brahmin who knew the signs of the body. / Then, as that five-year-old boy was playing, 4

14.41.s:
ānāsāgraśikhāgrābhyāṃ ciraṃ caivāvalokitaḥ ..
tato'hasatsa sahasā taṃ mṛkaṇḍo hyalakṣayat.. 5 ..
14.41.d:
आनासाग्रशिखाग्राभ्यां चिरं चैवावलोकितः ..
ततोऽहसत्स सहसा तं मृकण्डो ह्यलक्षयत्.. 5 ..
14.41.m: he gazed at him for a long time from the tip of his nose to the crest of his hair. / Then suddenly he laughed; and Mṛkaṇḍu noticed him. 5

14.41.s:
athā'bravīcciraṃ dṛṣṭastvayā putro mama dvija..
tato hasitavānbhūyaḥ kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ vada.. 6..
14.41.d:
अथाऽब्रवीच्चिरं दृष्टस्त्वया पुत्रो मम द्विज..
ततो हसितवान्भूयः किमिदं कारणं वद.. 6..
14.41.m: Then [Mṛkaṇḍu] said: 'You looked at my son for a long time, O twice-born, / and then you laughed. Tell [me], what is the reason for this?' 6

14.41.s:
asakṛtsa mṛkaṇḍena yāvatpṛṣṭo dvijottamaḥ ..
uparodhavaśāttasmai yathārthaṃ saṃnyavedayat .. 7 ..
14.41.d:
असकृत्स मृकण्डेन यावत्पृष्टो द्विजोत्तमः ..
उपरोधवशात्तस्मै यथार्थं संन्यवेदयत् .. 7 ..
14.41.m: When questioned repeatedly by Mṛkaṇḍu, that best of the twice-born, / yielding to importunity, disclosed the truth to him: 7

14.41.s:
asya bālasya cihnāni yāni kāye dvijottama ..
ajaraścāmaraścaiva tairbhavetpuruṣaḥ kila .. 8 ..
14.41.d:
अस्य बालस्य चिह्नानि यानि काये द्विजोत्तम ..
अजरश्चामरश्चैव तैर्भवेत्पुरुषः किल .. 8 ..
14.41.m: 'The marks that exist on the body of this boy, O best of the twice-born— / by those a person would indeed become ageless and immortal. 8

14.41.s:
ṣaṇmāsenāsya bālasya nūnaṃ mṛtyurbhaviṣyati ..
etasmātkāraṇāddhāsyaṃ mayā'kāri dvijottama ..
anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me vairiṣvapi kadācana .. 9 ..
14.41.d:
षण्मासेनास्य बालस्य नूनं मृत्युर्भविष्यति ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्धास्यं मयाऽकारि द्विजोत्तम ..
अनृतं नोक्तपूर्वं मे वैरिष्वपि कदाचन .. 9 ..
14.41.m: [Yet] within six months, death will certainly come to this boy. / For this reason laughter was made by me, O best of the twice-born. / An untruth has never been spoken by me before, even to enemies.' 9

14.41.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā tu sa jñānī uṣitvā tatra śarvarīm ..
mṛkaṃḍenābhyanujñāta iṣṭaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha .. 7.3.41.10 ..
14.41.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा तु स ज्ञानी उषित्वा तत्र शर्वरीम् ..
मृकंडेनाभ्यनुज्ञात इष्टं देशं जगाम ह .. 7.3.41.10 ..
14.41.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, that wise man, after dwelling there for the night / and being given leave by Mṛkaṇḍu, departed to his desired region. 10

14.41.s:
mṛkaṃḍopi sutaṃ jñātvā tataḥ kṣīṇāyuṣaṃ nṛpa ..
paṃcavārṣikamapyārttaścakāropanayānvitam .. 11 ..
14.41.d:
मृकंडोपि सुतं ज्ञात्वा ततः क्षीणायुषं नृप ..
पंचवार्षिकमप्यार्त्तश्चकारोपनयान्वितम् .. 11 ..
14.41.m: Mṛkaṇḍu, too, having learned that his son had a short lifespan, O king, / though he was only five years old, afflicted with grief, invested him with the sacred thread. 11

14.41.s:
śrutādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ yaṃyaṃ paśyasi cāgrataḥ ..
tasyābhivādanaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā putraka nityaśaḥ .. 12 ..
14.41.d:
श्रुताध्ययनसंपन्नं यंयं पश्यसि चाग्रतः ..
तस्याभिवादनं कार्यं त्वया पुत्रक नित्यशः .. 12 ..
14.41.m: [He said:] 'Endowed with the study of the scriptures, whomever you see before you, / to him an obeisance must be made constantly by you, my son.' 12

14.41.s: tataścakre brahmacārī piturvākyaṃ viśeṣataḥ .. 13 ..
14.41.d: ततश्चक्रे ब्रह्मचारी पितुर्वाक्यं विशेषतः .. 13 ..
14.41.m: Then the student of the Veda carried out the command of his father with special care. 13

14.41.s:
bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ yuvānaṃ ca yaṃyaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā ..
namaskaroti taṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vinayānvitaḥ .. 14 ..
14.41.d:
बालं वृद्धं युवानं च यंयं पश्यति चक्षुषा ..
नमस्करोति तं सर्वं ब्राह्मणं विनयान्वितः .. 14 ..
14.41.m: Whomever he sees with his eyes—a child, an old man, or a youth— / to every such brahmin he bows down, endowed with modesty. 14

14.41.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tasyāśramasamīpataḥ ..
saptarṣayaḥ samāyātāstīrthayātrāparāyaṇāḥ .. 15 ..
14.41.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तस्याश्रमसमीपतः ..
सप्तर्षयः समायातास्तीर्थयात्रापरायणाः .. 15 ..
14.41.m: Then, after some time, in the vicinity of his hermitage / arrived the seven seers, intent on a pilgrimage to sacred fords. 15

14.41.s:
atha tānsatvaraṃ gatvā vaṃdayāmāsa pārthiva ..
bālaḥ savinayopetaḥ sarvāṃścaiva yathākramam .. 16 ..
14.41.d:
अथ तान्सत्वरं गत्वा वंदयामास पार्थिव ..
बालः सविनयोपेतः सर्वांश्चैव यथाक्रमम् .. 16 ..
14.41.m: Then, having approached quickly, O ruler of the earth, the boy, endowed with humility, / bowed to all of them in due order. 16

14.41.s:
dīrghāyurbhava tairuktaḥ sa bālastuṣṭitatparaiḥ ..
āsthitāśca yathābhīṣṭaṃ deśaṃ bālaṃ visarjya tam .. 17 ..
14.41.d:
दीर्घायुर्भव तैरुक्तः स बालस्तुष्टितत्परैः ..
आस्थिताश्च यथाभीष्टं देशं बालं विसर्ज्य तम् .. 17 ..
14.41.m: 'May you be long-lived,' said those [seers] who were pleased with him to the boy; / and having dismissed that boy, they set off to their desired region. 17

14.41.s:
teṣāṃ madhyeṃ'girānāma divyajñānasamanvitaḥ ..
tenāvalokito bālaḥ sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā paraṃtapa .. 18 ..
14.41.d:
तेषां मध्येंऽगिरानाम दिव्यज्ञानसमन्वितः ..
तेनावलोकितो बालः सूक्ष्मदृष्ट्या परंतप .. 18 ..
14.41.m: Among them was one named Aṅgiras, endowed with divine knowledge. / By him the boy was examined with subtle insight, O scorcher of foes. 18

14.41.s:
atha tānabravītsarvānmunīnkiṃcitsavismayaḥ ..
dīrghāyurna ca bālo'yaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ .. 19 ..
14.41.d:
अथ तानब्रवीत्सर्वान्मुनीन्किंचित्सविस्मयः ..
दीर्घायुर्न च बालोऽयं युष्माभिः संप्रकीर्तितः .. 19 ..
14.41.m: Then, somewhat amazed, he spoke to all those sages: / 'This boy whom you have pronounced long-lived is not long-lived. 19

14.41.s:
gamiṣyati kumāro'yaṃ nidhanaṃ paṃcame dine ..
tanna yuktaṃ hi no vākyamasatyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ .. 7.3.41.20 ..
14.41.d:
गमिष्यति कुमारोऽयं निधनं पंचमे दिने ..
तन्न युक्तं हि नो वाक्यमसत्यं द्विजसत्तमाः .. 7.3.41.20 ..
14.41.m: This young boy will go to destruction on the fifth day. / Therefore, our words should not be untruthful, O best of the twice-born. 20

14.41.s:
yathā'yaṃ cirajīvī syāttathā nītirvidhīyatām ..
atha te munayo bhītā mithyā vākyasya pārthiva .. 21 ..
14.41.d:
यथाऽयं चिरजीवी स्यात्तथा नीतिर्विधीयताम् ..
अथ ते मुनयो भीता मिथ्या वाक्यस्य पार्थिव .. 21 ..
14.41.m: A plan should be devised so that he may live long.' / Then those sages, afraid of an untrue word, O ruler of the earth, 21

14.41.s:
bālakaṃ taṃ samādāya brahmalokaṃ gatāstadā ..
tatra dṛṣṭvā caturvaktraṃ namaścakrurmunīśvarāḥ .. 22 ..
14.41.d:
बालकं तं समादाय ब्रह्मलोकं गतास्तदा ..
तत्र दृष्ट्वा चतुर्वक्त्रं नमश्चक्रुर्मुनीश्वराः .. 22 ..
14.41.m: taking that boy, went then to the world of Brahmā. / Having seen the four-faced one there, the lords of sages bowed down. 22

14.41.s:
teṣāmanaṃtaraṃ tena bālake nābhivāditaḥ ..
dīrghāyurbhava tenā'pi brahmaṇoktaḥ sa bālakaḥ .. 23 ..
14.41.d:
तेषामनंतरं तेन बालके नाभिवादितः ..
दीर्घायुर्भव तेनाऽपि ब्रह्मणोक्तः स बालकः .. 23 ..
14.41.m: Immediately after them, the boy made his obeisance to him. / To him also Brahmā said, 'May you be long-lived, O boy.' 23

14.41.s:
tataḥ saptarṣayo hṛṣṭāḥ svacitte nṛpasattama ..
sukhāsīnānsaviśrāṃtānabravīnmunipuṃgavān .. 24 ..
14.41.d:
ततः सप्तर्षयो हृष्टाः स्वचित्ते नृपसत्तम ..
सुखासीनान्सविश्रांतानब्रवीन्मुनिपुंगवान् .. 24 ..
14.41.m: Then the seven seers rejoiced in their hearts, O best of kings; / [and Brahmā] spoke to those eminent sages who were seated comfortably and rested: 24

14.41.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
paripṛcchata kiṃ kāryaṃ kuto yūyamihāgatāḥ .. 25 ..
14.41.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
परिपृच्छत किं कार्यं कुतो यूयमिहागताः .. 25 ..
14.41.m: Brahmā said: / 'Ask; what is to be done? Whence have you come here?' 25

14.41.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena bhramamāṇā mahītalam ..
arbudaṃ parvataṃ nāma tasya tīrtheṣu vai gatāḥ .. 26 ..
14.41.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन भ्रममाणा महीतलम् ..
अर्बुदं पर्वतं नाम तस्य तीर्थेषु वै गताः .. 26 ..
14.41.m: The seers said: / 'Wandering over the surface of the earth in the course of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, / we went to the sacred fords on the mountain named Arbuda. 26

14.41.s:
athāgatya drutaṃ dūrādbālenānena vaṃditāḥ ..
dīrghāyurbhava saṃdiṣṭastataścāyamanekadhā ..
paṃcame divase'syāpi mṛtyurdeva bhaviṣyati .. 27 ..
14.41.d:
अथागत्य द्रुतं दूराद्बालेनानेन वंदिताः ..
दीर्घायुर्भव संदिष्टस्ततश्चायमनेकधा ..
पंचमे दिवसेऽस्यापि मृत्युर्देव भविष्यति .. 27 ..
14.41.m: Then this boy, coming swiftly from afar, bowed to us. / "May you be long-lived" was thereupon pronounced to him by many. / Yet on the fifth day his death will occur, O god. 27

14.41.s:
yathā vayaṃ tvayā sārddhamasatyā na caturmukha ..
bhavāmo'sya kṛte deva tathā kiṃcidvidhīyatām.. 28..
14.41.d:
यथा वयं त्वया सार्द्धमसत्या न चतुर्मुख ..
भवामोऽस्य कृते देव तथा किंचिद्विधीयताम्.. 28..
14.41.m: Devise something, O god, so that we, together with you, / do not become untruthful on his account, O four-faced one.' 28

14.41.s:
atha brahmā prahṛṣṭātmā dṛṣṭvā taṃ munidārakam ..
matprasādādayaṃ bālo bhāvī kalpāyurabravīt .. 29 ..
14.41.d:
अथ ब्रह्मा प्रहृष्टात्मा दृष्ट्वा तं मुनिदारकम् ..
मत्प्रसादादयं बालो भावी कल्पायुरब्रवीत् .. 29 ..
14.41.m: Then Brahmā, his soul delighted upon seeing that sage's boy, / said: 'By my grace this boy shall live for an eon.' 29

14.41.s:
tataste munayo hṛṣṭāstamādāya gṛhaṃ prati ..
prasthitā brahmalokāttu namaskṛtvā caturmukham .. 7.3.41.30 ..
14.41.d:
ततस्ते मुनयो हृष्टास्तमादाय गृहं प्रति ..
प्रस्थिता ब्रह्मलोकात्तु नमस्कृत्वा चतुर्मुखम् .. 7.3.41.30 ..
14.41.m: Then those sages, delighted, taking him, set out towards home / from the world of Brahmā, having bowed down to the four-faced one. 30

14.41.s:
atha tasya pitā tatra mṛkaṃḍo munisattamaḥ ..
tato bhāryāsamāyukto vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ .. 31 ..
14.41.d:
अथ तस्य पिता तत्र मृकंडो मुनिसत्तमः ..
ततो भार्यासमायुक्तो विललाप सुदुःखितः .. 31 ..
14.41.m:
Then his father, Mṛkaṇḍu, the best of sages,
together with his wife, wailed in great sorrow:

14.41.s:
hā putraputra karuṇaṃ ruditvā dharmavatsalaḥ ..
anāmaṃtrya ca māṃ kasmāddīrghaṃ paṃthānamāśritaḥ ..32..
14.41.d:
हा पुत्रपुत्र करुणं रुदित्वा धर्मवत्सलः ..
अनामंत्र्य च मां कस्माद्दीर्घं पंथानमाश्रितः ..32..
14.41.m:
Weeping piteously, 'Alas, my son, my son!' the lover of righteousness [cried]:
'Without taking leave of me, why have you set out on the long road?

14.41.s:
akṛtvāpi kriyāḥ kāryāḥ kathaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ ..
so'haṃ tvayā vinā putra na jīvāmi kathaṃcana .. 33 ..
14.41.d:
अकृत्वापि क्रियाः कार्याः कथं मृत्युवशं गतः ..
सोऽहं त्वया विना पुत्र न जीवामि कथंचन .. 33 ..
14.41.m:
Without even performing the rites that ought to be done, how have you fallen into the power of Death?
Without you, my son, I cannot live in any way.'

14.41.s:
evaṃ vilapatastasya bahudhā nṛpasattama ..
bālaścābhyāgatastatra yatra deśe purā sthitaḥ .. 34 ..
14.41.d:
एवं विलपतस्तस्य बहुधा नृपसत्तम ..
बालश्चाभ्यागतस्तत्र यत्र देशे पुरा स्थितः .. 34 ..
14.41.m:
As he was wailing thus in manifold ways, O best of kings,
the boy returned to the place where he had stayed before.

14.41.s:
athāsau prayayau bālaḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pathi tātaśca saṃprahṛṣṭo babhūva ha .. 35 ..
14.41.d:
अथासौ प्रययौ बालः प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना ..
तं दृष्ट्वा पथि तातश्च संप्रहृष्टो बभूव ह .. 35 ..
14.41.m:
Then that boy walked on with an inner self filled with delight;
and his father, seeing him on the path, became exceedingly joyful.

14.41.s:
papracchāṃkaṃ samāropya cirāgamana kāraṇam..
tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ muniviceṣṭitam ..
darśanaṃ brahmalokasya padmayonervaraṃ tathā .. 36 ..
14.41.d:
पप्रच्छांकं समारोप्य चिरागमन कारणम्..
ततः स कथयामास सर्वं मुनिविचेष्टितम् ..
दर्शनं ब्रह्मलोकस्य पद्मयोनेर्वरं तथा .. 36 ..
14.41.m:
Lifting him onto his lap, he asked the reason for his long absence.
Thereupon he related all the actions of the sages, / the sight of Brahmaloka, and the boon granted by the Lotus-born [Brahmā].

14.41.s:
.. bālaka uvāca .. ..
ajaraścāmaraścāhaṃ kṛtastāta svayaṃbhuvā ..
tasmātsatyaṃ madarthe te vyetvasau mānaso jvaraḥ ..37..
14.41.d:
.. बालक उवाच .. ..
अजरश्चामरश्चाहं कृतस्तात स्वयंभुवा ..
तस्मात्सत्यं मदर्थे ते व्येत्वसौ मानसो ज्वरः ..37..
14.41.m:
The boy said: / 'Father, I have been made free from old age and death by the Self-manifest [Brahmā];
therefore, truly on my account, let this fever of your mind depart.

14.41.s:
so'hamārādhayiṣyāmi tathaiva caturānanam ..
kṛtvā''śramapadaṃ ramyamarbude parvatottame .. 38 ..
14.41.d:
सोऽहमाराधयिष्यामि तथैव चतुराननम् ..
कृत्वा'ऽश्रमपदं रम्यमर्बुदे पर्वतोत्तमे .. 38 ..
14.41.m:
I shall likewise worship the Four-faced [Brahmā],
having established a delightful hermitage on Arbuda, the best of mountains.'

14.41.s:
amṛtasrāvi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā putrasya sa dvijaḥ ..
mṛkaṃḍo harṣasaṃyukto vācamityabravīcca tam .. 39 ..
14.41.d:
अमृतस्रावि तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा पुत्रस्य स द्विजः ..
मृकंडो हर्षसंयुक्तो वाचमित्यब्रवीच्च तम् .. 39 ..
14.41.m:
Hearing that speech of his son dripping with nectar, that twice-born
Mṛkaṇḍu, filled with joy, spoke these words to him:

14.41.s:
mārkkaṃḍo'pi drutaṃ gatvā ramya marbudaparvatam ..
tapastepe suvistīrṇaṃ dhyāyandevaṃ pitāmaham.. 7.3.41.40 ..
14.41.d:
मार्क्कंडोऽपि द्रुतं गत्वा रम्य मर्बुदपर्वतम् ..
तपस्तेपे सुविस्तीर्णं ध्यायन्देवं पितामहम्.. 7.3.41.40 ..
14.41.m:
Mārkaṇḍa too, having gone swiftly to delightful Mount Arbuda,
performed vast austerity, meditating upon the god, the Grandfather [Brahmā].

14.41.s:
tasyāśramapade puṇye śrāvaṇe māsi pārthiva ..
paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yaḥ kuryātpitṛtarpaṇam ..
pitṛmedhaphalaṃ tasya sakalaṃ syādasaṃśayam ..41..
14.41.d:
तस्याश्रमपदे पुण्ये श्रावणे मासि पार्थिव ..
पौर्णमास्यां विशेषेण यः कुर्यात्पितृतर्पणम् ..
पितृमेधफलं तस्य सकलं स्यादसंशयम् ..41..
14.41.m:
In his holy hermitage, O king, in the month of Śrāvaṇa,
whoever offers water to the ancestors especially on the full moon day / obtains the entire fruit of an ancestral sacrifice, without a doubt.

14.41.s:
ṛṣiyogena yastatra tarpayedbrāhmaṇottamān ..
brahmaloke ciraṃ vāsastasya saṃjāyate nṛpa .. .. 42 ..
14.41.d:
ऋषियोगेन यस्तत्र तर्पयेद्ब्राह्मणोत्तमान् ..
ब्रह्मलोके चिरं वासस्तस्य संजायते नृप .. .. 42 ..
14.41.m:
Whoever propitiates excellent brahmins there through the sage-conjunction,
O king, attains a long residence in Brahmaloka.

14.41.s:
yaḥ snānaṃ kurute tatra samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ ..
nālpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya kule kvāpi prajāyate .. 43 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍa tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe mārkaṃḍeyāśramapadotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..41..
14.41.d:
यः स्नानं कुरुते तत्र सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः ..
नाल्पमृत्युभयं तस्य कुले क्वापि प्रजायते .. 43 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्ड तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे मार्कंडेयाश्रमपदोत्पत्तिवर्णनंनामैकचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..41..
14.41.m:
Whoever performs ritual ablution there, endowed with full faith,
no fear of untimely death arises anywhere in his lineage.
Thus ends the forty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin of the Hermitage of Mārkaṇḍeya,' in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.42.s:
.. pulastya uvāca ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ param..
uddālakena muninā sthāpitaṃ lokaviśrutam .. 1 ..
14.42.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ लिंगं पापहरं परम्..
उद्दालकेन मुनिना स्थापितं लोकविश्रुतम् .. 1 ..
14.42.m:
Pulastya said: / 'Then, O best of kings, one should go to the supreme liṅga that removes sins,
consecrated by the sage Uddālaka, renowned in the world.

14.42.s:
tasminspṛṣṭe'tha vā dṛṣṭe pūjite ca viśeṣataḥ ..
sarvaroga vinirmukto gārhasthyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ .. 2 ..
14.42.d:
तस्मिन्स्पृष्टेऽथ वा दृष्टे पूजिते च विशेषतः ..
सर्वरोग विनिर्मुक्तो गार्हस्थ्यं प्राप्नुयान्नरः .. 2 ..
14.42.m:
When it is touched, seen, or especially worshipped,
a man is freed from all diseases and attains [the blessings of] householdership.
Freed from all sins, he is glorified in Śivaloka.'

14.42.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍa uddālakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..42 ..
14.42.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्ड उद्दालकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..42 ..
14.42.m: Thus ends the forty-second chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Uddālakeśvara,' in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.43.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha siddhaliṃgaṃ susiddhidam..
siddhaistu sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam .. 1 ..
14.43.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ सिद्धलिंगं सुसिद्धिदम्..
सिद्धैस्तु स्थापितं लिंगं सर्वपातकनाशनम् .. 1 ..
14.43.m:
Pulastya said: / 'Then, O best of kings, one should go to the Siddhaliṅga that bestows great accomplishment,
a liṅga consecrated by the Siddhas, destroying all evils.

14.43.s:
tatrāsti śobhanaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sunirmalajalānvitam ..
tatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅmucyate brahmahatyayā .. 2 ..
14.43.d:
तत्रास्ति शोभनं कुण्डं सुनिर्मलजलान्वितम् ..
तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यङ्मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया .. 2 ..
14.43.m:
There lies an auspicious pool endowed with pure water;
a man who has performed ritual ablution there properly is freed from the killing of a brahmin.

14.43.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyaṃstatra snāti naro nṛpa ..
avaśyaṃ tamavāpnoti niṣṭhāṃte ca parāṃ gatim .. 3 ..
14.43.d:
यंयं काममभिध्यायंस्तत्र स्नाति नरो नृप ..
अवश्यं तमवाप्नोति निष्ठांते च परां गतिम् .. 3 ..
14.43.m:
Whatever desire a man meditates upon while bathing there, O king,
he inevitably attains it, and at the end of life, the supreme goal.'

14.43.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe siddheśvaramahimavarṇanaṃnāma trayaścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ..43..
14.43.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे सिद्धेश्वरमहिमवर्णनंनाम त्रयश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः ..43..
14.43.m: Thus ends the forty-third chapter, entitled 'Description of the Greatness of Siddheśvara,' in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.44.s:
pulastya uvāca ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha gajatīrthamanuttamam ..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ diggajairbhāvitātmabhiḥ .. 1 ..
14.44.d:
पुलस्त्य उवाच ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ गजतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं दिग्गजैर्भावितात्मभिः .. 1 ..
14.44.m:
Pulastya said: / 'Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Gajatīrtha,
where austerity was formerly performed by the self-controlled directional elephants,

14.44.d:
भूभारधरणैश्चान्यैरैरावणमुखैर्नृप ..
तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यग्गजदानफलं लभेत् .. 2 ..
14.44.m:
the bearers of the earth's burden, headed by Airāvaṇa and others, O king.
A man who has performed ritual ablution there properly obtains the fruit of gifting an elephant.'

14.44.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe gajatīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 44 ..
14.44.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे गजतीर्थप्रभाववर्णनंनाम चतुश्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 44 ..
14.44.m: Thus ends the forty-fourth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Power of Gajatīrtha,' in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.45.s:
.. pulastya uvāca.. ..
devakhātaṃ tato gacchetsupuṇyaṃ tīrthamuttamam ..
yatkhyātirvibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ svayameva vyadhīyata .. 1 ..
14.45.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच.. ..
देवखातं ततो गच्छेत्सुपुण्यं तीर्थमुत्तमम् ..
यत्ख्यातिर्विबुधैः सर्वैः स्वयमेव व्यधीयत .. 1 ..
14.45.m:
Pulastya said: / 'Then one should go to Devakhāta, an exceedingly holy, supreme tīrtha,
whose renown was created by all the gods themselves.

14.45.s:
tatra yaḥ kurute śrāddhamamāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
kanyāgate ravau rājansa labhetparamaṃ padam ..
pitṝnsa tārayatyeva prāptānapi sudurgatim.. 2 ..
14.45.d:
तत्र यः कुरुते श्राद्धममावास्यां विशेषतः ..
कन्यागते रवौ राजन्स लभेत्परमं पदम् ..
पितॄन्स तारयत्येव प्राप्तानपि सुदुर्गतिम्.. 2 ..
14.45.m:
Whoever performs a śrāddha there, especially on the new moon day
when the sun has entered Virgo, O king, attains the supreme abode; / he indeed delivers his ancestors even if they have fallen into an evil state.'

14.45.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe śrīdevakhātotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 45 ..
14.45.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे श्रीदेवखातोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 45 ..
14.45.m: Thus ends the forty-fifth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Origin and Māhātmya of the Holy Devakhāta,' in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.46.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato vyāseśvaraṃ gacchedvyāsena sthāpitaṃ hi yat ..
taṃ dṛṣṭvā jāyate martyo medhāvī matimāñchuciḥ ..
saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā .. 1 ..
14.46.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो व्यासेश्वरं गच्छेद्व्यासेन स्थापितं हि यत् ..
तं दृष्ट्वा जायते मर्त्यो मेधावी मतिमाञ्छुचिः ..
सप्तजन्मांतराण्येव व्यासस्य वचनं यथा .. 1 ..
14.46.m:
Pulastya said: / 'Then one should go to Vyāseśvara, which was indeed consecrated by Vyāsa.
Having seen it, a mortal becomes wise, intelligent, and pure / for seven successive births, according to the word of Vyāsa.'

14.46.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vyāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 46 .. ..
14.46.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे व्यासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्चत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 46 .. ..
14.46.m: Thus ends the forty-sixth chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Vyāsatīrtha,' in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a compendium of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.47.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha supūrṇaṃ gautamāśramam ..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ gautamena mahātmanā .. 1 ..
14.47.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ सुपूर्णं गौतमाश्रमम् ..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं गौतमेन महात्मना .. 1 ..
14.47.m:
Pulastya said: / 'Then, O best of kings, one should go to the very complete hermitage of Gautama,
where austerity was formerly performed by the great-souled Gautama.

14.47.s:
purā''sīdgautamo nāma muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ ..
sa bhaktyā''rādhayāmāsa devadevaṃ maheśvaram .. 2 ..
14.47.d:
पुरा'ऽसीद्गौतमो नाम मुनिः परमधार्मिकः ..
स भक्त्या'ऽराधयामास देवदेवं महेश्वरम् .. 2 ..
14.47.m:
Formerly there was a sage named Gautama, supremely righteous;
with devotion he worshipped the god of gods, Maheśvara.

14.47.s:
bhaktyā''rādhayamānasya nirbhidya dharaṇītalam ..
samuttasthau mahalliṃgaṃ paraṃ māheśvaraṃ nṛpa .. 3 ..
14.47.d:
भक्त्या'ऽराधयमानस्य निर्भिद्य धरणीतलम् ..
समुत्तस्थौ महल्लिंगं परं माहेश्वरं नृप .. 3 ..
14.47.m:
As he worshipped with devotion, cleaving through the surface of the earth,
a great liṅga arose, supreme and dedicated to Maheśvara, O king.

14.47.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
pūjayaitanmahalliṃgaṃ tvadbhaktyā samupasthitam..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate ..4..
14.47.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
पूजयैतन्महल्लिंगं त्वद्भक्त्या समुपस्थितम्..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ..4..
14.47.m:
At that very time, a bodiless voice spoke:
"Worship this great liṅga, which has appeared because of your devotion. / Choose a boon—may good betide you—whatever is in your heart."

14.47.s:
.. gautama uvāca.. ..
atrāśramapade deva tvayā śambho jagatpate ..
sadā kāryaṃ hi sānnidhyaṃ yadi tuṣṭo mama prabho.. 5 ..
14.47.d:
.. गौतम उवाच.. ..
अत्राश्रमपदे देव त्वया शम्भो जगत्पते ..
सदा कार्यं हि सान्निध्यं यदि तुष्टो मम प्रभो.. 5 ..
14.47.m:
Gautama said: / "O god, O Śambhu, O Lord of the universe, if you are pleased with me, O Lord,
you must always maintain your presence here in this hermitage.

14.47.s: yastvāṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchatu .. 6 ..
14.47.d: यस्त्वां पश्यति सद्भक्त्या ब्रह्मलोकं स गच्छतु .. 6 ..
14.47.m: May whoever sees you with true devotion go to Brahmaloka."

14.47.s:
.. ākāśavāṇyuvāca .. ..
māghamāse caturddaśyāṃ yo'tra māṃ vīkṣayiṣyati ..
kṛṣṇāyāṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha sa yāsyati parāṃ gatim ..7..
14.47.d:
.. आकाशवाण्युवाच .. ..
माघमासे चतुर्द्दश्यां योऽत्र मां वीक्षयिष्यति ..
कृष्णायां ब्राह्मणश्रेष्ठ स यास्यति परां गतिम् ..7..
14.47.m:
The voice from the sky said: / "Whoever beholds me here on the fourteenth day
of the dark fortnight in the month of Māgha, O best of brahmins, shall attain the supreme goal."'

14.47.s:
evamuktvā tato vāṇī virarāma mahīpate ..
tatrāsti kuṇḍamaparaṃ pavitraṃ jalapūritam..
tatra snāto naraḥ sadyaḥ kulaṃ tārayate'khilam .. 8 ..
14.47.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो वाणी विरराम महीपते ..
तत्रास्ति कुण्डमपरं पवित्रं जलपूरितम्..
तत्र स्नातो नरः सद्यः कुलं तारयतेऽखिलम् .. 8 ..
14.47.m: Having spoken thus, the voice then fell silent, O lord of the earth. / There is another pure pool there, filled with water; / a man who bathes there instantly saves his entire family.

14.47.s:
yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ viśeṣādindusaṃkṣaye ..
gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ tasya sakalaṃ jāyate dhruvam .. 9 ..
14.47.d:
यस्तत्र कुरुते श्राद्धं विशेषादिन्दुसंक्षये ..
गयाश्राद्धफलं तस्य सकलं जायते ध्रुवम् .. 9 ..
14.47.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there, especially on the new moon, / certainly obtains the entire fruit of a Gayā-śrāddha.

14.47.s:
tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tilānāṃ munipuṃgavāḥ ..
tilasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi dānātsvarge vasennṛpa .. 7.3.47.10 ..
14.47.d:
तत्र दानं प्रशंसंति तिलानां मुनिपुंगवाः ..
तिलसंख्यानि वर्षाणि दानात्स्वर्गे वसेन्नृप .. 7.3.47.10 ..
14.47.m: The best among sages praise the gifting of sesame seeds there; / from the gift of sesame seeds, O king, one may dwell in heaven for as many years as there are seeds.

14.47.s:
arbude gautamī yātrā siṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau ..
amāyāṃ somavāreṇa dviṣaḍgodāvarīphalam .. 11 ..
14.47.d:
अर्बुदे गौतमी यात्रा सिंहस्थे च बृहस्पतौ ..
अमायां सोमवारेण द्विषड्गोदावरीफलम् .. 11 ..
14.47.m: On Arbuda, the Gautamī pilgrimage when Jupiter is in Leo, / on a new moon falling on a Monday, yields twelve times the fruit of the Godāvarī.
Immersion in the Bhāgīrathī for sixty thousand years / [equals] a single ritual ablution in the Godāvarī when Jupiter is in Leo.

14.47.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe gautamāśramatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 47 ..
14.47.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशातिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे गौतमाश्रमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 47 ..
14.47.m: Thus ends the forty-seventh chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of the Sacred Ford of Gautama’s Hermitage', in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh [part], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skandapurāṇa, the Mahāpurāṇa in eighty-one thousand verses.

14.48.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
kulasaṃtāraṇaṃ gacchettatra tīrthamanuttamam ..
yatra snāto naraḥ samyakkulaṃ tārayate'khilam.. 1 ..
14.48.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
कुलसंतारणं गच्छेत्तत्र तीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
यत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यक्कुलं तारयतेऽखिलम्.. 1 ..
14.48.m: Pulastya said: / One should go there to the unexcelled sacred ford called Kulasaṃtāraṇa, / where a man who has bathed properly saves his entire family.

14.48.s:
daśa pūrvānbhaviṣyāṃśca tathātmānaṃ nṛpottama ..
uddharecchraddhayāyuktastatra dānena mānavaḥ .. 2 ..
14.48.d:
दश पूर्वान्भविष्यांश्च तथात्मानं नृपोत्तम ..
उद्धरेच्छ्रद्धयायुक्तस्तत्र दानेन मानवः .. 2 ..
14.48.m: Endowed with faith, O best of kings, / a man should deliver through gifting there ten ancestors, ten future descendants, and himself.

14.48.s:
āsīdaprastuto nāma rājā pūrvaṃ sa pāpakṛt ..
nāpi dānaṃ tathā jñānaṃ na dhyānaṃ na ca satkriyā .. 3 ..
14.48.d:
आसीदप्रस्तुतो नाम राजा पूर्वं स पापकृत् ..
नापि दानं तथा ज्ञानं न ध्यानं न च सत्क्रिया .. 3 ..
14.48.m: Formerly, there was an evil-doing king named Aprastuta; / he had neither charity nor knowledge, neither meditation nor righteous conduct.

14.48.s:
tasmiñchāsati lokānāṃ nāsītsaukhyaṃ kadācana ..
paradāra rucirnityaṃ mahādaṇḍaparaśca saḥ .. 4 ..
14.48.d:
तस्मिञ्छासति लोकानां नासीत्सौख्यं कदाचन ..
परदार रुचिर्नित्यं महादण्डपरश्च सः .. 4 ..
14.48.m: While he ruled, the people never experienced happiness; / he was constantly lusting after others' wives and intent upon severe punishments.

14.48.s:
nyāyato'nyāyato vāpi karoti dhanasaṃgraham ..
sa ghātayati lokāṃśca nirdoṣānpāpakṛttamaḥ .. 5 ..
14.48.d:
न्यायतोऽन्यायतो वापि करोति धनसंग्रहम् ..
स घातयति लोकांश्च निर्दोषान्पापकृत्तमः .. 5 ..
14.48.m: Whether justly or unjustly, he amassed wealth; / that greatest of evil-doers also had innocent people slaughtered.

14.48.s:
tato vārdhakyamāpannastathāpi na śamaṃ gataḥ ..
kasyacittvatha kālasya pitṛbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ ..
taṃ prasuptaṃ samāsādya nārakeyaiḥ suduḥkhitaiḥ .. 6..
14.48.d:
ततो वार्धक्यमापन्नस्तथापि न शमं गतः ..
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य पितृभिः प्रतिबोधितः ..
तं प्रसुप्तं समासाद्य नारकेयैः सुदुःखितैः .. 6..
14.48.m: Then, having reached old age, he still did not attain tranquility. / But after some time, he was awakened by his ancestors, / who, extremely distressed in hell, approached him as he slept.

14.48.s:
.. pitara ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ śuddhasamācārā nityaṃ dharmaparāyaṇāḥ ..
dānayajñatapaḥśīlāḥ svadāraniratāstathā .. 7 ..
14.48.d:
.. पितर ऊचुः .. ..
वयं शुद्धसमाचारा नित्यं धर्मपरायणाः ..
दानयज्ञतपःशीलाः स्वदारनिरतास्तथा .. 7 ..
14.48.m: The ancestors said: / We were of pure conduct, always devoted to righteousness, / practicing charity, sacrifice, and austerity, and devoted to our own wives.

14.48.s:
svakarmabhiḥ kulāṃgāra divaṃ prāptā yathārhataḥ ..
kuputraṃ tvāṃ samāsādya narakaṃ samupasthitāḥ ..
tasmāduddhara naḥ sarvānkṛtvā kiṃcicchubhārcanam .. 8 ..
14.48.d:
स्वकर्मभिः कुलांगार दिवं प्राप्ता यथार्हतः ..
कुपुत्रं त्वां समासाद्य नरकं समुपस्थिताः ..
तस्मादुद्धर नः सर्वान्कृत्वा किंचिच्छुभार्चनम् .. 8 ..
14.48.m: By our own deeds, O ember of your family, we attained heaven as was deserved. / Having obtained you as an evil son, we have entered hell. / Therefore, having performed some auspicious worship, deliver us all!

14.48.s:
karmabhistava pāpātmanvayaṃ narakamāśritāḥ ..
narakaṃ daśa yāsyaṃti bhaviṣyāśca tathā bhavān .. 9 ..
14.48.d:
कर्मभिस्तव पापात्मन्वयं नरकमाश्रिताः ..
नरकं दश यास्यंति भविष्याश्च तथा भवान् .. 9 ..
14.48.m: Because of your deeds, O sinful soul, we have taken refuge in hell. / Ten future descendants shall also go to hell, and likewise you.

14.48.s:
evamuktvā ca te sarve pitarastu suduḥkhitāḥ ..
yātāśca narakaṃ bhūyaḥ prabuddhaḥ so'pi pārthivaḥ .. 7.3.48.10 ..
14.48.d:
एवमुक्त्वा च ते सर्वे पितरस्तु सुदुःखिताः ..
याताश्च नरकं भूयः प्रबुद्धः सोऽपि पार्थिवः .. 7.3.48.10 ..
14.48.m: Having spoken thus, all those ancestors, deeply sorrowful, / went back to hell; and that king woke up.

14.48.s:
tato duḥkhamanuprāptaḥ pitṛvākyāni saṃsmaran ..
ruroda prātarutthāya taṃ bhāryā pratyabhāṣata .. 11 ..
14.48.d:
ततो दुःखमनुप्राप्तः पितृवाक्यानि संस्मरन् ..
रुरोद प्रातरुत्थाय तं भार्या प्रत्यभाषत .. 11 ..
14.48.m: Then, overcome with grief, remembering the words of his ancestors, / he wept upon rising in the morning. His wife addressed him:

14.48.s:
.. indumatyuvāca .. ..
kimarthaṃ rājaśārdūla tvaṃ rodiṣi mahāsvanam ..
kathaṃ te kuśalaṃ rājye śarīre vā pure'thavā .. 12 .. ..
14.48.d:
.. इन्दुमत्युवाच .. ..
किमर्थं राजशार्दूल त्वं रोदिषि महास्वनम् ..
कथं ते कुशलं राज्ये शरीरे वा पुरेऽथवा .. 12 .. ..
14.48.m: Indumatī said: / Why, O tiger among kings, do you weep so loudly? / Is there welfare in your kingdom, or in your body, or in the city?

14.48.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
mayā dṛṣṭo'dya svapnāṃte pitā hyatha pitāmahaḥ ..
apaśyaṃ duḥkhitāndevi tābhyāmathāgrajānpitṝn .. 13 ..
14.48.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
मया दृष्टोऽद्य स्वप्नांते पिता ह्यथ पितामहः ..
अपश्यं दुःखितान्देवि ताभ्यामथाग्रजान्पितॄन् .. 13 ..
14.48.m: The king said: / At the end of a dream today, I saw my father and grandfather; / O queen, I saw those ancestors and their elder brothers grieving.

14.48.s:
upālabdho'smi taiḥ sarvaistava karmabhirīdṛśaiḥ ..
dāruṇe narake prāptā adharmādiviceṣṭitaiḥ .. 14 ..
14.48.d:
उपालब्धोऽस्मि तैः सर्वैस्तव कर्मभिरीदृशैः ..
दारुणे नरके प्राप्ता अधर्मादिविचेष्टितैः .. 14 ..
14.48.m: I was reproached by all of them: 'Because of your such deeds, / because of your actions devoid of righteousness, we have landed in a terrible hell!

14.48.s:
athānye daśa yāsyanti bhaviṣyāśca bhavānapi ..
tasmātkṛtvā śubhaṃ karma durgateścoddharasva naḥ .. 15 ..
14.48.d:
अथान्ये दश यास्यन्ति भविष्याश्च भवानपि ..
तस्मात्कृत्वा शुभं कर्म दुर्गतेश्चोद्धरस्व नः .. 15 ..
14.48.m: Furthermore, ten future descendants will go [there], and you as well. / Therefore, having performed an auspicious deed, deliver us from this misfortune!'

14.48.s:
evamuktaḥ prabuddho'haṃ pitṛbhirvaravarṇini ..
tenāhaṃ duḥkhamāpannastadvākyaṃ hṛdi saṃsmaran .. 16 .. ..
14.48.d:
एवमुक्तः प्रबुद्धोऽहं पितृभिर्वरवर्णिनि ..
तेनाहं दुःखमापन्नस्तद्वाक्यं हृदि संस्मरन् .. 16 .. ..
14.48.m: Having been spoken to thus by the ancestors, O lady of fair complexion, I awoke. / Because of that I have fallen into sorrow, remembering their words in my heart.

14.48.s:
.. indumatyuvāca .. ..
satyametanmahārāja yadukto'si pitāmahaiḥ ..
na tvayā sukṛtaṃ karma saṃsmare'haṃ kṛtaṃ purā .. 17 ..
14.48.d:
.. इन्दुमत्युवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाराज यदुक्तोऽसि पितामहैः ..
न त्वया सुकृतं कर्म संस्मरेऽहं कृतं पुरा .. 17 ..
14.48.m: Indumatī said: / This that you were told by your ancestors, O great king, is true. / I do not recall any good deed performed by you in the past.

14.48.s:
yathā suputramāsādya taraṃti pitaro nṛpa ..
kuputreṇa tathā yāṃti narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 18 ..
14.48.d:
यथा सुपुत्रमासाद्य तरंति पितरो नृप ..
कुपुत्रेण तथा यांति नरकं नात्र संशयः .. 18 ..
14.48.m: Just as ancestors are saved by having a good son, O king, / so they go to hell through an evil son; there is no doubt about this.

14.48.s:
sa tvamāhūya vipreṃdrāndharmaśāstravicakṣaṇān ..
pṛṣṭvā tānkuru yacchreyaḥ pitṝṇāmātmanā saha .. 19 ..
14.48.d:
स त्वमाहूय विप्रेंद्रान्धर्मशास्त्रविचक्षणान् ..
पृष्ट्वा तान्कुरु यच्छ्रेयः पितॄणामात्मना सह .. 19 ..
14.48.m: Summon the best of brahmins who are learned in the treatises on dharma; / consult them and do what is best for the ancestors along with yourself.

14.48.s:
ānayāmāsa rājā'sau tato viprānanekaśaḥ ..
vedavedāṃgatattvajñāndharmaśāstravicakṣaṇān ..
uvāca vinayopeto bhāryayā sahito hitān.. 7.3.48.20 ..
14.48.d:
आनयामास राजाऽसौ ततो विप्राननेकशः ..
वेदवेदांगतत्त्वज्ञान्धर्मशास्त्रविचक्षणान् ..
उवाच विनयोपेतो भार्यया सहितो हितान्.. 7.3.48.20 ..
14.48.m: Then that king brought many brahmins / who knew the truth of the Vedas and Vedāṅgas and were learned in the treatises on dharma. / Together with his wife, he spoke humbly to these well-wishers:

14.48.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
karmaṇā kena pitaro nirayasthā dvijottamāḥ ..
svargaṃ yāṃti suputreṇa tāritāḥ procyatāṃ sphuṭam .. .. 21 ..
14.48.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
कर्मणा केन पितरो निरयस्था द्विजोत्तमाः ..
स्वर्गं यांति सुपुत्रेण तारिताः प्रोच्यतां स्फुटम् .. .. 21 ..
14.48.m: The king said: / By what deed, O best among the twice-born, can ancestors residing in hell / be delivered by a good son and go to heaven? Let this be clearly spoken!

14.48.s:
.. brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ .. ..
pitṛmedhena rājeṃdra kṛtena vidhipūrvakam ..
nirayasthā divaṃ yāṃti yadyapi syuḥ supāpinaḥ .. 22 ..
14.48.d:
.. ब्राह्मणा ऊचुः .. ..
पितृमेधेन राजेंद्र कृतेन विधिपूर्वकम् ..
निरयस्था दिवं यांति यद्यपि स्युः सुपापिनः .. 22 ..
14.48.m: The brahmins said: / By means of a pitṛmedha performed according to prescribed rule, O ruler of kings, / those residing in hell go to heaven, even if they should be great sinners.

14.48.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
dīkṣayaṃtu dvijāḥ sarve tadarthaṃ māṃ dhṛtavratam ..
yatkiṃcidatra karttavyaṃ procyatāmakhilaṃ hi tat .. 23 ..
14.48.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
दीक्षयंतु द्विजाः सर्वे तदर्थं मां धृतव्रतम् ..
यत्किंचिदत्र कर्त्तव्यं प्रोच्यतामखिलं हि तत् .. 23 ..
14.48.m: The king said: / Let all the twice-born initiate me, who observe the vow for that purpose. / Whatever is to be done in this matter, let it all indeed be declared!

14.48.s:
tathoktāste nṛpeṃdreṇa brāhmaṇāḥ satyavādinaḥ ..
samagrāḥ pārthivaṃ procuryaduktaṃ yajñakarmaṇi .. 24 ..
14.48.d:
तथोक्तास्ते नृपेंद्रेण ब्राह्मणाः सत्यवादिनः ..
समग्राः पार्थिवं प्रोचुर्यदुक्तं यज्ञकर्मणि .. 24 ..
14.48.m: Thus addressed by that ruler of kings, those truthful brahmins / together told the king what was prescribed for the sacrificial rite:

14.48.s:
dīkṣā grāhyā nṛpaśreṣṭha puraścaraṇamāditaḥ ..
kṛtvā kāyaviśuddhyarthaṃ tataḥ śreyaskarī bhavet .. 25 ..
14.48.d:
दीक्षा ग्राह्या नृपश्रेष्ठ पुरश्चरणमादितः ..
कृत्वा कायविशुद्ध्यर्थं ततः श्रेयस्करी भवेत् .. 25 ..
14.48.m: O best of kings, an initiation should be taken after first performing a preliminary rite / for the purification of the body; then it becomes conducive to welfare.

14.48.s:
sa tvaṃ pāpasamācāro bālyātprabhṛti pārthiva ..
asaṃkhyaṃ pātakaṃ tasmāttīrthayātrāṃ samācara .. 26 ..
14.48.d:
स त्वं पापसमाचारो बाल्यात्प्रभृति पार्थिव ..
असंख्यं पातकं तस्मात्तीर्थयात्रां समाचर .. 26 ..
14.48.m: You have engaged in sinful conduct since childhood, O king, / [and accrued] countless sins; therefore, undertake a pilgrimage to sacred fords.

14.48.s:
sarvatīrthābhiṣiktastvaṃ yadā syānnṛpasattama ..
prāyaścittena yogyaḥ syāstato yajñasya nānyathā .. 27 ..
14.48.d:
सर्वतीर्थाभिषिक्तस्त्वं यदा स्यान्नृपसत्तम ..
प्रायश्चित्तेन योग्यः स्यास्ततो यज्ञस्य नान्यथा .. 27 ..
14.48.m: When you have bathed in all the sacred fords, O best of kings, / you will become eligible for the sacrifice through that expiation, not otherwise.

14.48.s:
prabhāsādīni tīrthāni yāni saṃti dharātale ..
gaṃtavyaṃ teṣu sarveṣu snānaṃ kuru samāhitaḥ .. 28 ..
14.48.d:
प्रभासादीनि तीर्थानि यानि संति धरातले ..
गंतव्यं तेषु सर्वेषु स्नानं कुरु समाहितः .. 28 ..
14.48.m: Go to all those sacred fords that exist on the face of the earth, / such as Prabhāsa, and bathe with a focused mind.

14.48.s:
manasā gaccha durgāṇi dadaddānamanuttamam ..
naśyettenāśubhaṃ kiṃcidapi brahmavadhodbhavam ..
yanna yāti nṛṇāṃ rājaṃstīrthasnānādinā bhuvi .. 29 ..
14.48.d:
मनसा गच्छ दुर्गाणि ददद्दानमनुत्तमम् ..
नश्येत्तेनाशुभं किंचिदपि ब्रह्मवधोद्भवम् ..
यन्न याति नृणां राजंस्तीर्थस्नानादिना भुवि .. 29 ..
14.48.m: Travel to impassable places in mind, giving the best of gifts. / By that, any inauspiciousness arising from the slaying of a brahmin might be destroyed, / which does not vanish for mortals on earth even through bathing in sacred fords and the like.

14.48.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
viprāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājā śraddhayā'nvitaḥ ..
tīrthayātrāparo bhūtvā paribabhrāma medinīm.. .. 7.3.48.30 ..
14.48.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
विप्राणां वचनं श्रुत्वा स राजा श्रद्धयाऽन्वितः ..
तीर्थयात्रापरो भूत्वा परिबभ्राम मेदिनीम्.. .. 7.3.48.30 ..
14.48.m: Pulastya said: / Having heard the words of the brahmins, that king, filled with faith / and devoted to the pilgrimage to sacred fords, wandered the earth.

14.48.s:
niyato niyatāhāro dadaddānāni bhūriśaḥ ..
rājye putraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vasuṃ satyaparākramam .. 31 ..
14.48.d:
नियतो नियताहारो ददद्दानानि भूरिशः ..
राज्ये पुत्रं प्रतिष्ठाप्य वसुं सत्यपराक्रमम् .. 31 ..
14.48.m: Restrained, with restricted food, giving abundant gifts, / having established on the throne his son Vasu of true prowess,

14.48.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tīrthayātrānuṣaṃgataḥ ..
yāto'sau nṛpatiścaiva hyarbude nirmalodakam .. 32 ..
14.48.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तीर्थयात्रानुषंगतः ..
यातोऽसौ नृपतिश्चैव ह्यर्बुदे निर्मलोदकम् .. 32 ..
14.48.m: in the course of his pilgrimage to sacred fords after some time, / that king indeed arrived at Arbuda with its clear waters.

14.48.s:
sa snānamakarottatra śraddhāpūtena cetasā ..
snātamātrasya tasyātha tasminneva jalāśaye .. .. 33 ..
14.48.d:
स स्नानमकरोत्तत्र श्रद्धापूतेन चेतसा ..
स्नातमात्रस्य तस्याथ तस्मिन्नेव जलाशये .. .. 33 ..
14.48.m: He performed a ritual ablution there with a mind purified by faith. / As soon as he had bathed in that very body of water,

14.48.s:
vimuktāḥ pitaro raudrānnarakātsupraharṣitāḥ ..
tato divyavimānasthā divyamālyāṃbarānvitāḥ .. 34 ..
14.48.d:
विमुक्ताः पितरो रौद्रान्नरकात्सुप्रहर्षिताः ..
ततो दिव्यविमानस्था दिव्यमाल्यांबरान्विताः .. 34 ..
14.48.m: His ancestors were released from terrible hell, overjoyed. / Then, seated in a divine aerial chariot and adorned with divine garlands and garments,

14.48.s:
tamūcustāritāḥ sarve vayaṃ putra tvayā'dhunā ..
tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa bhaviṣyāśca tathā daśa .. 35 ..
14.48.d:
तमूचुस्तारिताः सर्वे वयं पुत्र त्वयाऽधुना ..
तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेण भविष्याश्च तथा दश .. 35 ..
14.48.m: they said to him: “O son, we all have now been redeemed by you / by the power of this sacred ford, as well as ten generations to come,

14.48.s:
ātmā ca pārthivaśreṣṭha snānācca jalatarpaṇāt ..
yasmātkulaṃ tvayā putra tīrthe'smiṃstāritaṃ tataḥ .. 36 ..
14.48.d:
आत्मा च पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ स्नानाच्च जलतर्पणात् ..
यस्मात्कुलं त्वया पुत्र तीर्थेऽस्मिंस्तारितं ततः .. 36 ..
14.48.m: and yourself, O best of kings, through your ritual ablution and water libation. / Because the family was redeemed by you, son, at this sacred ford,

14.48.s:
kulasaṃtāraṇaṃnāma tīrthametadbhaviṣyati ..
tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra sahā'smābhirdivaṃ prati ..
āgacchānena dehena tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 37 ..
14.48.d:
कुलसंतारणंनाम तीर्थमेतद्भविष्यति ..
तस्मात्त्वमपि राजेंद्र सहाऽस्माभिर्दिवं प्रति ..
आगच्छानेन देहेन तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 37 ..
14.48.m: this sacred ford will be known as Kulasaṃtāraṇa. / Therefore, you too, O king of kings, together with us, / come to heaven in this very body by the power of this sacred ford!”

14.48.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktaḥ sa rājeṃdro divyakāṃtivapustadā ..
taṃ vimānamathāruhya gataḥ svargaṃ ca taiḥ saha .. 38 ..
14.48.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तः स राजेंद्रो दिव्यकांतिवपुस्तदा ..
तं विमानमथारुह्य गतः स्वर्गं च तैः सह .. 38 ..
