14.48.m: Pulastya said: / Addressed thus, that king of kings, his body then possessing divine radiance, / mounted that aerial chariot and went to heaven along with them.

14.48.s:
eṣa prabhāvo rājarṣe kulasaṃtāraṇasya ca ..
mayā te varṇitaḥ samyagbhūyaḥ kiṃ paripṛcchasi .. 39 ..
14.48.d:
एष प्रभावो राजर्षे कुलसंतारणस्य च ..
मया ते वर्णितः सम्यग्भूयः किं परिपृच्छसि .. 39 ..
14.48.m: Such is the power of Kulasaṃtāraṇa, O royal seer, / described fully by me to you. What more do you ask?

14.48.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
sa kiṃprabhāvo rājā sa tathā pāpasamanvitaḥ ..
svadehena gataḥ svargametanme kautukaṃ mahat .. 7.3.48.40 ..
14.48.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
स किंप्रभावो राजा स तथा पापसमन्वितः ..
स्वदेहेन गतः स्वर्गमेतन्मे कौतुकं महत् .. 7.3.48.40 ..
14.48.m: Yayāti said: / What power did that king possess, who, though so full of sin, / went to heaven in his own body? This is a great wonder to me.

14.48.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
rākāsomavyatīpāta samakāle nṛpottama ..
sa snāto yatra bhūpālastanmahacchreyase param .. 41 ..
14.48.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
राकासोमव्यतीपात समकाले नृपोत्तम ..
स स्नातो यत्र भूपालस्तन्महच्छ्रेयसे परम् .. 41 ..
14.48.m: Pulastya said: / At the very moment of a full moon, Monday, and vyatīpāta, O best of kings, / the king bathed there, which led to the supreme, highest good.

14.48.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kulasaṃtāraṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 48 ..
14.48.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे कुलसंतारणतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टचत्वारिंशोऽध्यायः .. 48 ..
14.48.m: Thus ends the forty-eighth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Kulasaṃtāraṇa Sacred Ford,’ in the Arbudakhaṇḍa, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.49.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
rāmatīrthaṃ tato gacchetpuṇyamṛṣiniṣevitam..
tatra snātasya marttyasya jāyate pāpasaṃkṣayaḥ .. 1 ..
14.49.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
रामतीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्पुण्यमृषिनिषेवितम्..
तत्र स्नातस्य मर्त्त्यस्य जायते पापसंक्षयः .. 1 ..
14.49.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Rāmatīrtha, sacred and resorted to by seers; / for a mortal who has bathed there, destruction of sin occurs,

14.49.s:
pitṝṇāṃ ca parā tuṣṭiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ..
purāsīdbhārgavo rāmaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ .. 2 ..
14.49.d:
पितॄणां च परा तुष्टिर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ..
पुरासीद्भार्गवो रामः सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः .. 2 ..
14.49.m: and supreme satisfaction of the ancestors until the dissolution of all beings. / Formerly, there was Rāma the Bhārgava, the best of all weapon-bearers.

14.49.s:
tena pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ śatrūṇāmicchatā kṣayam..
tataḥ pāśupataṃ nāma tasyāstraṃ paramaṃ dadau .. 3 ..
14.49.d:
तेन पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं शत्रूणामिच्छता क्षयम्..
ततः पाशुपतं नाम तस्यास्त्रं परमं ददौ .. 3 ..
14.49.m: Earlier, desiring the destruction of his enemies, he performed austerity; / then He gave him the supreme weapon named Pāśupata.

14.49.s:
tapastuṣṭo mahādevo gate varṣaśatatraye ..
abravīdvarado'smīti sa vavre śatrusaṃkṣayam .. 4 ..
14.49.d:
तपस्तुष्टो महादेवो गते वर्षशतत्रये ..
अब्रवीद्वरदोऽस्मीति स वव्रे शत्रुसंक्षयम् .. 4 ..
14.49.m: Pleased with his austerity after three hundred years had passed, / Mahādeva said, “I am a giver of boons,” and he chose the destruction of his enemies.

14.49.s:
tataḥ pāśupataṃ nāma tasyāstraṃ paramaṃ dadau ..
smaraṇenāpi śatrūṇāṃ yasya saṃjāyate kṣayaḥ .. 5 ..
14.49.d:
ततः पाशुपतं नाम तस्यास्त्रं परमं ददौ ..
स्मरणेनापि शत्रूणां यस्य संजायते क्षयः .. 5 ..
14.49.m: Then He gave him the supreme weapon named Pāśupata, / by the mere remembrance of which the destruction of enemies occurs.

14.49.s:
abravīdvacanaṃ cāpi prahasya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
jāmadagnya mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ .. 6 ..
14.49.d:
अब्रवीद्वचनं चापि प्रहस्य वृषभध्वजः ..
जामदग्न्य महाबाहो शृणु मे परमं वचः .. 6 ..
14.49.m: And smiling, the bull-bannered [god] spoke these words: / “O son of Jamadagni, mighty-armed one, hear my supreme words!

14.49.s:
astreṇānena yuktastvamajeyaḥ sarvadehinām ..
bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādādbhṛgūdvaha .. 7 ..
14.49.d:
अस्त्रेणानेन युक्तस्त्वमजेयः सर्वदेहिनाम् ..
भविष्यसि न संदेहो मत्प्रसादाद्भृगूद्वह .. 7 ..
14.49.m: Endowed with this weapon, you will be unconquerable by all embodied beings / without a doubt, through my grace, O scion of Bhṛgu.

14.49.s:
etajjalāśayaṃ puṇyaṃ trailokye sacarācare ..
rāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ matprasādādbhaviṣyati .. 8 ..
14.49.d:
एतज्जलाशयं पुण्यं त्रैलोक्ये सचराचरे ..
रामतीर्थमिति ख्यातं मत्प्रसादाद्भविष्यति .. 8 ..
14.49.m: This holy pool, renowned in the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings / as Rāmatīrtha, will come to be through my grace.

14.49.s:
ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitāḥ ..
saṃprāpte kārttike māsi kṛttikāyogasaṃyute .. 9 ..
14.49.d:
येऽत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यंति पौर्णमास्यां समाहिताः ..
संप्राप्ते कार्त्तिके मासि कृत्तिकायोगसंयुते .. 9 ..
14.49.m: Those who, being concentrated in mind, perform an ancestral rite here on the full moon day / when the month of Kārttika arrives in conjunction with the Kṛttikā constellation,

14.49.s:
pitṛmedhaphalaṃ teṣāmaśeṣaṃ ca bhaviṣyati ..
tathā śatrukṣayo rājanvāsaḥ svargeṣu cākṣayaḥ .. 7.3.49.10 ..
14.49.d:
पितृमेधफलं तेषामशेषं च भविष्यति ..
तथा शत्रुक्षयो राजन्वासः स्वर्गेषु चाक्षयः .. 7.3.49.10 ..
14.49.m: will receive the complete fruit of an ancestral sacrifice, / as well as the destruction of enemies, O king, and imperishable residence in the heavens.”

14.49.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā mahādevastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ..
rāmo'pyasūdayatkṣatraṃ pitṛduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ .. 11 ..
14.49.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवस्ततश्चादर्शनं गतः ..
रामोऽप्यसूदयत्क्षत्रं पितृदुःखेन दुःखितः .. 11 ..
14.49.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, Mahādeva then vanished from sight. / Rāma, too, pained by grief for his father, slaughtered the kṣatriyas.

14.49.s:
triḥsapta tarpayāmāsa pitṝṃstatra praharṣitaḥ ..
jamadagnau mṛte tena pratijñātaṃ mahātmanā .. 12 ..
14.49.d:
त्रिःसप्त तर्पयामास पितॄंस्तत्र प्रहर्षितः ..
जमदग्नौ मृते तेन प्रतिज्ञातं महात्मना .. 12 ..
14.49.m: Extremely delighted, he offered libations to his ancestors twenty-one times there. / When Jamadagni died, that great-souled one made a vow,

14.49.s:
dṛṣṭvā mātuḥ kṣatānyaṃge triḥsapta manujādhipa ..
śastrajātāni viprāṇāṃ samāje samupasthite .. 13 ..
14.49.d:
दृष्ट्वा मातुः क्षतान्यंगे त्रिःसप्त मनुजाधिप ..
शस्त्रजातानि विप्राणां समाजे समुपस्थिते .. 13 ..
14.49.m: having seen, O ruler of men, twenty-one wounds on his mother's body, / inflicted by weapons, when an assembly of brahmins had gathered:

14.49.s:
pitā me nihato yasmātkṣatriyaistāpaso dvijaḥ ..
ayudhyamāna evātha tasmātkṛtvā trisapta vai .. 14 ..
14.49.d:
पिता मे निहतो यस्मात्क्षत्रियैस्तापसो द्विजः ..
अयुध्यमान एवाथ तस्मात्कृत्वा त्रिसप्त वै .. 14 ..
14.49.m: “Since my father, an ascetic twice-born, was slain by kṣatriyas / even as he was not fighting, therefore, having made

14.49.s:
kṣattrahīnāmahaṃ pṛthvīṃ pradāsye salilaṃ pituḥ ..
tatsarvaṃ tasya saṃjātaṃ tīrthamāhātmyato nṛpa .. 15 ..
14.49.d:
क्षत्त्रहीनामहं पृथ्वीं प्रदास्ये सलिलं पितुः ..
तत्सर्वं तस्य संजातं तीर्थमाहात्म्यतो नृप .. 15 ..
14.49.m: the earth devoid of kṣatriyas twenty-one times, I will offer water to my father.” / All that came to pass for him, O king, by the power of the sacred ford.

14.49.s:
tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret ..
kṣatriyaśca viśeṣeṇa ya icchecchatrusaṃkṣayam .. 16 ..
14.49.d:
तस्मात्सर्वं प्रयत्नेन श्राद्धं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
क्षत्रियश्च विशेषेण य इच्छेच्छत्रुसंक्षयम् .. 16 ..
14.49.m: Therefore, one should perform an ancestral rite there with every effort, / especially a kṣatriya who desires the destruction of enemies.

14.49.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe rāmatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 49 ..
14.49.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे रामतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनपंचाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 49 ..
14.49.m: Thus ends the forty-ninth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of the Rāmatīrtha,’ in the Arbudakhaṇḍa, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.50.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
koṭitīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapātakanāśanam ..
tīrthānāṃ yatra saṃjātā koṭiḥ pārthiva helayā ..1..
14.50.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
कोटितीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
तीर्थानां यत्र संजाता कोटिः पार्थिव हेलया ..1..
14.50.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Koṭitīrtha, which destroys all sins, / where ten million sacred fords gathered with ease, O king.

14.50.s:
yadā syātkalikālastu raudro rājanmahītale ..
mlecchabhūtā janāḥ sarve tatsparśāttīrthaviplavaḥ .. 2 ..
14.50.d:
यदा स्यात्कलिकालस्तु रौद्रो राजन्महीतले ..
म्लेच्छभूता जनाः सर्वे तत्स्पर्शात्तीर्थविप्लवः .. 2 ..
14.50.m: When the terrible Kali age falls upon the surface of the earth, O king, / all people become barbarians; from contact with them, sacred fords are polluted.

14.50.s:
tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca tīrthānāṃ bhūmivāsinām ..
teṣāṃ koṭistato'vātsītparvate'rbudasaṃjñake .. 3 ..
14.50.d:
तिस्रः कोट्योऽर्धकोटिश्च तीर्थानां भूमिवासिनाम् ..
तेषां कोटिस्ततोऽवात्सीत्पर्वतेऽर्बुदसंज्ञके .. 3 ..
14.50.m: Of the thirty-five million sacred fords abiding on earth, / ten million of them then dwelt on the mountain named Arbuda,

14.50.s:
puṣkare ca tathā koṭiḥ kurukṣetre ca pārthiva ..
vārāṇasyāmardhakoṭiḥ stutā devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ ..
rājannetāni rakṣaṃti sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ .. 4 ..
14.50.d:
पुष्करे च तथा कोटिः कुरुक्षेत्रे च पार्थिव ..
वाराणस्यामर्धकोटिः स्तुता देवैः सवासवैः ..
राजन्नेतानि रक्षंति सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः .. 4 ..
14.50.m: ten million at Puṣkara, O king, and at Kurukṣetra, / and five million at Vārāṇasī, praised by the gods together with Indra. / O king, all the gods together with Indra protect them.

14.50.s:
yadā yadā bhayārttāni mlecchasparśātsamaṃtataḥ ..
sthāneṣveteṣu tiṣṭhaṃti tīrthānyukteṣu satvaram .. 5 ..
14.50.d:
यदा यदा भयार्त्तानि म्लेच्छस्पर्शात्समंततः ..
स्थानेष्वेतेषु तिष्ठंति तीर्थान्युक्तेषु सत्वरम् .. 5 ..
14.50.m: Whenever, afflicted by fear from contact with barbarians on all sides, / the sacred fords quickly abide in these aforesaid places,

14.50.s:
koṭitīrthāni trīṇyeva tatra jātāni bhūtale ..
ardha koṭisametāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca .. 6 ..
14.50.d:
कोटितीर्थानि त्रीण्येव तत्र जातानि भूतले ..
अर्ध कोटिसमेतानि सर्वपापहराणि च .. 6 ..
14.50.m: exactly three groups of ten million sacred fords, / along with five million, have emerged there on the earth, removing all sins.

14.50.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ nabhasye ca viśeṣataḥ .. 7 ..
14.50.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
कृष्णपक्षे त्रयोदश्यां नभस्ये च विशेषतः .. 7 ..
14.50.m: Therefore, one should take a ritual ablution there with every effort, / especially on the thirteenth day of the dark fortnight in the month of Nabhasya.

14.50.s:
tatra snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ japahomādikaṃ ca yat ..
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ rājaṃstatprasādādasaṃśayam .. 8 ..
14.50.d:
तत्र स्नानादिकं सर्वं जपहोमादिकं च यत् ..
सर्वं कोटिगुणं राजंस्तत्प्रसादादसंशयम् .. 8 ..
14.50.m: Whatever ritual ablution and the like, recitation and fire-offering and the like are done there, / all becomes multiplied ten millionfold, O king, by its grace, without a doubt.

14.50.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe koṭitīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 50 ..
14.50.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे कोटितीर्थप्रभाववर्णनंनाम पंचाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 50 ..
14.50.m: Thus ends the fiftieth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Power of Koṭitīrtha,’ in the Arbudakhaṇḍa, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.51.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha caṃdrodbhedamanuttamam ..
tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ niśānāthena nirmitam .. 1 ..
14.51.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ चंद्रोद्भेदमनुत्तमम् ..
तीर्थं पापहरं नृणां निशानाथेन निर्मितम् .. 1 ..
14.51.m: Pulastya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassable Candrodbheda, / a sacred ford that removes the sins of men, created by the lord of night.

14.51.s:
pratijñātaṃ yadā rājangrahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ ..
rāhuṇā kṛtavaireṇa cchinne śirasi viṣṇunā .. 2 ..
14.51.d:
प्रतिज्ञातं यदा राजन्ग्रहणे चंद्रसूर्ययोः ..
राहुणा कृतवैरेण च्छिन्ने शिरसि विष्णुना .. 2 ..
14.51.m: When, during an eclipse of the moon and sun, O king, a pledge was made / by Rāhu who bore enmity after his head had been severed by Viṣṇu,

14.51.s:
tadā bhayānvitaścandro matvā daityaṃ durāsadam..
pīyūṣabhakṣaṇodyuktaṃ tataścārbudamabhyagāt .. 3 ..
14.51.d:
तदा भयान्वितश्चन्द्रो मत्वा दैत्यं दुरासदम्..
पीयूषभक्षणोद्युक्तं ततश्चार्बुदमभ्यगात् .. 3 ..
14.51.m: then the Moon, seized with fear, considering the Daitya difficult to overcome / as he strove to devour the nectar, went to Arbuda.

14.51.s:
tatra bhittvā gireḥ śṛṃge kṛtvā vivaramuttamam..
praviṣṭastasya madhye tu tapastepe suduścaram.. 4 ..
14.51.d:
तत्र भित्त्वा गिरेः शृंगे कृत्वा विवरमुत्तमम्..
प्रविष्टस्तस्य मध्ये तु तपस्तेपे सुदुश्चरम्.. 4 ..
14.51.m: Having cleft the peak of the mountain there and made an excellent cavern, / he entered its interior and performed very arduous austerity.

14.51.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ ..
abravīdvṛṇu bhadraṃ te varaṃ yatte hṛdisthitam .. 5 ..
14.51.d:
ततः कालेन महता तुष्टस्तस्य महेश्वरः ..
अब्रवीद्वृणु भद्रं ते वरं यत्ते हृदिस्थितम् .. 5 ..
14.51.m: Then, after a long time, Maheśvara was pleased with him / and said: “Choose a boon that is in your heart, may good fortune be yours!”

14.51.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca .. ..
pratijñātaṃ suraśreṣṭha rāhuṇā grahaṇaṃ mama ..
balavāneṣa durdharṣaḥ prakṛtyā siṃhikāsutaḥ .. 6 ..
14.51.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच .. ..
प्रतिज्ञातं सुरश्रेष्ठ राहुणा ग्रहणं मम ..
बलवानेष दुर्धर्षः प्रकृत्या सिंहिकासुतः .. 6 ..
14.51.m:
The Moon said:
It was sworn by Rāhu, O best of the gods, that I would be seized.
He is mighty, difficult to assault, the son of Siṃhikā by nature.

14.51.s:
sāṃprataṃ bhakṣitaṃ tena pīyūṣaṃ surasattama ..
ahaṃ madhye dhṛtaścāpi rāhuṇā'sau durāsadaḥ .. 7 ..
14.51.d:
सांप्रतं भक्षितं तेन पीयूषं सुरसत्तम ..
अहं मध्ये धृतश्चापि राहुणाऽसौ दुरासदः .. 7 ..
14.51.m:
Just now the nectar was consumed by him, O best of the gods,
and I was held in the midst by Rāhu; he is unapproachable.

14.51.s:
pīyamāne'mṛte deva devaiḥ pūrvaṃ parājitaiḥ ..
daivataṃ rūpamāsthāya dānavo'sau samāgataḥ .. 8 ..
14.51.d:
पीयमानेऽमृते देव देवैः पूर्वं पराजितैः ..
दैवतं रूपमास्थाय दानवोऽसौ समागतः .. 8 ..
14.51.m:
O god, while the nectar was being drunk formerly by the defeated gods,
that Dānava arrived having assumed a divine form.

14.51.s:
apibaccāmṛtaṃ rāhustenāsya mṛtyuvarjitam ..
amṛtaṃ cākṣayaṃ jātaṃ śiro devabhayapradam .. 9 ..
14.51.d:
अपिबच्चामृतं राहुस्तेनास्य मृत्युवर्जितम् ..
अमृतं चाक्षयं जातं शिरो देवभयप्रदम् .. 9 ..
14.51.m:
And Rāhu drank the nectar; therefore, free from death,
his head became imperishable through the nectar, bringing terror to the gods.

14.51.s:
tato devaiḥ kṛtaṃ sāma grahamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ ..
pratijñāte grahe'smākaṃ tato me bhayamāviśat .. 7.3.51.10 ..
14.51.d:
ततो देवैः कृतं साम ग्रहमध्ये प्रतिष्ठितः ..
प्रतिज्ञाते ग्रहेऽस्माकं ततो मे भयमाविशत् .. 7.3.51.10 ..
14.51.m:
Then conciliation was made by the gods, and he was established among the planets.
When our seizure was promised, then fear entered me.

14.51.s:
bhayāttasya suraśreṣṭha bhittvā śṛṃgaṃ gireridam ..
kṛtaṃ śvabhramagādhaṃ ca tapo'rthaṃ surasattama ..
tasmādatra prasādaṃ me kuru kāmaniṣūdana .. 11 ..
14.51.d:
भयात्तस्य सुरश्रेष्ठ भित्त्वा शृंगं गिरेरिदम् ..
कृतं श्वभ्रमगाधं च तपोऽर्थं सुरसत्तम ..
तस्मादत्र प्रसादं मे कुरु कामनिषूदन .. 11 ..
14.51.m:
Out of fear of him, O best of gods, breaking this peak of the mountain,
an unfathomable cleft was made for the sake of austerity, O best of gods.
Therefore show me your favour here, O destroyer of desire!

14.51.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāmajeyaḥ sa mahābalaḥ ..
kariṣyati grahaṃ nūnaṃ rāhuḥ kopaparāyaṇaḥ ..
paraṃ tava niśānātha kariṣye'haṃ pratikriyām .. 12 ..
14.51.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
अवध्यः सर्वदेवानामजेयः स महाबलः ..
करिष्यति ग्रहं नूनं राहुः कोपपरायणः ..
परं तव निशानाथ करिष्येऽहं प्रतिक्रियाम् .. 12 ..
14.51.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
He cannot be killed by any of the gods; he is invincible, exceedingly mighty.
Rāhu, intent on wrath, will indeed carry out the seizure;
nevertheless, O lord of the night, I shall provide a remedy for you.

14.51.s:
grahaṇe tava saṃprāpte snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
kariṣyaṃti janā loke samyakchreyaḥsamanvitāḥ .. 13 ..
14.51.d:
ग्रहणे तव संप्राप्ते स्नानदानादिकाः क्रियाः ..
करिष्यंति जना लोके सम्यक्छ्रेयःसमन्विताः .. 13 ..
14.51.m:
When your eclipse arrives, rites such as ritual ablution and gifts
will be performed by people in the world, accompanied by proper welfare.

14.51.s:
tābhistava na saṃtāpaḥ svalpo'pyevaṃ bhaviṣyati ..
akṣayaṃ sukṛtaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtaṃ karma bhaviṣyati .. 14 ..
14.51.d:
ताभिस्तव न संतापः स्वल्पोऽप्येवं भविष्यति ..
अक्षयं सुकृतं तेषां कृतं कर्म भविष्यति .. 14 ..
14.51.m:
By those [rites] there will not be even the slightest torment for you in this way;
the deed performed by them shall become imperishable merit.

14.51.s:
grahaṇe tava saṃjāte mama vākyādasaṃśayam ..
etadbhinnaṃ tvayā yasmāttapo'rthaṃ śikharaṃ gireḥ ..
candrodbhedamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ loke bhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
14.51.d:
ग्रहणे तव संजाते मम वाक्यादसंशयम् ..
एतद्भिन्नं त्वया यस्मात्तपोऽर्थं शिखरं गिरेः ..
चन्द्रोद्भेदमिति ख्यातं तीर्थं लोके भविष्यति .. 15 ..
14.51.m:
When your eclipse has occurred, through my word there is no doubt.
Since this peak of the mountain was cleaved by you for the sake of austerity,
it shall become a sacred ford known in the world as Candrodbheda.

14.51.s:
grahaṇe tava saṃprāpte yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
na tasya punarevātra janma loke bhaviṣyati ..16..
14.51.d:
ग्रहणे तव संप्राप्ते योऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यति ..
न तस्य पुनरेवात्र जन्म लोके भविष्यति ..16..
14.51.m:
Whoever will perform a ritual ablution here when your eclipse arrives,
for him there will never again be rebirth in this world.

14.51.s:
yo vā somadine snānaṃ darśanaṃ tatra cācaret ..
tava loke dhruvaṃ vāsastasya caṃdra bhaviṣyati .. 17 ..
14.51.d:
यो वा सोमदिने स्नानं दर्शनं तत्र चाचरेत् ..
तव लोके ध्रुवं वासस्तस्य चंद्र भविष्यति .. 17 ..
14.51.m:
Or whoever performs a ritual ablution and darśana there on a Monday,
his dwelling shall certainly be in your world, O Moon.

14.51.s:
evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścāṃtardadhe haraḥ..
candro'pi prayayau hṛṣṭaḥ svasthānaṃ nṛpasattama .. 18 ..
14.51.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स भगवांस्ततश्चांतर्दधे हरः..
चन्द्रोऽपि प्रययौ हृष्टः स्वस्थानं नृपसत्तम .. 18 ..
14.51.m:
Having spoken thus, that Blessed Lord Hara then vanished.
The Moon too departed, delighted, to his own abode, O best of kings.

14.51.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe candrodbhedatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 51 ..
14.51.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे चन्द्रोद्भेदतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकपंचाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. .. 51 ..
14.51.m: Thus ends the fifty-first chapter, entitled 'Description of the Māhātmya of the Candrodbheda Sacred Ford', in the third Arbuda section of the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.52.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha īśānīśikharaṃ mahat ..
yatra gauryā tapastaptaṃ supuṇyaṃ lokaviśrutam .. 1 ..
14.52.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ ईशानीशिखरं महत् ..
यत्र गौर्या तपस्तप्तं सुपुण्यं लोकविश्रुतम् .. 1 ..
14.52.m:
Pulastya said:
Then, O best of kings, one should go to the great peak of Īśānī,
where holy austerity, renowned in the world, was performed by Gaurī,

14.52.s:
yasya saṃdarśanenāpi naraḥ pāpātpramucyate ..
labhate cātisaubhāgyaṃ saptajanmāṃtarāṇi ca .. 2 ..
14.52.d:
यस्य संदर्शनेनापि नरः पापात्प्रमुच्यते ..
लभते चातिसौभाग्यं सप्तजन्मांतराणि च .. 2 ..
14.52.m:
by the mere vision of which a person is freed from sin
and obtains great good fortune for seven successive births.

14.52.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
kasminkāle tapastaptaṃ devyā tatra munīśvara ..
kimarthaṃ ca mahattvetatkautukaṃ vaktumarhasi .. 3 ..
14.52.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्काले तपस्तप्तं देव्या तत्र मुनीश्वर ..
किमर्थं च महत्त्वेतत्कौतुकं वक्तुमर्हसि .. 3 ..
14.52.m:
Yayāti said:
At what time was austerity performed there by the goddess, O lord of sages,
and for what purpose? You ought to tell this great marvel.

14.52.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu rājankathāṃ divyāmadbhutāṃ lokaviśrutām ..
yasyāḥ saṃśravaṇādeva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ .. 4 ..
14.52.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
शृणु राजन्कथां दिव्यामद्भुतां लोकविश्रुताम् ..
यस्याः संश्रवणादेव मुच्यते सर्वपातकैः .. 4 ..
14.52.m:
Pulastya said:
Listen, O king, to the divine, wondrous story renowned in the world,
from the mere hearing of which one is freed from all sins.

14.52.s:
purā gauryā samāsaktaṃ jñātvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
maṃtraṃ cakrurbhayāviṣṭā ekāṃte samupāśritāḥ .. 9 ..
vīryaṃ yadi trinetrasya kṣetre gauryāḥ patiṣyati ..
asmākaṃ patanaṃ nūnaṃ jagataśca bhaviṣyati .. 6 ..
saṃtatestu vināśāya tato gacchāmahe vayam.. 7 ..
evaṃ saṃmaṃtrya devāste kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatāḥ ..
tatastu naṃdinā sarve niṣiddhāḥ samayaṃ vinā .. 8 ..
.. naṃdyuvāca .. ..
ekāṃte bhagavānrudraḥ sahagauryā vyavasthitaḥ ..
tasmāddevagaṇāḥ sarve gacchadhvaṃ nilayaṃ svakam .. 9 ..
14.52.d:
पुरा गौर्या समासक्तं ज्ञात्वा देवाः सवासवाः ..
मंत्रं चक्रुर्भयाविष्टा एकांते समुपाश्रिताः .. 9 ..
वीर्यं यदि त्रिनेत्रस्य क्षेत्रे गौर्याः पतिष्यति ..
अस्माकं पतनं नूनं जगतश्च भविष्यति .. 6 ..
संततेस्तु विनाशाय ततो गच्छामहे वयम्.. 7 ..
एवं संमंत्र्य देवास्ते कैलासं पर्वतं गताः ..
ततस्तु नंदिना सर्वे निषिद्धाः समयं विना .. 8 ..
.. नंद्युवाच .. ..
एकांते भगवान्रुद्रः सहगौर्या व्यवस्थितः ..
तस्माद्देवगणाः सर्वे गच्छध्वं निलयं स्वकम् .. 9 ..
14.52.m:
Formerly, learning that [Śiva] was deeply attached to Gaurī, the gods along with Indra,
overcome with fear, held counsel, gathered together in a secluded place:
'If the semen of the three-eyed god falls into the womb of Gaurī,
the downfall of us and of the world will surely take place.
Therefore we shall go to bring about the destruction of his offspring.'
Having thus deliberated, those gods went to Mount Kailāsa;
there, however, they were all stopped by Nandin, since it was unseasonable.
Nandin said:
The Blessed Lord Rudra is staying in seclusion with Gaurī;
therefore, O hosts of gods, go all to your own abodes.

14.52.s:
atha devagaṇāḥ sarve vañcayitvā ca taṃ gaṇam..
praiṣayaṃstatra vāyuṃ ca guptamūcurvacastvidam.. 7.3.52.10 ..
14.52.d:
अथ देवगणाः सर्वे वञ्चयित्वा च तं गणम्..
प्रैषयंस्तत्र वायुं च गुप्तमूचुर्वचस्त्विदम्.. 7.3.52.10 ..
14.52.m:
Then all the hosts of gods, having deceived that attendant,
sent Vāyu there and spoke these words in secret:

14.52.s:
gatvā vāyo bhavaṃ brūhi na kāryā saṃtatistvayā ..
evaṃ devagaṇā deva prārthayaṃti bhayāturāḥ .. 11 ..
14.52.d:
गत्वा वायो भवं ब्रूहि न कार्या संततिस्त्वया ..
एवं देवगणा देव प्रार्थयंति भयातुराः .. 11 ..
14.52.m:
'Having gone, O Vāyu, tell Bhava: "No offspring should be produced by you."
Thus the hosts of gods, distressed with fear, pray, O god.'

14.52.s:
tato vāyurdrutaṃ gatvā sthito yatra maheśvaraḥ ..
uccairjagāda tadvākyaṃ yaduktaṃ tridaśālayaiḥ .. 12 ..
14.52.d:
ततो वायुर्द्रुतं गत्वा स्थितो यत्र महेश्वरः ..
उच्चैर्जगाद तद्वाक्यं यदुक्तं त्रिदशालयैः .. 12 ..
14.52.m:
Then Vāyu, having gone swiftly to where Maheśvara was staying,
spoke aloud that message which had been spoken by the gods.

14.52.s:
tatastu bhagavāñcharvo vrīḍayā parayā yutaḥ ..
gaurīṃ tyaktvā samuttasthau bāḍhamityeva cābravīt .. 13 ..
14.52.d:
ततस्तु भगवाञ्छर्वो व्रीडया परया युतः ..
गौरीं त्यक्त्वा समुत्तस्थौ बाढमित्येव चाब्रवीत् .. 13 ..
14.52.m:
Thereupon the Blessed Lord Śarva, filled with utmost shame,
let go of Gaurī, stood up, and said, 'So be it!'
Then Gaurī, greatly afflicted with sorrow, cursed the gods.

14.52.s:
.. gauryuvāca .. ..
yasmādahaṃ kṛtā devaiḥ putrahīnā samāgataiḥ ..
tasmātte'pi bhaviṣyanti santānena vivarjjitāḥ .. 15 ..
14.52.d:
.. गौर्युवाच .. ..
यस्मादहं कृता देवैः पुत्रहीना समागतैः ..
तस्मात्तेऽपि भविष्यन्ति सन्तानेन विवर्ज्जिताः .. 15 ..
14.52.m:
Gaurī said:
Because I have been rendered sonless by the assembled gods,
therefore they too shall be devoid of progeny.

14.52.s:
yasmādvāyo samāyātaḥ sthāne'smiñjanavarjite ..
tasmātkāyavinirmuktastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi sarvadā .. 16 ..
14.52.d:
यस्माद्वायो समायातः स्थानेऽस्मिञ्जनवर्जिते ..
तस्मात्कायविनिर्मुक्तस्त्वं भविष्यसि सर्वदा .. 16 ..
14.52.m:
Because you, O Vāyu, came into this place devoid of people,
therefore you shall forever be bodiless.

14.52.s:
evamuktvā tato dīrghaṃ bhartuḥ kopaparāyaṇā ..
tyaktvā pārśvaṃ gatā rājannarbudaṃ nagasattamam.. 17 ..
14.52.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो दीर्घं भर्तुः कोपपरायणा ..
त्यक्त्वा पार्श्वं गता राजन्नर्बुदं नगसत्तमम्.. 17 ..
14.52.m:
Having spoken thus, then deeply intent on anger at her husband,
she left his presence and went, O king, to Arbuda, the best of mountains.

14.52.s:
sutārthaṃ sā tapastepe yatavākkāyamānasā ..
tato varṣasahasrānte devadevo maheśvaraḥ ..918 ..
indrādyairvibudhaiḥ sārddhaṃ tadaṃtikamupāgamat..
atha śakro vinītātmā devīṃ tā pratyabhāṣata .. 19 ..
eṣa devaḥ śivaḥ prāptastava pārśvaṃ svalajjayā ..
nāyāti tatprasādo'sya kriyatā mahatī bhava .. 7.3.52.20 ..
.. devyuvāca .. ..
tyaktā'haṃ tava vākyena patinā samayānvitā ..
putraṃ labdhvā prayāsyāmi tasya pārśve sureśvara .. 21 ..
tasyāstaṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā svayaṃ devaḥ samāyayau ..
abravītprahasanvākyaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti .. 22..
dṛṣṭidānena deveśi bhāṣaṇena varānane ..
mayā devahitaṃ kāryaṃ sarvāvasthāsu pārvati .. 23 ..
akāle tena muktā'si nivṛttiḥ surate kṛtā ..
putrārthaṃ te samāraṃbho yataścāsītsureśvari .. 24 ..
14.52.d:
सुतार्थं सा तपस्तेपे यतवाक्कायमानसा ..
ततो वर्षसहस्रान्ते देवदेवो महेश्वरः ..918 ..
इन्द्राद्यैर्विबुधैः सार्द्धं तदंतिकमुपागमत्..
अथ शक्रो विनीतात्मा देवीं ता प्रत्यभाषत .. 19 ..
एष देवः शिवः प्राप्तस्तव पार्श्वं स्वलज्जया ..
नायाति तत्प्रसादोऽस्य क्रियता महती भव .. 7.3.52.20 ..
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
त्यक्ताऽहं तव वाक्येन पतिना समयान्विता ..
पुत्रं लब्ध्वा प्रयास्यामि तस्य पार्श्वे सुरेश्वर .. 21 ..
तस्यास्तं निश्चयं ज्ञात्वा स्वयं देवः समाययौ ..
अब्रवीत्प्रहसन्वाक्यं प्रसादः क्रियतामिति .. 22..
दृष्टिदानेन देवेशि भाषणेन वरानने ..
मया देवहितं कार्यं सर्वावस्थासु पार्वति .. 23 ..
अकाले तेन मुक्ताऽसि निवृत्तिः सुरते कृता ..
पुत्रार्थं ते समारंभो यतश्चासीत्सुरेश्वरि .. 24 ..
14.52.m:
Restraining her speech, body, and mind, she performed austerity for the sake of a son.
Then, at the end of a thousand years, the god of gods, Maheśvara,
came into her presence along with the gods headed by Indra.
Then Śakra, humble in spirit, addressed that goddess:
'This god Śiva has come into your presence; out of his own bashfulness
he does not approach. Therefore let favour be shown to him; be magnanimous!'
The goddess said:
'At your word I was abandoned by my husband, bound by an agreed time.
Having obtained a son, I shall go to his side, O lord of the gods.'
Knowing that resolve of hers, the god himself came forward;
smiling, he spoke these words: 'Let favour be shown,
by granting a glance, O ruler of the gods, and by speaking, O fair-faced one!
The welfare of the gods must be accomplished by me in all circumstances, O Pārvatī.
At an improper time you were therefore released, and an end was made to lovemaking;
and since your undertaking was for the sake of a son, O ruler of the gods,

14.52.s:
tasmātte bhavitā putro nijadehasamudbhavaḥ ..
matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ caturthe divase priye .. 25 ..
nijāṃgamalamādāya yādṛgrūpaṃ sureśvari ..
kariṣyasi na sandehastādṛgeva bhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
sadyo devagaṇānāṃ ca daityānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ ..
tathā vai sarvamarttyānāṃ siddhido bahurūpadhṛk .. 27 ..
evamuktā trinetreṇa parituṣṭā sureśvarī ..
ālāpaṃ patinā cakre sārddhaṃ harṣasamanvitā .. 28 ..
caturthe divase prāpte tataḥ snātvā śivā nṛpa ..
tadodvarttanajaṃ lepaṃ gṛhītvā kautukātkila ..
caturbhujaṃ cakārā'tha haravākyādvināyakam .. 29 ..
tataḥ sajīvatāṃ prāpya haravākyena taṃ tadā ..
viśeṣeṇa mahārāja nāyako'sau kṛtaḥ kṣitau ..
sarveṣāṃ caiva martyānāṃ tataḥ khyāto babhūva ha .. 7.3.52.30 ..
vināyaka iti śrīmānpūjyastrailokyavāsinām ..
sarveṣāṃ devamukhyānāṃ babhūva hi vināyakaḥ .. 31 ..
14.52.d:
तस्मात्ते भविता पुत्रो निजदेहसमुद्भवः ..
मत्प्रसादादसंदिग्धं चतुर्थे दिवसे प्रिये .. 25 ..
निजांगमलमादाय यादृग्रूपं सुरेश्वरि ..
करिष्यसि न सन्देहस्तादृगेव भविष्यति .. 26 ..
सद्यो देवगणानां च दैत्यानां च विशेषतः ..
तथा वै सर्वमर्त्त्यानां सिद्धिदो बहुरूपधृक् .. 27 ..
एवमुक्ता त्रिनेत्रेण परितुष्टा सुरेश्वरी ..
आलापं पतिना चक्रे सार्द्धं हर्षसमन्विता .. 28 ..
चतुर्थे दिवसे प्राप्ते ततः स्नात्वा शिवा नृप ..
तदोद्वर्त्तनजं लेपं गृहीत्वा कौतुकात्किल ..
चतुर्भुजं चकाराऽथ हरवाक्याद्विनायकम् .. 29 ..
ततः सजीवतां प्राप्य हरवाक्येन तं तदा ..
विशेषेण महाराज नायकोऽसौ कृतः क्षितौ ..
सर्वेषां चैव मर्त्यानां ततः ख्यातो बभूव ह .. 7.3.52.30 ..
विनायक इति श्रीमान्पूज्यस्त्रैलोक्यवासिनाम् ..
सर्वेषां देवमुख्यानां बभूव हि विनायकः .. 31 ..
14.52.m:
therefore a son born from your own body shall come to be for you
by my grace, without doubt, on the fourth day, my dear.
Taking the dirt from your own limbs, whatever form you make, O ruler of the gods,
of such a form he shall surely become, without doubt.
Instantly he shall be a bestower of success to the hosts of gods and especially to the Daityas,
as well as to all mortals, assuming many forms.'
Addressed thus by the Three-Eyed [Śiva], the queen of gods was fully satisfied; / filled with joy, she conversed with her husband.
When the fourth day arrived, O king, Śivā bathed, / and taking the paste from her cleansing rub out of curiosity, / made a four-armed Vināyaka in accordance with Hara's words.
Then, having attained life by the word of Hara, / that one was especially made a leader on earth, O great king, / and over all mortals, and so he became renowned
as the glorious Vināyaka, worthy of worship by the dwellers of the three worlds. / He became Vināyaka indeed among all the foremost of the gods.

14.52.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve devīpriyahite ratāḥ ..
tasmai dadurvarāndivyānprocurdevīṃ ca pārthiva .. 32 .. ..
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
tavāyaṃ tanayo devi sarveṣāṃ naḥ puraḥsaraḥ ..
prathamaṃ pūjite cāsminpūjā grāhyā tataḥ suraiḥ .. 33 ..
etacchṛṃgaṃ gire ramyaṃ tava saṃsevanācchubhe ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ darśanācca bhaviṣyati .. 34 ..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyanti supuṇye salilāśraye ..
te yāṃsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 35 ..
māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ ye samāhitāḥ ..
saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva bhaviṣyanti sukhānvitāḥ .. 36 ..
evamuktvā surāḥ sarve svasthānaṃ tu tato gatāḥ ..
devo'pi sahito devyā kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ .. 37 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍa īśānīśikharamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 52 ..
14.52.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे देवीप्रियहिते रताः ..
तस्मै ददुर्वरान्दिव्यान्प्रोचुर्देवीं च पार्थिव .. 32 .. ..
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
तवायं तनयो देवि सर्वेषां नः पुरःसरः ..
प्रथमं पूजिते चास्मिन्पूजा ग्राह्या ततः सुरैः .. 33 ..
एतच्छृंगं गिरे रम्यं तव संसेवनाच्छुभे ..
सर्वपापहरं नृणां दर्शनाच्च भविष्यति .. 34 ..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यन्ति सुपुण्ये सलिलाश्रये ..
ते यांस्यंति परं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 35 ..
माघमासे तृतीयायां शुक्लायां ये समाहिताः ..
सप्तजन्मांतराण्येव भविष्यन्ति सुखान्विताः .. 36 ..
एवमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे स्वस्थानं तु ततो गताः ..
देवोऽपि सहितो देव्या कैलासं पर्वतं गतः .. 37 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्ड ईशानीशिखरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 52 ..
14.52.m:
Then all the hosts of gods, devoted to what was dear and beneficial to the Goddess, / granted him divine boons, O ruler of the earth, and said to the Goddess:
The gods said: / 'O Goddess, this son of yours shall go before us all. / Only when he is worshipped first shall worship be accepted by the gods.
O auspicious one, through attendance upon you, this delightful peak of the mountain / will remove all sins of men even through its darśana.
Those who perform a ritual ablution here in this most holy reservoir of water / shall go to the supreme abode, free from old age and death.
Those who are focused in mind on the third day of the bright fortnight of the month of Māgha / will remain filled with happiness for seven future births.'
Having spoken thus, all the gods went to their respective abodes. / The god [Śiva] also went to Mount Kailāsa together with the Goddess.
Thus ends the fifty-second chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Peak of Īśānī', in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [division] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.53.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchedbrahmapadaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
yatra pūrvaṃ padaṃ nyastaṃ brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā .. 1 ..
14.53.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेद्ब्रह्मपदं तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
यत्र पूर्वं पदं न्यस्तं ब्रह्मणा लोककारिणा .. 1 ..
14.53.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Brahmapada, the sacred ford famous in the three worlds, / where the creator of the worlds, Brahmā, previously set his foot.

14.53.s:
purā brahmādayo devāstatra sarve samāhitāḥ ..
arbude parvate ramya ṛṣayaśca sunirmalāḥ .. 2 ..
14.53.d:
पुरा ब्रह्मादयो देवास्तत्र सर्वे समाहिताः ..
अर्बुदे पर्वते रम्य ऋषयश्च सुनिर्मलाः .. 2 ..
14.53.m: Formerly, Brahmā and the other gods, all concentrated in mind, / and the completely pure seers, were there on the delightful mountain Arbuda,

14.53.s:
acaleśvarayātrāyāṃ subhaktyā bhāvitā nṛpa ..
atha te munayaḥ sarve procurdevaṃ pitāmaham .. 3 ..
14.53.d:
अचलेश्वरयात्रायां सुभक्त्या भाविता नृप ..
अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे प्रोचुर्देवं पितामहम् .. 3 ..
14.53.m: filled with deep devotion during the pilgrimage to Acaleśvara, O king. / Then all those sages said to the god Pitāmaha [Brahmā]:

14.53.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
prabhūtaniyamairhomairvratasnānaiśca nityaśaḥ ..
upavāsaiśca nirviṇṇā vayaṃ sarve pitāmaha .. 4 ..
14.53.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
प्रभूतनियमैर्होमैर्व्रतस्नानैश्च नित्यशः ..
उपवासैश्च निर्विण्णा वयं सर्वे पितामह .. 4 ..
14.53.m: The seers said: / 'We are all utterly weary, O Grandfather, / with numerous observances, burnt offerings, vows, ritual ablutions daily, and fasts.

14.53.s:
tasmātsadupadeśaṃ tvaṃ kiṃciddātumihārhasi ..
tarāmo yena deveśa durgaṃ saṃsārasāgaram .. 5 ..
14.53.d:
तस्मात्सदुपदेशं त्वं किंचिद्दातुमिहार्हसि ..
तरामो येन देवेश दुर्गं संसारसागरम् .. 5 ..
14.53.m: Therefore you ought to give some good instruction here, / by which, O Lord of gods, we may cross the impassable ocean of saṃsāra.

14.53.s:
ayācitopacāraiśca japahomaiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ ..
mantrairvrataistathā dānaiḥ svargaprāptiṃ vadasva naḥ .. 6 ..
14.53.d:
अयाचितोपचारैश्च जपहोमैः सुदुष्करैः ..
मन्त्रैर्व्रतैस्तथा दानैः स्वर्गप्राप्तिं वदस्व नः .. 6 ..
14.53.m: Tell us how to attain heaven through easily obtained offerings, / without difficult muttered prayers, burnt offerings, mantras, vows, and gifts.'

14.53.s:
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tadā devaḥ kṛpānvitaḥ ..
ciṃtayāmāsa suciramiha kiṃcitprahasya ca ..7..
14.53.d:
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा तदा देवः कृपान्वितः ..
चिंतयामास सुचिरमिह किंचित्प्रहस्य च ..7..
14.53.m: Hearing those words of theirs, the god, filled with compassion, / pondered for a long time here, and smiling slightly,

14.53.s:
tataḥ svakaṃ padaṃ tyaktvā ramye parvatarodhasi ..
athovāca munīnsarvānbrahmā saṃślakṣṇayā girā .. 8 ..
14.53.d:
ततः स्वकं पदं त्यक्त्वा रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि ..
अथोवाच मुनीन्सर्वान्ब्रह्मा संश्लक्ष्णया गिरा .. 8 ..
14.53.m: then left his own footprint on the pleasant mountain slope, / and Brahmā said to all the sages in a very gentle voice:

14.53.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
etanmahāpadaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ..
spṛśaṃtu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tato yāsyatha sadgatim .. ..9..
14.53.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
एतन्महापदं रम्यं सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
स्पृशंतु ऋषयः सर्वे ततो यास्यथ सद्गतिम् .. ..9..
14.53.m: Brahmā said: / 'Let all the seers touch this great, beautiful footprint / that destroys all sins; then you will go to the good destination.

14.53.s:
vinā snānena dānena vratahomajapādibhiḥ..
hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ mayā nyastaṃ padaṃ śubham..7.3.53.10..
14.53.d:
विना स्नानेन दानेन व्रतहोमजपादिभिः..
हितार्थं सर्वलोकानां मया न्यस्तं पदं शुभम्..7.3.53.10..
14.53.m: Without ritual ablution, gifting, vows, burnt offerings, muttered prayers, and the like, / this auspicious footprint was placed by me for the benefit of all worlds.

14.53.s:
asminpade mayā nyaste yāṃti lokāḥ sahasraśaḥ..
spṛśaṃtu ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāścāpi padaṃ mama .. 11 ..
14.53.d:
अस्मिन्पदे मया न्यस्ते यांति लोकाः सहस्रशः..
स्पृशंतु ऋषयः सर्वे देवाश्चापि पदं मम .. 11 ..
14.53.m: Since this footprint was placed by me, people go [to heaven] by thousands. / Let all the seers, and the gods as well, touch my footprint.

14.53.s:
ekaivātra prakarttavyā śraddhā vā'vyabhicāriṇī ..
yaśca śraddhānvitaḥ samyakpadametanmunīśvarāḥ .. 12 ..
14.53.d:
एकैवात्र प्रकर्त्तव्या श्रद्धा वाऽव्यभिचारिणी ..
यश्च श्रद्धान्वितः सम्यक्पदमेतन्मुनीश्वराः .. 12 ..
14.53.m: Here, unswerving faith alone must be exercised. / And whoever, endowed with faith, properly worships this footprint, O lords of sages,

14.53.s:
pūjayiṣyati saṃprāpte kārtike pūrṇimādine ..
toyaiḥ phalaiśca vividhairgaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ .. 13 ..
14.53.d:
पूजयिष्यति संप्राप्ते कार्तिके पूर्णिमादिने ..
तोयैः फलैश्च विविधैर्गंधमाल्यानुलेपनैः .. 13 ..
14.53.m: when the full-moon day in the month of Kārttika arrives, / with waters, various fruits, perfumes, garlands, and ointments,

14.53.s:
brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu miṣṭānnena svaśaktitaḥ ..
sa yāsyati na sandeho mama lokaṃ sudurlabham .. 14 ..
14.53.d:
ब्राह्मणान्भोजयित्वा तु मिष्टान्नेन स्वशक्तितः ..
स यास्यति न सन्देहो मम लोकं सुदुर्लभम् .. 14 ..
14.53.m: and feeds brahmins with sweet foods according to his means, / he shall go, there is no doubt, to my world which is very hard to attain.'

14.53.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato munigaṇāḥ sarve samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ ..
pūjayitvā padaṃ tatra brahmalokaṃ samāgatāḥ .. 15 ..
14.53.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो मुनिगणाः सर्वे सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्विताः ..
पूजयित्वा पदं तत्र ब्रह्मलोकं समागताः .. 15 ..
14.53.m: Pulastya said: / Then all the hosts of sages, endowed with full faith, / worshipped the footprint there and reached the world of Brahmā.

14.53.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena padaṃ pūjyaṃ narottama ..
pitāmahapadaṃ samyakchraddhayā svargadāyakam.. 16 ..
14.53.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पदं पूज्यं नरोत्तम ..
पितामहपदं सम्यक्छ्रद्धया स्वर्गदायकम्.. 16 ..
14.53.m: Therefore, O best of men, with every effort the footprint must be worshipped, / the footprint of the Grandfather, which through faith truly bestows heaven.

14.53.s:
anyatkautūhalaṃ rājanmahaddṛṣṭaṃ mahādbhutam ..
padasya tasya yacchrutvā jāyate vismayo mahān .. 17 ..
14.53.d:
अन्यत्कौतूहलं राजन्महद्दृष्टं महाद्भुतम् ..
पदस्य तस्य यच्छ्रुत्वा जायते विस्मयो महान् .. 17 ..
14.53.m: Another great, marvelous wonder of that footprint is seen, O king, / hearing which great amazement arises.

14.53.s:
āyāmavistareṇā'pi prāpte kṛtayuge nṛpa ..
na saṃkhyā jāyate rājañchuklavarṇasya mānavaiḥ .. 18 ..
14.53.d:
आयामविस्तरेणाऽपि प्राप्ते कृतयुगे नृप ..
न संख्या जायते राजञ्छुक्लवर्णस्य मानवैः .. 18 ..
14.53.m: When the Kṛta age arrives, O king, / men cannot reckon its measure in length and breadth, being white in color.

14.53.s:
tatastretāyuge prāpte raktavarṇaṃ pradṛśyate ..
suvyaktaṃ saṃkhyayā yuktaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam .. 19 ..
14.53.d:
ततस्त्रेतायुगे प्राप्ते रक्तवर्णं प्रदृश्यते ..
सुव्यक्तं संख्यया युक्तं सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् .. 19 ..
14.53.m: Then, when the Tretā age arrives, it is seen as red in color, / clearly defined, having a definite measure, bowed to by all the worlds.

14.53.s:
dvāpare kapilaṃ tacca laghumātraṃ pradṛśyate ..
kalau kṛṣṇaṃ susūkṣmaṃ ca ramye parvatarodhasi .. 7.3.53.20 ..
14.53.d:
द्वापरे कपिलं तच्च लघुमात्रं प्रदृश्यते ..
कलौ कृष्णं सुसूक्ष्मं च रम्ये पर्वतरोधसि .. 7.3.53.20 ..
14.53.m: In the Dvāpara it is seen as tawny and of small measure; / and in the Kali age, it is black and extremely subtle, on the pleasant mountain slope.

14.53.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe brahmapadotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 53 .. ..
14.53.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे ब्रह्मपदोत्पत्तिमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रिपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 53 .. ..
14.53.m: Thus ends the fifty-third chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of the Origin of Brahmapada', in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [division] in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.54.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tatastripuṣkaraṃ gacchedabhīṣṭaṃ padmajasya ca ..
brahmaṇā tatsamānītaṃ parvate'rbudasaṃjñake .. 1 ..
14.54.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततस्त्रिपुष्करं गच्छेदभीष्टं पद्मजस्य च ..
ब्रह्मणा तत्समानीतं पर्वतेऽर्बुदसंज्ञके .. 1 ..
14.54.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Tripuṣkara, which is dear to the Lotus-Born [Brahmā]; / it was brought by Brahmā to the mountain named Arbuda.

14.54.s:
vasiṣṭhasya purā satre varttamāne narādhipa ..
tasminnage samāyātā brahmādyāśca surottamāḥ .. 2 ..
14.54.d:
वसिष्ठस्य पुरा सत्रे वर्त्तमाने नराधिप ..
तस्मिन्नगे समायाता ब्रह्माद्याश्च सुरोत्तमाः .. 2 ..
14.54.m: Formerly, while Vasiṣṭha's sacrificial session was underway, O ruler of men, / Brahmā and the foremost gods arrived at that mountain.

14.54.s:
pratijñātaṃ mahārāja brahmaṇā'vyaktajanmanā ..
yāvatsthāsye nṛloke'smiṃstāvatsandhyāṃ tripuṣkare ..
vaṃdayiṣyāmi saṃprāpte saṃdhyākāle samāhitaḥ .. 3 ..
14.54.d:
प्रतिज्ञातं महाराज ब्रह्मणाऽव्यक्तजन्मना ..
यावत्स्थास्ये नृलोकेऽस्मिंस्तावत्सन्ध्यां त्रिपुष्करे ..
वंदयिष्यामि संप्राप्ते संध्याकाले समाहितः .. 3 ..
14.54.m: A vow had been made, O great king, by Brahmā of unmanifest birth: / 'As long as I stay in this world of men, so long will I, composed in mind, / worship the twilight at Tripuṣkara when twilight time arrives.'

14.54.s:
etasminneva kāle tu prasthitaḥ puṣkaraṃ prati ..
saṃdhyārthaṃ padmajo yāvadvasiṣṭhastāvadabravīt .. 4 ..
14.54.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु प्रस्थितः पुष्करं प्रति ..
संध्यार्थं पद्मजो यावद्वसिष्ठस्तावदब्रवीत् .. 4 ..
14.54.m: Just at that time, as the Lotus-Born was setting out towards Puṣkara / for the twilight devotion, Vasiṣṭha said to him:

14.54.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
karmakālaśca samprāpto yajñe'sminsurasattama ..
sa vinā na tvayā deva siddhiṃ yāsyati karhicit .. 5..
14.54.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
कर्मकालश्च सम्प्राप्तो यज्ञेऽस्मिन्सुरसत्तम ..
स विना न त्वया देव सिद्धिं यास्यति कर्हिचित् .. 5..
14.54.m: Vasiṣṭha said: / 'The time for ritual actions has arrived in this sacrifice, O best of gods; / without you, O god, it will never reach completion.

14.54.s:
tasmādānaya cātraiva padmayone tripuṣkaram ..
saṃdhyopāstiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tatra bhūyaḥ sureśvara ..
brahmatvaṃ kuru deveśa satre cāsmindayānidhe .. 6 ..
14.54.d:
तस्मादानय चात्रैव पद्मयोने त्रिपुष्करम् ..
संध्योपास्तिं ततः कृत्वा तत्र भूयः सुरेश्वर ..
ब्रह्मत्वं कुरु देवेश सत्रे चास्मिन्दयानिधे .. 6 ..
14.54.m: Therefore bring Tripuṣkara right here, O Lotus-Born. / Having performed the twilight worship there again, O Lord of gods, / act as the chief priest (brahman) in this sacrificial session, O Lord of gods, O store of compassion!'

14.54.s:
evamukto vasiṣṭhena brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ ..
dhyātvā tatrānayāmāsa jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhikam ..
puṣkaratritayaṃ cāgātsupuṇye salilāśaye .. 7 ..
14.54.d:
एवमुक्तो वसिष्ठेन ब्रह्मा लोक पितामहः ..
ध्यात्वा तत्रानयामास ज्येष्ठमध्यकनिष्ठिकम् ..
पुष्करत्रितयं चागात्सुपुण्ये सलिलाशये .. 7 ..
14.54.m: Addressed thus by Vasiṣṭha, Brahmā, the grandfather of the worlds, / meditated and brought there the senior, middle, and junior ones; / and the triad of Puṣkaras entered into a most holy reservoir of water.
From that time onwards, Tripuṣkara came to be on this Arbuda.

14.54.s:
tatra yaḥ kārtike māsi paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
snānaṃ karoti dānaṃ ca tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ .. 9 ..
14.54.d:
तत्र यः कार्तिके मासि पौर्णमास्यां समाहितः ..
स्नानं करोति दानं च तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः .. 9 ..
14.54.m: Whoever, composed in mind, bathes and gives gifts there / on the full-moon day in the month of Kārtika attains eternal worlds. // 9

14.54.s:
tasya cottaradigbhāge sāvitrīkuṇḍamuttamam ..
snānadānādikaṃ kurvanyatra yāti śubhāṃ gatim .. 7.3.54.10 ..
14.54.d:
तस्य चोत्तरदिग्भागे सावित्रीकुण्डमुत्तमम् ..
स्नानदानादिकं कुर्वन्यत्र याति शुभां गतिम् .. 7.3.54.10 ..
14.54.m: To the north of it is the excellent Sāvitrīkuṇḍa, / performing bath, gift-giving, and other rites at which one attains an auspicious realm. // 7.3.54.10

14.54.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe tripuṣkaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 54 .. ..
14.54.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे त्रिपुष्करमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुष्पंचाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 54 .. ..
14.54.m: Thus ends the fifty-fourth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of Tripuṣkara", in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh book, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 54

14.55.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha puṇyaṃ rudrahradaṃ śubham ..
yatra snāto naro bhaktyā gaṇādhīśatvamāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
14.55.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ पुण्यं रुद्रह्रदं शुभम् ..
यत्र स्नातो नरो भक्त्या गणाधीशत्वमाप्नुयात् .. 1 ..
14.55.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should proceed, best of kings, to the meritorious and auspicious Rudrahrada, / bathing where with devotion a person attains the status of a lord of Gaṇas. // 1

14.55.s:
purā hatvāṃ'dhakaṃ daityaṃ sagaṇo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
tataḥ snāto hradaṃ kṛtvā tato rudrahrado'bhavat .. 2 ..
14.55.d:
पुरा हत्वांऽधकं दैत्यं सगणो वृषभध्वजः ..
ततः स्नातो ह्रदं कृत्वा ततो रुद्रह्रदोऽभवत् .. 2 ..
14.55.m: Long ago, having slain the Daitya Andhaka, he whose banner bears a bull, together with his Gaṇas, / bathed there after creating the pool; hence it became known as Rudrahrada. // 2

14.55.s:
caturddaśyāṃ mahārāja yastatra kurute naraḥ ..
snānaṃ tasya bhavetpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrthasamudbhavam .. 3 ..
14.55.d:
चतुर्द्दश्यां महाराज यस्तत्र कुरुते नरः ..
स्नानं तस्य भवेत्पुण्यं सर्वतीर्थसमुद्भवम् .. 3 ..
14.55.m: O great king, whatever person bathes there on the fourteenth day, / his merit becomes equivalent to that arising from all sacred fords. // 3

14.55.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe rudrahradamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 55 ..
14.55.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे रुद्रह्रदमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पञ्चपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. .. 55 ..
14.55.m: Thus ends the fifty-fifth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of Rudrahrada", in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh book, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 55

14.56.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha guheśvaramanuttamam ..
guhāmadhye gataṃ liṃgaṃ siddhaiḥ saṃpūjitaṃ purā .. 1 ..
14.56.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ गुहेश्वरमनुत्तमम् ..
गुहामध्ये गतं लिंगं सिद्धैः संपूजितं पुरा .. 1 ..
14.56.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, best of kings, to the unexcelled Guheśvara, / the liṅga situated inside a cave, worshipped in ancient times by the Siddhas. // 1

14.56.s:
yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya saṃpūjayati mānavaḥ ..
taṃtaṃ sa labhate rājanniṣkāmo mokṣamāpnuyāt .. 2 ..
14.56.d:
यंयं काममभिध्याय संपूजयति मानवः ..
तंतं स लभते राजन्निष्कामो मोक्षमाप्नुयात् .. 2 ..
14.56.m: Whatever desire a person meditates upon when worshipping it, / that very desire he obtains, O king; and if free from desire, he attains liberation. // 2

14.56.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe guheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ..56 ..
14.56.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे गुहेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षट्पञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः ..56 ..
14.56.m: Thus ends the fifty-sixth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of Guheśvara", in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh book, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 56

14.57.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
aviyuktavanaṃ gacchettataḥ pārthivasattama ..
yasmindṛṣṭe narobhīṣṭairna viyujyeta karhicit ..1..
14.57.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
अवियुक्तवनं गच्छेत्ततः पार्थिवसत्तम ..
यस्मिन्दृष्टे नरोभीष्टैर्न वियुज्येत कर्हिचित् ..1..
14.57.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to the Aviyuktavana, best of kings, / upon seeing which a man is never separated from his loved ones. // 1

14.57.s:
tatra pūrvaṃ śacī rājanpraviṣṭā duḥkhasaṃyutā ..
nahuṣeṇa hṛte rājye devendrasya mahātmanaḥ .. 2 ..
14.57.d:
तत्र पूर्वं शची राजन्प्रविष्टा दुःखसंयुता ..
नहुषेण हृते राज्ये देवेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः .. 2 ..
14.57.m: There formerly entered Śacī, O king, filled with grief, / when the kingdom of the great Indra, lord of the gods, was seized by Nahuṣa. // 2

14.57.s:
tatprabhāvātpunaḥ prāpto viyukto'pi śatakratuḥ ..
tatastasya varo datto vanasya hi tayā nṛpa .. 3 ..
14.57.d:
तत्प्रभावात्पुनः प्राप्तो वियुक्तोऽपि शतक्रतुः ..
ततस्तस्य वरो दत्तो वनस्य हि तया नृप .. 3 ..
14.57.m: Through its power, Śatakratu, though separated, was recovered; / therefore a boon was granted by her to that forest, O king: // 3

14.57.s:
naro vā yadi vā nārī viyuktā'tra vane śubhe ..
priyairnivāsa ekasminrātrimekāṃ vasiṣyati .. 4 ..
14.57.d:
नरो वा यदि वा नारी वियुक्ताऽत्र वने शुभे ..
प्रियैर्निवास एकस्मिन्रात्रिमेकां वसिष्यति .. 4 ..
14.57.m: ‘Whether a man or a woman, separated [from a lover], / shall stay for a single night in this auspicious forest in a dwelling with loved ones, // 4

14.57.s:
sa tena labhate saṃgaṃ bhūya eva yathā mayā ..
priyaiḥ sa labhate vāsamekarātraṃ vasannṛpa .. 5 ..
14.57.d:
स तेन लभते संगं भूय एव यथा मया ..
प्रियैः स लभते वासमेकरात्रं वसन्नृप .. 5 ..
14.57.m: he shall obtain union with that person again, just as I did; / staying for a single night, he attains residence with his loved ones, O king.’ // 5

14.57.s:
phaladānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tatra brāhmaṇasattamāḥ ..
vaṃdhyānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa yataḥ putraphalaṃ labhet .. 6 ..
14.57.d:
फलदानं प्रशंसंति तत्र ब्राह्मणसत्तमाः ..
वंध्यानां च विशेषेण यतः पुत्रफलं लभेत् .. 6 ..
14.57.m: The best among brahmins praise the giving of fruit there, / especially for barren women, because one obtains the fruit of sons. // 6

14.57.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe'viyuktakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 57 ..
14.57.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डेऽवियुक्तक्षेत्रमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 57 ..
14.57.m: Thus ends the fifty-seventh chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Aviyuktakṣetra", in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh book, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 57

14.58.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
umāmāheśvaraṃ gacchettato rājansupuṇyadam..
sthāpitaṃ bhaktiyuktena dhundhumāreṇa yatpurā .. 1 ..
14.58.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
उमामाहेश्वरं गच्छेत्ततो राजन्सुपुण्यदम्..
स्थापितं भक्तियुक्तेन धुन्धुमारेण यत्पुरा .. 1 ..
14.58.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O king, to Umāmāheśvara, which bestows great merit, / which was formerly established by the devoted Dhundhumāra. // 1

14.58.s:
dāṃpatyaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā yastatra manujādhipa ..
sapta janmāṃtarāṇyeva na sa daurbhāgyamāpnuyāta .. 2 ..
14.58.d:
दांपत्यं पूजयेद्भक्त्या यस्तत्र मनुजाधिप ..
सप्त जन्मांतराण्येव न स दौर्भाग्यमाप्नुयात .. 2 ..
14.58.m: Whoever devoutly worships the divine couple there, lord of men, / for seven future births does not suffer misfortune. // 2

14.58.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍa umāmāheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 58 ..
14.58.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्ड उमामाहेश्वरतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टपञ्चाशत्तमोऽध्यायः .. 58 ..
14.58.m: Thus ends the fifty-eighth chapter, entitled "Description of the Greatness of the Umāmāheśvara Sacred Ford", in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh book, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 58

14.59.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato mahaujasaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ pātakanāśanam ..
yasminsnāto naro rājaṃstejasā yujyate dhruvam ..
brahmahatyāgninā śakraḥ purā dainyaṃ paraṃ gataḥ .. 1 ..
14.59.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो महौजसं गच्छेत्तीर्थं पातकनाशनम् ..
यस्मिन्स्नातो नरो राजंस्तेजसा युज्यते ध्रुवम् ..
ब्रह्महत्याग्निना शक्रः पुरा दैन्यं परं गतः .. 1 ..
14.59.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to the Mahaujas sacred ford, which destroys sins, / bathing where a man is certainly endowed with splendor, O king. / Formerly, Śakra was brought to extreme distress by the fire of slaying a brahmin. // 1

14.59.s:
niḥśrīkastejasā hīno durgandhena samanvitaḥ ..
parityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvairviṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ .. 2 ..
14.59.d:
निःश्रीकस्तेजसा हीनो दुर्गन्धेन समन्वितः ..
परित्यक्तः सुरैः सर्वैर्विषादं परमं गतः .. 2 ..
14.59.m: Devoid of luster, bereft of splendor, accompanied by a foul odor, / abandoned by all the gods, he fell into supreme dejection. // 2

14.59.s:
tataḥ papraccha devendro dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim ..
bhagavaṃstejaso vṛddhiḥ kathaṃ syānme yathā purā .. 3 ..
14.59.d:
ततः पप्रच्छ देवेन्द्रो द्विजश्रेष्ठं बृहस्पतिम् ..
भगवंस्तेजसो वृद्धिः कथं स्यान्मे यथा पुरा .. 3 ..
14.59.m: Then the lord of the gods asked the foremost twice-born, Bṛhaspati: / ‘O venerable one, how might an increase in my splendor come about as before?’ // 3

14.59.s:
.. bṛhaspatiruvāca .. ..
tīrthayātrāṃ suraśreṣṭha kuruṣva dharaṇītale ..
tīrthaṃ vinā dhruvaṃ vṛddhistejaso na bhaviṣyati ..4..
14.59.d:
.. बृहस्पतिरुवाच .. ..
तीर्थयात्रां सुरश्रेष्ठ कुरुष्व धरणीतले ..
तीर्थं विना ध्रुवं वृद्धिस्तेजसो न भविष्यति ..4..
14.59.m: Bṛhaspati said: / ‘Best of gods, undertake a pilgrimage to sacred fords on the surface of the earth; / without a sacred ford, there will surely be no increase of your splendor.’ // 4

14.59.s:
tatastīrthānyanekāni bhrāṃtvā śakro narādhipa ..
krameṇaivārbudaṃ prāptastatra dṛṣṭvā jalāśayam ..
snānaṃ cakre tataḥ śrānto mahaujāḥ pratyapadyata .. 5 ..
14.59.d:
ततस्तीर्थान्यनेकानि भ्रांत्वा शक्रो नराधिप ..
क्रमेणैवार्बुदं प्राप्तस्तत्र दृष्ट्वा जलाशयम् ..
स्नानं चक्रे ततः श्रान्तो महौजाः प्रत्यपद्यत .. 5 ..
14.59.m: Then, having wandered to many sacred fords, O king of men, / Śakra in due course reached Arbuda, and seeing a pool of water there, / the exhausted [god] took a bath; thereupon he regained great splendor. // 5

14.59.s:
durgandhena vinirmuktastato devaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ ..
uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ sarvadevatāḥ .. 6 ..
14.59.d:
दुर्गन्धेन विनिर्मुक्तस्ततो देवैः समावृतः ..
उवाच प्रहसन्वाक्यं शृणुध्वं सर्वदेवताः .. 6 ..
14.59.m: Completely freed from the foul odor and surrounded by the gods, / he smilingly spoke these words: ‘Listen, all deities! // 6

14.59.s:
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyanti prāpte śakrocchraye sadā ..
āśvine śuklapakṣāṃte te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim ..
suśrīkāśca bhaviṣyaṃti sadā janmanijanmani .. 7 ..
14.59.d:
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यन्ति प्राप्ते शक्रोच्छ्रये सदा ..
आश्विने शुक्लपक्षांते ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् ..
सुश्रीकाश्च भविष्यंति सदा जन्मनिजन्मनि .. 7 ..
14.59.m: Those who will bathe here whenever Śakra’s festival arrives, / at the end of the bright fortnight of Āśvina, shall attain the highest goal, / and they shall always be endowed with good fortune birth after birth.’ // 7

14.59.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe mahaujasatīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 59 ..
14.59.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे महौजसतीर्थप्रभाववर्णनंनामैकोनषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 59 ..
14.59.m: Thus ends the fifty-ninth chapter, entitled "Description of the Power of the Mahaujas Sacred Ford", in the third section, the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh book, the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses. // 59

14.60.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha jaṃbūtīrthamanuttamam ..
tatra snāto naraḥ samyagiṣṭaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt. ..
jaṃbūdvīpasamutthānāṃ tīrthānāṃ nṛpasattama .. 1 ..
14.60.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ जंबूतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यगिष्टं फलमवाप्नुयात्. ..
जंबूद्वीपसमुत्थानां तीर्थानां नृपसत्तम .. 1 ..
14.60.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, best of kings, to the unsurpassed Jambūtīrtha; / a man who bathes there duly attains the desired reward / of the sacred fords situated in Jambūdvīpa, best of kings. // 1

14.60.s:
āsītpurā nimirnāma kṣatriyaḥ sūryavaṃśajaḥ ..
vayasaḥ pariṇāme sa parvataṃ cārbudaṃ gataḥ .. 2 ..
14.60.d:
आसीत्पुरा निमिर्नाम क्षत्रियः सूर्यवंशजः ..
वयसः परिणामे स पर्वतं चार्बुदं गतः .. 2 ..
14.60.m: In ancient times there was a kṣatriya named Nimi, born of the solar dynasty. / In the maturity of his age, he went to Mount Arbuda. // 2

14.60.s:
prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā sthitastatra samāhitaḥ ..
athājagmurmunigaṇāstasya pārśve sahasraśaḥ .. 3 ..
14.60.d:
प्रायोपवेशनं कृत्वा स्थितस्तत्र समाहितः ..
अथाजग्मुर्मुनिगणास्तस्य पार्श्वे सहस्रशः .. 3 ..
14.60.m: Having undertaken fasting unto death, he stayed there, composed in mind. / Then hosts of sages came to his side by the thousands. // 3

14.60.s:
cakrurdharmakathāṃ puṇyāṃ rājarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām ..
devarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ mahātmanām .. 4 ..
14.60.d:
चक्रुर्धर्मकथां पुण्यां राजर्षीणां महात्मनाम् ..
देवर्षीणां पुराणानां तथान्येषां महात्मनाम् .. 4 ..
14.60.m: They engaged in holy discourse on dharma concerning the great royal seers, / the ancient celestial seers, and other great souls. // 4

14.60.s:
tataḥ kaścitkathāṃte ca lomaśo nāma sanmuniḥ ..
kīrttayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthasamudbhavam .. 5 ..
14.60.d:
ततः कश्चित्कथांते च लोमशो नाम सन्मुनिः ..
कीर्त्तयामास माहात्म्यं सर्वतीर्थसमुद्भवम् .. 5 ..
14.60.m: Then, at the end of the narrative, a true sage named Lomaśa / proclaimed the greatness originating from all sacred fords. // 5

14.60.s:
tacchrutvā pārthivo rājannimiḥ paramadurmanāḥ ..
babhūva na kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yatastīrthāvagāhanam .. 6 ..
14.60.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा पार्थिवो राजन्निमिः परमदुर्मनाः ..
बभूव न कृतं पूर्वं यतस्तीर्थावगाहनम् .. 6 ..
14.60.m: Hearing that, King Nimi became exceedingly dejected, / O king, because he had not performed bathing in sacred fords previously. // 6

14.60.s:
tataḥ provāca taṃ vipramastyupāyo dvijottama ..
kaścidyena ca sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ labhyate phalam .. 7 .. ..
14.60.d:
ततः प्रोवाच तं विप्रमस्त्युपायो द्विजोत्तम ..
कश्चिद्येन च सर्वेषां तीर्थानां लभ्यते फलम् .. 7 .. ..
14.60.m: Then he said to that brahmin: ‘Is there any means, best of the twice-born, / by which the fruit of all sacred fords is obtained?’ // 7

14.60.s:
.. lomaśa uvāca .. ..
dayā me nṛpa sañjātā tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitaṃ bhṛśam ..
tīrthayātrākṛte yasmātkariṣye'haṃ tava priyam .. 8 ..
14.60.d:
.. लोमश उवाच .. ..
दया मे नृप सञ्जाता त्वां दृष्ट्वा दुःखितं भृशम् ..
तीर्थयात्राकृते यस्मात्करिष्येऽहं तव प्रियम् .. 8 ..
14.60.m: Lomaśa said: / ‘Compassion has arisen in me, O king, seeing you deeply distressed; / for the purpose of a pilgrimage to sacred fords, I shall do what pleases you.’ // 8

14.60.s:
atraiva cānayiṣyāmi jaṃbūdvīpodbhavāni ca ..
sarvatīrthāni rājendra mantraśaktyā na saṃśayaḥ .. 9 ..
14.60.d:
अत्रैव चानयिष्यामि जंबूद्वीपोद्भवानि च ..
सर्वतीर्थानि राजेन्द्र मन्त्रशक्त्या न संशयः .. 9 ..
14.60.m: And right here, O best of kings, by the power of mantras, / I will bring all the sacred fords born in Jambudvīpa; there is no doubt. 9.

14.60.s:
snānaṃ kuru mahārāja hyekībhūteṣu tatra ca ..
asmiñjalāśaye puṇye satyametadbravīmyaham .. 7.3.60.10 ..
14.60.d:
स्नानं कुरु महाराज ह्येकीभूतेषु तत्र च ..
अस्मिञ्जलाशये पुण्ये सत्यमेतद्ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 7.3.60.10 ..
14.60.m: Take your ritual ablution, O great king, right there when they are united / in this holy reservoir; I speak this truth to you. 7.3.60.10.

14.60.s:
evamuktvā sa viprarṣirdhyānaṃ cakre samāhitaḥ ..
tatastīrthāni sarvāṇi tatrāyātāni tatkṣaṇāt .. 11 ..
14.60.d:
एवमुक्त्वा स विप्रर्षिर्ध्यानं चक्रे समाहितः ..
ततस्तीर्थानि सर्वाणि तत्रायातानि तत्क्षणात् .. 11 ..
14.60.m: Having spoken thus, that brahmin seer concentrated his mind in meditation; / thereupon, all the sacred fords arrived there in that very instant. 11.

14.60.s:
pratyayārthaṃ ca rājarṣe jaṃbūvṛkṣo vyajāyata ..
tatra snānaṃ nṛpaścakre sarvatīrthamaye dhruve .. 12 ..
14.60.d:
प्रत्ययार्थं च राजर्षे जंबूवृक्षो व्यजायत ..
तत्र स्नानं नृपश्चक्रे सर्वतीर्थमये ध्रुवे .. 12 ..
14.60.m: And to inspire trust, O royal seer, a rose-apple tree sprang up; / there the king took his ritual ablution in the eternal [waters] embodying all sacred fords. 12.

14.60.s:
sadehaśca gataḥ svarge tīrthasnānādanantaram ..
tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ jaṃbūtīrthamanusmṛtam .. 13 ..
14.60.d:
सदेहश्च गतः स्वर्गे तीर्थस्नानादनन्तरम् ..
ततः प्रभृति तत्तीर्थं जंबूतीर्थमनुस्मृतम् .. 13 ..
14.60.m: And he went to heaven with his physical body immediately after the ritual ablution in the sacred ford; / from that time onward, that sacred ford has been commemorated as Jambūtīrtha. 13.

14.60.s:
kanyāgate ravau tatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ ..
gayāśīrṣasamaṃ tasya puṇyamāhurmaharṣayaḥ .. 14 ..
14.60.d:
कन्यागते रवौ तत्र यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नरः ..
गयाशीर्षसमं तस्य पुण्यमाहुर्महर्षयः .. 14 ..
14.60.m: When the sun has entered the sign of Virgo, whatever person performs an ancestral rite there, / the great seers say his merit is equal to [that of performing it at] Gayāśīrṣa. 14.

14.60.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe jaṃbūtīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 60 ..
14.60.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे जंबूतीर्थप्रभाववर्णनंनाम षष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 60 ..
14.60.m: Thus ends the sixtieth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Jambūtīrtha,' in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 60.

14.61.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
gaṃgādharaṃ tato gacchetsupuṇyaṃ vimalodakam ..
yena gaṃgā dhṛtā rājannipatantī nabhastalāt .. 1 ..
14.61.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
गंगाधरं ततो गच्छेत्सुपुण्यं विमलोदकम् ..
येन गंगा धृता राजन्निपतन्ती नभस्तलात् .. 1 ..
14.61.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Gaṅgādhara, very sacred, having clear waters, / by which Gaṅgā was held, O king, as she fell from the expanse of the sky, 1.

14.61.s:
āhūtā deva devena hyacaleśvararūpiṇā ..
hareṇa rabhasā rājanyatpurā kathitaṃ tava .. 2 ..
14.61.d:
आहूता देव देवेन ह्यचलेश्वररूपिणा ..
हरेण रभसा राजन्यत्पुरा कथितं तव .. 2 ..
14.61.m: summoned impetuously, O king, by Hara, the god of gods, / in the form of Acaleśvara, as was told to you before. 2.

14.61.s:
tatra yaḥ kurute snānamaṣṭamyāṃ ca samāhitaḥ ..
sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ devai rapi sudurlabham .. 3 ..
14.61.d:
तत्र यः कुरुते स्नानमष्टम्यां च समाहितः ..
स गच्छेत्परमं स्थानं देवै रपि सुदुर्लभम् .. 3 ..
14.61.m: Whoever, attentive in mind, performs a ritual ablution there on the eighth day [of the fortnight], / he shall go to the supreme abode, very difficult to attain even for the gods. 3.

14.61.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīya'rbudakhaṇḍe gaṃgādharatīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 61 ..
14.61.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयऽर्बुदखण्डे गंगाधरतीर्थमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनामैकषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 61 ..
14.61.m: Thus ends the sixty-first chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Gaṅgādharatīrtha,' in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 61.

14.62.s:
.. pulastyasya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ kaṭeśvaraṃ gacchelliṃgaṃ gaurīvinirmitam ..
tathā gaṃgeśvaraṃ cānyadgaṅgayā nirmitaṃ svayam .. 1 ..
14.62.d:
.. पुलस्त्यस्य उवाच .. ..
ततः कटेश्वरं गच्छेल्लिंगं गौरीविनिर्मितम् ..
तथा गंगेश्वरं चान्यद्गङ्गया निर्मितं स्वयम् .. 1 ..
14.62.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Kaṭeśvara, the liṅga fashioned by Gaurī, / and likewise to another, Gaṅgeśvara, fashioned by Gaṅgā herself. 1.

14.62.s:
purā samabhavadyuddhamumāyāḥ saha gaṃgayā ..
saubhāgyaṃ prati rājendra tato gaurītyabhāṣata .. 2 ..
14.62.d:
पुरा समभवद्युद्धमुमायाः सह गंगया ..
सौभाग्यं प्रति राजेन्द्र ततो गौरीत्यभाषत .. 2 ..
14.62.m: Long ago, a rivalry arose between Umā and Gaṅgā / regarding good fortune [with their husband], O best of kings; then Gaurī spoke: 2.

14.62.s:
yayā saṃpūjitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ śīghraṃ yāsyati darśanam ..
sā saubhāgyavatī nūnabhāvayoḥ saṃbhaviṣyati .. 3 ..
14.62.d:
यया संपूजितः शंभुः शीघ्रं यास्यति दर्शनम् ..
सा सौभाग्यवती नूनभावयोः संभविष्यति .. 3 ..
14.62.m: "She by whom Śambhu is worshipped and will swiftly grant darśana, / she indeed of the two of us will be the one possessing good fortune." 3.

14.62.s:
evamuktā tato gaṃgā satvaraityātra parvate ..
liṃgamanveṣayāmāsa cirakālādavāpa sā .. 4 ..
14.62.d:
एवमुक्ता ततो गंगा सत्वरैत्यात्र पर्वते ..
लिंगमन्वेषयामास चिरकालादवाप सा .. 4 ..
14.62.m: Addressed thus, Gaṅgā then went quickly to this mountain; / she searched for a liṅga and found one after a long time. 4.

14.62.s:
dṛṣṭvā gauryātha kaṭakaṃ parvatasya manoharam ..
liṃgākāraṃ mahārāja pūjayāmāsa sā tadā .. 5 ..
14.62.d:
दृष्ट्वा गौर्याथ कटकं पर्वतस्य मनोहरम् ..
लिंगाकारं महाराज पूजयामास सा तदा .. 5 ..
14.62.m: Then Gaurī, having seen a delightful slope of the mountain / shaped like a liṅga, O great king, worshipped it at that time. 5.

14.62.s:
samyakchraddhāsamopetā tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
pradadau darśanaṃ tasyā varado'smīti cābravīt .. 6 ..
14.62.d:
सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमोपेता ततस्तुष्टो महेश्वरः ..
प्रददौ दर्शनं तस्या वरदोऽस्मीति चाब्रवीत् .. 6 ..
14.62.m: She was endowed with complete faith; pleased with that, Maheśvara / granted his darśana to her and said, "I am the granter of boons." 6.

14.62.s:
.. gauryuvāca .. ..
sāpatnyajerṣyayā deva mayā liṃgaṃ prakalpitam ..
tasmātkaṭeśvarākhyā ca loke cāsya bhaviṣyati .. 7 ..
14.62.d:
.. गौर्युवाच .. ..
सापत्न्यजेर्ष्यया देव मया लिंगं प्रकल्पितम् ..
तस्मात्कटेश्वराख्या च लोके चास्य भविष्यति .. 7 ..
14.62.m: Gaurī said: / "O God, this liṅga was fashioned by me out of jealousy arising from having a co-wife; / therefore, its name in the world shall be Kaṭeśvara. 7.

14.62.s:
yā nārī patinā muktā sapatnīduḥkhaduḥkhitā ..
asya saṃdarśanādeva sā bhaviṣyati vijvarā ..
sutasaubhāgyasaṃpannā bhartṛprāṇasamā tathā .. 8 ..
14.62.d:
या नारी पतिना मुक्ता सपत्नीदुःखदुःखिता ..
अस्य संदर्शनादेव सा भविष्यति विज्वरा ..
सुतसौभाग्यसंपन्ना भर्तृप्राणसमा तथा .. 8 ..
14.62.m: Whatever woman is abandoned by her husband or afflicted by the sorrow caused by a co-wife, / merely by seeing this [liṅga] she will be free of sorrow, / endowed with sons and good fortune, and as dear to her husband as his own life." 8.

14.62.s:
gaṃgayārādhito deva evameva varaṃ dadau ..
tasmālliṃgadvayaṃ tacca draṣṭavyaṃ manujādhipa .. 9 ..
14.62.d:
गंगयाराधितो देव एवमेव वरं ददौ ..
तस्माल्लिंगद्वयं तच्च द्रष्टव्यं मनुजाधिप .. 9 ..
14.62.m: Worshipped by Gaṅgā, the god granted the very same boon; / therefore, that pair of liṅgas must be seen, O lord of men, 9.

14.62.s:
viśeṣataśca nārībhiḥ sapatnīdoṣahānidam ..
sukhasaubhāgyadaṃ nityaṃ tathā'bhīṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām .. 7.3.62.10 ..
14.62.d:
विशेषतश्च नारीभिः सपत्नीदोषहानिदम् ..
सुखसौभाग्यदं नित्यं तथाऽभीष्टप्रदं नृणाम् .. 7.3.62.10 ..
14.62.m: especially by women, as it destroys the afflictions caused by a co-wife, / constantly bestows happiness and good fortune, and grants the desires of humans. 7.3.62.10.

14.62.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kaṭeśvaragaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 62..
14.62.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे कटेश्वरगंगेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्विषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 62..
14.62.m: Thus ends the sixty-second chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Kaṭeśvara and Gaṅgeśvara,' in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 62.

14.63.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..
arbudasya mahārāja māhātmyaṃ hi samāsataḥ .. 1 ..
14.63.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..
अर्बुदस्य महाराज माहात्म्यं हि समासतः .. 1 ..
14.63.m: Pulastya said: / All this which you ask me has been recounted to you, / namely the māhātmya of Arbuda in brief, O great king. 1.

14.63.s:
vistareṇa ca saṃkhyā syādapi varṣaśatairapi ..
asaṃkhyānīha tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca ..
padepade gṛhāṇyeva nirmitāni maharṣibhiḥ .. 2 ..
14.63.d:
विस्तरेण च संख्या स्यादपि वर्षशतैरपि ..
असंख्यानीह तीर्थानि पुण्यान्यायतनानि च ..
पदेपदे गृहाण्येव निर्मितानि महर्षिभिः .. 2 ..
14.63.m: A detailed reckoning would take even hundreds of years; / innumerable are the sacred fords and holy shrines here, / and at every step there are dwellings built by the great seers. 2.

14.63.s:
na tattīrthaṃ na sā siddhirna sa vṛkṣo mahīpate ..
na sā nadī na deveśo yasya tatrāsti na sthitiḥ .. 3 ..
14.63.d:
न तत्तीर्थं न सा सिद्धिर्न स वृक्षो महीपते ..
न सा नदी न देवेशो यस्य तत्रास्ति न स्थितिः .. 3 ..
14.63.m: There is no such sacred ford, no such perfection, no such tree, O lord of the earth, / no such river, no such lord of gods, whose presence is not found there. 3.

14.63.s:
ye vasaṃti mahārāja suramye'rbudaparvate ..
nūnaṃ te puṇyakarmāṇo na vasaṃti triviṣṭape .. 4 ..
14.63.d:
ये वसंति महाराज सुरम्येऽर्बुदपर्वते ..
नूनं ते पुण्यकर्माणो न वसंति त्रिविष्टपे .. 4 ..
14.63.m: Those who dwell on the charming Arbuda mountain, O great king, / are truly performers of meritorious deeds; they do not reside in heaven. 4.

14.63.s:
kiṃ tasya jīvitenārthaḥ kiṃ dhanaiḥ kiṃ japairnṛpa ..
yo na paśyati mandātmā samantādarbudācalam .. 5 ..
14.63.d:
किं तस्य जीवितेनार्थः किं धनैः किं जपैर्नृप ..
यो न पश्यति मन्दात्मा समन्तादर्बुदाचलम् .. 5 ..
14.63.m: What is the purpose of his life, what is the purpose of riches, what is the purpose of whispered prayers, O king, / for the dull-witted one who does not see Mount Arbuda completely? 5.

14.63.s:
api kīṭapataṃgā ye paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ..
svedajāścāṇḍajāścāpi hyudbhijjāśca jarāyujāḥ .. 6 ..
14.63.d:
अपि कीटपतंगा ये पशवः पक्षिणो मृगाः ..
स्वेदजाश्चाण्डजाश्चापि ह्युद्भिज्जाश्च जरायुजाः .. 6 ..
14.63.m: Even worms, moths, beasts, birds, animals of the wild, / sweat-born, egg-born, sprout-born, and womb-born creatures, 6.

14.63.s:
tasminmṛtā mahārāja niṣkāmāḥ kāmato'pi vā ..
te yānti śivasāyujyaṃ jarā maraṇavarjitam .. 7 ..
14.63.d:
तस्मिन्मृता महाराज निष्कामाः कामतोऽपि वा ..
ते यान्ति शिवसायुज्यं जरा मरणवर्जितम् .. 7 ..
14.63.m: if they die upon it, O great king, whether devoid of desire or with desire, / they attain union with Śiva, free from old age and death. 7.

14.63.s:
yaścaitacchuṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ ..
arbudasya mahārāja sa yātrāphalamaśnute .. 8 ..
14.63.d:
यश्चैतच्छुणुयान्नित्यं पुराणं श्रद्धयान्वितः ..
अर्बुदस्य महाराज स यात्राफलमश्नुते .. 8 ..
14.63.m: And whatever person endowed with faith constantly hears this purāṇa / of Arbuda, O great king, he obtains the fruit of the pilgrimage. 8.

14.63.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrāṃ tatra samācaret ..
ya icchedātmanaḥ siddhimiha loke paratra ca .. 9 ..
14.63.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन यात्रां तत्र समाचरेत् ..
य इच्छेदात्मनः सिद्धिमिह लोके परत्र च .. 9 ..
14.63.m: Therefore, with every effort one should undertake the pilgrimage there, / whoever desires perfection for oneself in this world and in the next. 9.

14.63.s:
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe'rbudakhaṇḍamāhātmyaphalaśrutivarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 63 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīyamarbudakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam .. 7 - 3 ..
.. atha śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīyamarbudakhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate .. ( 7 - 3) ..
14.63.d:
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडेऽर्बुदखण्डमाहात्म्यफलश्रुतिवर्णनंनाम त्रिषष्टितमोऽध्यायः .. 63 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराणे सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयमर्बुदखण्डं सम्पूर्णम् .. 7 - 3 ..
.. अथ श्रीस्कांदे महापुराणे सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयमर्बुदखण्डं प्रारभ्यते .. ( 7 - 3) ..
14.63.m:
Thus ends the sixty-third chapter, named 'Description of the Reward for Hearing the Māhātmya of Arbudakhaṇḍa,' in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 63.
Thus ends the third Arbudakhaṇḍa in the seventh [section], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa. 7 - 3.
Now begins the third, the Arbuda Section, in the seventh Prabhāsa Section in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa (7.3).

14.64.s:

14.64.m:
Now the third Arbudakhaṇḍa in the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa. 7 3.
1. The commencement of the description of the Arbuda mountain māhātmya. Therein, first, Vasiṣṭha's journey to the Arbuda mountain; having performed austerity there, his cow, kept for sacrifice, having gone to graze on grass and other plants in the forest, falls into a chasm; Vasiṣṭha's anxiety when the cow does not return in the evening; then Vasiṣṭha, having approached the chasm and heard the lowing of his cow, meditates upon Sarasvatī for her exit; by that meditation, Sarasvatī fills the chasm with her waters and causes the cow to emerge; Vasiṣṭha takes that cow and goes to his hermitage; then Vasiṣṭha goes to Himavat to fill that chasm, and having told Himavat the length and breadth of the chasm, the origin of the chasm is spoken according to the word of Himavat; the beginning of the narration concerning the fissure near Vasiṣṭha's hermitage. 237 1

2. Gautama's pupil Uttaṅka, urged by his preceptor's wife to bring the earrings of Saudāsa's wife Madayantī in order to pay the preceptor's fee, goes to Saudāsa's house; seeing there Saudāsa with the face of a tiger coming to devour his body, he makes a pledge to him to give up his own self; then he receives the earrings from his wife; Saudāsa's release from the curse; then, as Gautama's pupil departs taking the earrings, while they are set down on the way, Takṣaka steals those two earrings; then he goes to Pātāla after Takṣaka to bring them back; at that very time, the creation of a pit there; the narration of the deed of Gautama's pupil Uttaṅka. 237 2

14.64.m: 29. Piercing with an arrow of a doe suckling her fawn by King Suprabha, who was addicted to hunting; then the doe's pronouncement of a curse upon the king: "You shall become a fierce tiger!"; at that very moment the king's transformation into a tiger; the arrival in that very forest of a certain cow named Kapilā, separated from her herd; description of the dialogue between the tiger and Kapilā; then, having made a pledge before the tiger, Kapilā goes to her own pen, suckles her young calf with milk, tells the calf the account of what happened in the forest, sees the calf's insistence on going to the forest, restrains the calf, returns to her companions and recounts everything, and though restrained by her companions from going near the tiger, disregards her companions' words and returns to the tiger; seeing the cow's truthfulness, the tiger, with a heart overflowing with wonder, grants life to the cow; Suprabha's release from the curse; the renown of that very place by the name Kapilātīrtha; description of the māhātmya of Kapilātīrtha ... 255 1

34. While Brahmā and Viṣṇu were quarreling and fighting with each other out of a desire for greatness, the description of the emergence of a single liṅga without beginning or end between them; then, causing them to cease from fighting through a voice from the sky, the declaration of the wager: "He who sees the end of the liṅga is the greater"; there, because Brahmā falsely related the account of seeing the upper limit of the liṅga in the presence of Śiva, Śiva's bestowal of a curse bringing unworthiness of worship upon Brahmā; likewise, the curse upon the ketaka plant that stepped forward to give false testimony for Brahmā; then the granting of a boon to Viṣṇu by Śaṃkara; description of the māhātmya of Kṛṣṇatīrtha ... 260 2
