A note on Dvārakā
Om, reverence to the glorious Gaṇeśa.
Now begins the fourth, the Dvārakā Māhātmya, in the seventh Prabhāsa Section in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

15.1.s:
.. śaunaka uvāca .. ..
kathaṃ sūta yuge hyasminraudre vai kalisaṃjñake ..
bahupākhaṃḍasaṃkīrṇe prāpsyāmo madhusūdanam .. 1 ..
15.1.d:
.. शौनक उवाच .. ..
कथं सूत युगे ह्यस्मिन्रौद्रे वै कलिसंज्ञके ..
बहुपाखंडसंकीर्णे प्राप्स्यामो मधुसूदनम् .. 1 ..
15.1.m:
Śaunaka said:
O Sūta, how, in this terrible age named Kali, / crowded with many heretics, shall we reach Madhusūdana?

15.1.s:
yugatraye vyatikrānte dharmācārapare sadā ..
prāpte kaliyuge ghore kva viṣṇurbhagavāniti .. 2 ..
15.1.d:
युगत्रये व्यतिक्रान्ते धर्माचारपरे सदा ..
प्राप्ते कलियुगे घोरे क्व विष्णुर्भगवानिति .. 2 ..
15.1.m: When the three ages devoted ever to righteous conduct have passed away, / and the dreadful Kali age has arrived, where is Lord Viṣṇu?

15.1.s:
.. sūta uvāca .. ..
divaṃ yāte mahārāje rāme daśarathātmaje ..
duṣṭarājanyabhāreṇa pīḍite dharaṇītale .. 3 ..
15.1.d:
.. सूत उवाच .. ..
दिवं याते महाराजे रामे दशरथात्मजे ..
दुष्टराजन्यभारेण पीडिते धरणीतले .. 3 ..
15.1.m: Sūta said: / When the great king Rāma, son of Daśaratha, had gone to heaven, / and the surface of the earth was oppressed by the burden of wicked warriors, 3

15.1.s:
devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ bhūbhāraharaṇāya ca ..
vasudevagṛhe sākṣādāvirbhūte janārdane .. 4 ..
15.1.d:
देवानां कार्यसिद्ध्यर्थं भूभारहरणाय च ..
वसुदेवगृहे साक्षादाविर्भूते जनार्दने .. 4 ..
15.1.m: for the sake of accomplishing the work of the gods and to remove the burden of the earth, / Janārdana manifested visibly in the house of Vasudeva. 4

15.1.s:
naṃdavrajaṃ gate deve pūtanāśoṣaṇe sati ..
ghātite ca tṛṇāvarte śakaṭe parivartite .. .. 5 ..
15.1.d:
नंदव्रजं गते देवे पूतनाशोषणे सति ..
घातिते च तृणावर्ते शकटे परिवर्तिते .. .. 5 ..
15.1.m: When the Lord went to Nanda's settlement and Pūtanā was drained dry, / when Tṛṇāvarta was slain, and the cart overturned, 5

15.1.s:
damite kāliye nāge pralaṃbe ca niṣūdite ..
dhṛte govardhane śaile paritrāte ca gokule .. 6 ..
15.1.d:
दमिते कालिये नागे प्रलंबे च निषूदिते ..
धृते गोवर्धने शैले परित्राते च गोकुले .. 6 ..
15.1.m: when the serpent Kāliya was subdued, and Pralamba destroyed, / when Mount Govardhana was held up, and Gokula protected, 6

15.1.s:
surabhyā cābhiṣikte tu indre ca vimadīkṛte ..
rāsakrīḍārate deve dārite keśidānave .. 7 ..
15.1.d:
सुरभ्या चाभिषिक्ते तु इन्द्रे च विमदीकृते ..
रासक्रीडारते देवे दारिते केशिदानवे .. 7 ..
15.1.m: when he was consecrated by Surabhi, Indra's pride was crushed, / the Lord engaged in the rāsa-dance, and the demon Keśin was torn apart, 7

15.1.s:
akrūravacanāddeve mathurāyāṃ gate harau ..
hate kuvalayāpīḍe mallarāje ca ghātite .. 8 ..
15.1.d:
अक्रूरवचनाद्देवे मथुरायां गते हरौ ..
हते कुवलयापीडे मल्लराजे च घातिते .. 8 ..
15.1.m: when Hari, at the word of Akrūra, went to Mathurā, / when Kuvalayāpīḍa was slain, and the king of wrestlers killed, 8

15.1.s:
paśyatāṃ deva daityānāṃ bhojarāje nipātite ..
yadupuryāmabhiṣikta ugrasene narādhipe .. 9 ..
15.1.d:
पश्यतां देव दैत्यानां भोजराजे निपातिते ..
यदुपुर्यामभिषिक्त उग्रसेने नराधिपे .. 9 ..
15.1.m: when the king of the Bhojas was struck down before the eyes of gods and daityas, / and the ruler of men Ugrasena was consecrated in the city of the Yadus, 9

15.1.s:
jarāsaṃdhabale raudre yavane ca hate kṣitau ..
rājasūye kratuvare caidye caiva nipātite .. 7.4.1.10 ..
15.1.d:
जरासंधबले रौद्रे यवने च हते क्षितौ ..
राजसूये क्रतुवरे चैद्ये चैव निपातिते .. 7.4.1.10 ..
15.1.m: when the terrifying army of Jarāsandha and the Yavana were slain upon the earth, / and during the Rājasūya, the foremost of sacrifices, the king of Cedi was cast down; 10

15.1.s:
nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe bhāre ca kṣapite bhuvaḥ ..
yātrāvyājasamānīte prabhāsaṃ yādave kule .. 11 ..
15.1.d:
निवृत्ते भारते युद्धे भारे च क्षपिते भुवः ..
यात्राव्याजसमानीते प्रभासं यादवे कुले .. 11 ..
15.1.m: when the Bhārata war ceased and the earth's burden was removed, / and the Yādava family was brought to Prabhāsa under the pretext of a pilgrimage; 11

15.1.s:
madyapānaprasakte tu parasparavadho dyate ..
kalahenātiraudreṇa vinaṣṭe yādave kule .. 12 ..
15.1.d:
मद्यपानप्रसक्ते तु परस्परवधो द्यते ..
कलहेनातिरौद्रेण विनष्टे यादवे कुले .. 12 ..
15.1.m: when, addicted to wine-drinking and intent on slaughtering one another, / the Yādava clan was destroyed in a terribly violent feud; 12

15.1.s:
gātraṃ saṃtyajya cātraiva gate'naṃte dharātalāt ..
aśvatthamūlalamāśritya samāsīne janārdane .. .. 13 ..
15.1.d:
गात्रं संत्यज्य चात्रैव गतेऽनंते धरातलात् ..
अश्वत्थमूललमाश्रित्य समासीने जनार्दने .. .. 13 ..
15.1.m: when Ananta cast off his body right there and departed from the surface of the earth, / and Janārdana sat down, leaning against the root of an aśvattha tree; 13

15.1.s:
vyādhaprahārabhinnāṃge parityakte kalevare ..
svadhāmasaṃsthite deve pārthe ca punarāgate .. 14 ..
15.1.d:
व्याधप्रहारभिन्नांगे परित्यक्ते कलेवरे ..
स्वधामसंस्थिते देवे पार्थे च पुनरागते .. 14 ..
15.1.m: when his limbs were pierced by the hunter's shot, he abandoned his body, / the Lord entered his own realm, and Pārtha returned; 14

15.1.s:
yadupuryyāṃ plāvitāyāṃ sāgareṇa samaṃtataḥ ..
śakraprasthaṃ tato gatvā kārayitvā harergṛham .. 15 ..
15.1.d:
यदुपुर्य्यां प्लावितायां सागरेण समंततः ..
शक्रप्रस्थं ततो गत्वा कारयित्वा हरेर्गृहम् .. 15 ..
15.1.m: when the city of the Yadus was inundated on all sides by the ocean, / [Arjuna] then went to Indraprastha and had a temple built for Hari; 15

15.1.s:
dvāpare ca vyatikrāṃte dharmādharmavimiśrite ..
saṃprāpte ca mahāraudre yuge vai kalisaṃjñite .. 16 ..
15.1.d:
द्वापरे च व्यतिक्रांते धर्माधर्मविमिश्रिते ..
संप्राप्ते च महारौद्रे युगे वै कलिसंज्ञिते .. 16 ..
15.1.m: and when Dvāpara, where dharma and adharma were intermingled, had passed away, / and the very dreadful age called Kali arrived; 16

15.1.s:
kṣīyamāṇe ca saddharme vidharme prabale tathā ..
naṣṭadharmakriyāyoge vedavādabahiṣkṛte ..
ekapāde sthite dharme varṇāśramavivarjite .. 17 ..
15.1.d:
क्षीयमाणे च सद्धर्मे विधर्मे प्रबले तथा ..
नष्टधर्मक्रियायोगे वेदवादबहिष्कृते ..
एकपादे स्थिते धर्मे वर्णाश्रमविवर्जिते .. 17 ..
15.1.m: when true dharma was waning and adharma grew powerful, / the practice of righteous rites was destroyed, the teachings of the Veda excluded, / and dharma stood upon a single foot, bereft of caste and life-stage; 17

15.1.s:
asminyuge vilulite hyṛṣayo vanacāriṇaḥ ..
sametyāmaṃtrayansarve gargacyavanabhārgavāḥ .. 18 ..
15.1.d:
अस्मिन्युगे विलुलिते ह्यृषयो वनचारिणः ..
समेत्यामंत्रयन्सर्वे गर्गच्यवनभार्गवाः .. 18 ..
15.1.m: in this disordered age, the forest-dwelling seers / assembled and took counsel together—Garga, Cyavana, the Bhārgavas, 18

15.1.s:
asito devalo dhaumyaḥ kraturuddālakastathā ..
ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parasparamathābruvan .. 19 ..
15.1.d:
असितो देवलो धौम्यः क्रतुरुद्दालकस्तथा ..
एते चान्ये च बहवः परस्परमथाब्रुवन् .. 19 ..
15.1.m: Asita, Devala, Dhaumya, Kratu, and Uddālaka. / These and many others then said to one another: 19

15.1.s:
paśyadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kalivyāptaṃ digaṃtaram ..
samaṃtātparidhāvadbhirdasyubhirbādhyate prajā .. 7.4.1.20 ..
15.1.d:
पश्यध्वं मुनयः सर्वे कलिव्याप्तं दिगंतरम् ..
समंतात्परिधावद्भिर्दस्युभिर्बाध्यते प्रजा .. 7.4.1.20 ..
15.1.m: “Behold, all you sages, the horizon is pervaded by Kali! / The subjects are tormented by robbers running all around, 20

15.1.s:
adharmaparamaiḥ puṃbhiḥ satyārjavanirākṛtaiḥ ..
kathaṃ sa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ saṃprāpyo munisattamāḥ .. 21 ..
15.1.d:
अधर्मपरमैः पुंभिः सत्यार्जवनिराकृतैः ..
कथं स भगवान्विष्णुः संप्राप्यो मुनिसत्तमाः .. 21 ..
15.1.m: by men dedicated to unrighteousness, who have cast aside truth and uprightness. / How can that Blessed Lord Viṣṇu be reached, O best of sages? 21

15.1.s:
ko vā bhavābdhau patatastārayiṣyati saṃgatān ..
na kalau saṃbhavastasya triyugo madhusūdanaḥ ..
taṃ vinā puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ kathaṃ syāma kalau yuge .. 22 ..
15.1.d:
को वा भवाब्धौ पततस्तारयिष्यति संगतान् ..
न कलौ संभवस्तस्य त्रियुगो मधुसूदनः ..
तं विना पुंडरीकाक्षं कथं स्याम कलौ युगे .. 22 ..
15.1.m: Or who will deliver those assembled who are falling into the ocean of worldly existence? / He has no incarnation in Kali, for Madhusūdana appears in only three ages. / Without that lotus-eyed one, how can we exist in the Kali age?” 22

15.1.s:
teṣāṃ ciṃtayatāmevaṃ duḥkhitānāṃ tapasvinām ..
uvāca vacanaṃ tatra ṛṣiruddālakastadā.. 23..
15.1.d:
तेषां चिंतयतामेवं दुःखितानां तपस्विनाम् ..
उवाच वचनं तत्र ऋषिरुद्दालकस्तदा.. 23..
15.1.m: As those ascetics were thus reflecting in their sorrow, / the seer Uddālaka then spoke these words: 23

15.1.s:
uddālaka uvāca ..
yāvanna kalidoṣeṇa lipyāmo munisattamāḥ ..
apāpā brahmasadanaṃ gacchāmaḥ parisaṃgatāḥ .. 24 ..
15.1.d:
उद्दालक उवाच ..
यावन्न कलिदोषेण लिप्यामो मुनिसत्तमाः ..
अपापा ब्रह्मसदनं गच्छामः परिसंगताः .. 24 ..
15.1.m: Uddālaka said: / “Before we are stained by the evil of Kali, O best of sages, / let us go, gathered together, free from sin, to the abode of Brahmā. 24

15.1.s:
pṛcchāmo lokadhātāraṃ sthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ kalau yuge ..
yadi viṣṇuḥ kalau na syādrudreṇa brahmaṇā'saha .. 25 ..
15.1.d:
पृच्छामो लोकधातारं स्थितं विष्णुं कलौ युगे ..
यदि विष्णुः कलौ न स्याद्रुद्रेण ब्रह्मणाऽसह .. 25 ..
15.1.m: Let us ask the creator of the world where Viṣṇu abides in the Kali age. / If Viṣṇu is not present in Kali along with Rudra and Brahmā, 25

15.1.s:
taṃ vinā puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ tyakṣyāmaḥ svakalevaram ..
vinā bhagavatā loke kaḥ sthāsyati kalau yuge .. 26 ..
15.1.d:
तं विना पुंडरीकाक्षं त्यक्ष्यामः स्वकलेवरम् ..
विना भगवता लोके कः स्थास्यति कलौ युगे .. 26 ..
15.1.m: without that lotus-eyed one, we shall cast off our own bodies. / Without the Blessed Lord, who can remain in the world in the Kali age?” 26

15.1.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ ..
sādhusādhviti te coktvā prasthitā brahmaṇoṃ'tikam.. 27 ..
15.1.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य ऋषयः संशितव्रताः ..
साधुसाध्विति ते चोक्त्वा प्रस्थिता ब्रह्मणोंऽतिकम्.. 27 ..
15.1.m: Hearing those words of his, the seers of strict vows / said, “Excellent, excellent!” and set forth to the presence of Brahmā. 27

15.1.s:
kathayantaḥ kathāṃ viṣṇoḥ svarūpamanuvarṇanam ..
tāpasāḥ prayayuḥ sarve saṃhṛṣṭā brahmaṇoṃ'tikam .. ..28..
15.1.d:
कथयन्तः कथां विष्णोः स्वरूपमनुवर्णनम् ..
तापसाः प्रययुः सर्वे संहृष्टा ब्रह्मणोंऽतिकम् .. ..28..
15.1.m: Speaking of tales of Viṣṇu and describing his true nature, / all the ascetics went with joyful hearts to the presence of Brahmā. 28

15.1.s:
dadṛśuste tadā devamāsīnaṃ paramāsane ..
pitāmahabhūtagaṇairmūrtāmūrtairvṛtaṃ tathā .. 29 ..
15.1.d:
ददृशुस्ते तदा देवमासीनं परमासने ..
पितामहभूतगणैर्मूर्तामूर्तैर्वृतं तथा .. 29 ..
15.1.m: Then they beheld the god seated upon a supreme throne, / surrounded by the Grandsire's hosts of beings, both corporeal and incorporeal. 29

15.1.s:
dṛṣṭvā caturmukhaṃ devaṃ daṃḍavatpraṇatāḥ kṣitau ..
praṇamya devadevaṃ tu stotreṇa tuṣuvustadā .. 7.4.1.30 ..
15.1.d:
दृष्ट्वा चतुर्मुखं देवं दंडवत्प्रणताः क्षितौ ..
प्रणम्य देवदेवं तु स्तोत्रेण तुषुवुस्तदा .. 7.4.1.30 ..
15.1.m: Having seen the four-faced god, they prostrated like sticks upon the ground; / having bowed to the god of gods, they praised him then with a hymn: 30

15.1.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
namaste padmasaṃbhūta caturvaktrākṣayāvyaya ..
namaste sṛṣṭikartre tu pitāmaha namo'stu te ..31..
15.1.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
नमस्ते पद्मसंभूत चतुर्वक्त्राक्षयाव्यय ..
नमस्ते सृष्टिकर्त्रे तु पितामह नमोऽस्तु ते ..31..
15.1.m: The seers said: / “Salutations to you, O lotus-born one, four-faced, imperishable and immutable! / Salutations to you, the author of creation, O Grandsire, salutations be to you!” 31

15.1.s:
evaṃ stutaḥ sanmunibhiḥ suprītaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ ..
pādyārghyeṇābhivandyaitānpapraccha munipuṃgavān .. 32 ..
15.1.d:
एवं स्तुतः सन्मुनिभिः सुप्रीतः कमलोद्भवः ..
पाद्यार्घ्येणाभिवन्द्यैतान्पप्रच्छ मुनिपुंगवान् .. 32 ..
15.1.m: Thus praised by the noble sages, the lotus-born one was well-pleased; / honoring them with water for the feet and guest-offering, he asked those eminent sages: 32

15.1.s:
.. brahmovāca ..
kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ vo brūta tattvena putrakāḥ ..
kuśalaṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ putraśiṣyāgnibandhuṣu .. 33 ..
15.1.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच ..
किमागमनकृत्यं वो ब्रूत तत्त्वेन पुत्रकाः ..
कुशलं वो महाभागाः पुत्रशिष्याग्निबन्धुषु .. 33 ..
15.1.m: Brahmā said: / “What is the purpose of your coming? Tell me truly, my sons. / Is all well with you, O fortunate ones, in regard to your sons, disciples, sacred fires, and kin?” 33

15.1.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
bhavatprasādātsakalaṃ prāptaṃ nastapasaḥ phalam ..
yadbhavaṃtaṃ prapaśyāmaḥ sarvadevaguruṃ prabhum .. 34 ..
15.1.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
भवत्प्रसादात्सकलं प्राप्तं नस्तपसः फलम् ..
यद्भवंतं प्रपश्यामः सर्वदेवगुरुं प्रभुम् .. 34 ..
15.1.m: The seers said: / “By your favor the complete fruit of our austerity has been attained, / in that we behold you, the lord and preceptor of all the gods. 34

15.1.s:
śṛṇvetatkāraṇaṃ śaṃbho ete prāptāstavāṃtikam ..
yugatraye vyatikrāṃte kṛtādidvāparāṃtake .. 35 ..
15.1.d:
शृण्वेतत्कारणं शंभो एते प्राप्तास्तवांतिकम् ..
युगत्रये व्यतिक्रांते कृतादिद्वापरांतके .. 35 ..
15.1.m: Hear this reason, O Śambhu, why these [sages] have come to your presence: / When the three ages have elapsed, beginning with Kṛta and ending with Dvāpara, 35

15.1.s:
prāpte kaliyuge ghore kva viṣṇuḥ pṛthivītale ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāṃ muktiṃ yāsyāmo muktabandhanāḥ .. 36 ..
15.1.d:
प्राप्ते कलियुगे घोरे क्व विष्णुः पृथिवीतले ..
यं दृष्ट्वा परमां मुक्तिं यास्यामो मुक्तबन्धनाः .. 36 ..
15.1.m: and the dreadful Kali age has arrived, where on the surface of the earth is Viṣṇu, / seeing whom we, freed from bondage, shall attain supreme liberation?” 36

15.1.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
matsyakūrmādirūpaiśca bhagavāñjñāyate mayā ..
viṣṇoḥ pāramikāṃ mūrtiṃ na jānāmi dvijottamāḥ .. 37 ..
15.1.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मत्स्यकूर्मादिरूपैश्च भगवाञ्ज्ञायते मया ..
विष्णोः पारमिकां मूर्तिं न जानामि द्विजोत्तमाः .. 37 ..
15.1.m: Brahmā said: / “The Blessed Lord is known to me through forms such as the Fish, the Tortoise, and others; / but I do not know the highest form of Viṣṇu, O best of brahmins.” 37

15.1.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
yadi tvaṃ na vijānāsi tāta viṣṇoravasthitim ..
gatvā prayāgaṃ tatraiva saṃtyakṣyāmaḥ kalevaram .. 38 ..
15.1.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
यदि त्वं न विजानासि तात विष्णोरवस्थितिम् ..
गत्वा प्रयागं तत्रैव संत्यक्ष्यामः कलेवरम् .. 38 ..
15.1.m: The seers said: / “If you, father, do not know the abiding place of Viṣṇu, / we shall go to Prayāga and cast off our bodies right there.” 38

15.1.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
mā viṣādaṃ vrajadhvaṃ hi upadekṣyāmi vo hitam ..
ito vrajadhvaṃ pātālaṃ yatrāste daityasattamaḥ .. 39 ..
15.1.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
मा विषादं व्रजध्वं हि उपदेक्ष्यामि वो हितम् ..
इतो व्रजध्वं पातालं यत्रास्ते दैत्यसत्तमः .. 39 ..
15.1.m: Brahmā said: / “Do not fall into dejection; I shall instruct you for your welfare. / Go from here to Pātāla, where the best of daityas dwells. 39

15.1.s:
taṃ gatvā paripṛcchadhvaṃ prahlādaṃ daityasattamam ..
sa jñāsyati hareḥ sthānaṃ yāthātathyena bho dvijāḥ ..7.4.1.40..
15.1.d:
तं गत्वा परिपृच्छध्वं प्रह्लादं दैत्यसत्तमम् ..
स ज्ञास्यति हरेः स्थानं याथातथ्येन भो द्विजाः ..7.4.1.40..
15.1.m: Go to him and ask Prahlāda, the best of daityas; / he will know the true abode of Hari as it really is, O brahmins.” 40

15.1.s:
tacchutvā vacanaṃ tasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ ..
praṇipatya ca deveśaṃ prasthitāste tapodhanāḥ .. 41 ..
15.1.d:
तच्छुत्वा वचनं तस्य ब्रह्मणः परमात्मनः ..
प्रणिपत्य च देवेशं प्रस्थितास्ते तपोधनाः .. 41 ..
15.1.m: Hearing those words of Brahmā, the Supreme Self, / and bowing to the lord of gods, those rich in austerity departed. 41

15.1.s:
jagmuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamanasaḥ stuvanto daityasattamam ..
dhanyaḥ sa daityarājo'yaṃ yo jānāti janārddanam .. 42 ..
15.1.d:
जग्मुः संहृष्टमनसः स्तुवन्तो दैत्यसत्तमम् ..
धन्यः स दैत्यराजोऽयं यो जानाति जनार्द्दनम् .. 42 ..
15.1.m: They went with joyful minds, praising the best of daityas: / “Blessed is this king of the daityas, who knows Janārdana!” 42

15.1.s: iti saṃciṃtayānāste prāptā vai sutalaṃ dvijāḥ ..43..
15.1.d: इति संचिंतयानास्ते प्राप्ता वै सुतलं द्विजाः ..43..
15.1.m: Thus reflecting, those brahmins arrived at Sutala. 43

15.1.s:
gatvā te tasya nagaraṃ viviśurbhavanottamam ..
dūrādeva sa tāndṛṣṭvā balirvairocanistadā ..
pratyutthāyārhayāñcakre prahlādena samanvitaḥ .. 44 ..
15.1.d:
गत्वा ते तस्य नगरं विविशुर्भवनोत्तमम् ..
दूरादेव स तान्दृष्ट्वा बलिर्वैरोचनिस्तदा ..
प्रत्युत्थायार्हयाञ्चक्रे प्रह्लादेन समन्वितः .. 44 ..
15.1.m: Having gone to his city, they entered his splendid palace; / seeing them from afar, Bali, son of Virocana, / stood up to greet them and, accompanied by Prahlāda, showed them honor. 44

15.1.s:
madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ caiva dattvā cārghyaṃ tathaiva ca ..
uvāca prāṃjalirbhūtvā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā.. 45..
15.1.d:
मधुपर्कं च गां चैव दत्त्वा चार्घ्यं तथैव च ..
उवाच प्रांजलिर्भूत्वा प्रहृष्टेनांतरात्मना.. 45..
15.1.m:
Offering the honey-mixture, a cow, and water of welcome,
he joined his hands in reverence and said with an inner soul full of joy:

15.1.s:
svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ suvyuṣṭā rajanī mama..
bhavato yatprapaśyāmi brūta kiṃ karavāṇi ca.. 46..
15.1.d:
स्वागतं वो महाभागाः सुव्युष्टा रजनी मम..
भवतो यत्प्रपश्यामि ब्रूत किं करवाणि च.. 46..
15.1.m:
“Welcome to you, illustrious ones! Truly, my night has dawned into auspicious day,
since I behold your honours. Tell me, what may I do for you?”

15.1.s:
evaṃ hi daityarājena satkṛtāste dvijottamāḥ..
ūcuḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso dānavendrasutaṃ tadā.. 47..
15.1.d:
एवं हि दैत्यराजेन सत्कृतास्ते द्विजोत्तमाः..
ऊचुः प्रहृष्टमनसो दानवेन्द्रसुतं तदा.. 47..
15.1.m:
Thus honoured by the king of Daityas, those best of the twice-born,
with rejoicing hearts, then spoke to the son of the lord of the Dānavas.

15.1.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kāryārthinastu saṃprāptāḥ prahlāda harivallabha ..
tadasmākaṃ mahābāho bhavāṃstrātā bhavārṇavāt .. 48 ..
15.1.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
कार्यार्थिनस्तु संप्राप्ताः प्रह्लाद हरिवल्लभ ..
तदस्माकं महाबाहो भवांस्त्राता भवार्णवात् .. 48 ..
15.1.m:
The seers said:
“We have come here seeking an objective, O Prahlāda, beloved of Hari!
Therefore, O mighty-armed one, be our deliverer from the ocean of worldly existence!

15.1.s:
kathaṃ daitya yuge hyasminraudre vai kalisaṃjñake ..
bhaviṣyāmo vinā viṣṇuṃ bhītānāmabhayapradam .. 49 ..
15.1.d:
कथं दैत्य युगे ह्यस्मिन्रौद्रे वै कलिसंज्ञके ..
भविष्यामो विना विष्णुं भीतानामभयप्रदम् .. 49 ..
15.1.m:
How, O Daitya, in this terrible age named Kali,
shall we exist without Viṣṇu, who grants fearlessness to the frightened?

15.1.s:
asminyuge hyadharmeṇa jito dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ ..
anṛtena jitaṃ satyaṃ viprāśca vṛṣalairjitāḥ .. 7.4.1.50 ..
15.1.d:
अस्मिन्युगे ह्यधर्मेण जितो धर्मः सनातनः ..
अनृतेन जितं सत्यं विप्राश्च वृषलैर्जिताः .. 7.4.1.50 ..
15.1.m:
For in this age eternal dharma has been overcome by adharma,
truth has been overcome by falsehood, and the learned brahmins are overcome by the base.

15.1.s:
viṭairjitā vedamārgāḥ strībhiśca puruṣā jitāḥ ..
brāhmaṇāścāpi vadhyante mleccha rājanyarūpibhiḥ .. 51 ..
15.1.d:
विटैर्जिता वेदमार्गाः स्त्रीभिश्च पुरुषा जिताः ..
ब्राह्मणाश्चापि वध्यन्ते म्लेच्छ राजन्यरूपिभिः .. 51 ..
15.1.m:
The paths of the Vedas are conquered by rogues, and men are conquered by women;
brahmins too are slain by those wearing the guise of kings who are foreigners.

15.1.s:
asminvilulitaprāye varṇāśramavivarjite ..
avilupte vedamārge kva viṣṇurbhagavāniti .. 52 ..
15.1.d:
अस्मिन्विलुलितप्राये वर्णाश्रमविवर्जिते ..
अविलुप्ते वेदमार्गे क्व विष्णुर्भगवानिति .. 52 ..
15.1.m:
In this [age] utterly confounded, devoid of caste and stage of life,
with the Vedic path obliterated, where is the blessed Lord Viṣṇu?

15.1.s:
vinā jñānādvinā dhyānādvinā ceṃdriyanigrahāt ..
prāpyate bhagavānyatra tadguhyaṃ kathayasva naḥ ..53..
15.1.d:
विना ज्ञानाद्विना ध्यानाद्विना चेंद्रियनिग्रहात् ..
प्राप्यते भगवान्यत्र तद्गुह्यं कथयस्व नः ..53..
15.1.m:
Without knowledge, without meditation, and without restraint of the senses,
where the Blessed Lord may be attained—tell us that secret!

15.1.s:
daityarāja tvamasmākaṃ suhṛnmārgapradarśakaḥ ..
kathayasva mahābhāga yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ .. 54 ..
15.1.d:
दैत्यराज त्वमस्माकं सुहृन्मार्गप्रदर्शकः ..
कथयस्व महाभाग यत्र तिष्ठति केशवः .. 54 ..
15.1.m:
O king of Daityas, you are our friend who shows the way.
Tell us, O illustrious one, where Keśava abides.”

15.1.s:
evaṃ sa dvijamukhyaiśca saṃpṛṣṭo daityasattamaḥ ..
praṇamya brāhmaṇānsarvānbhaktyā saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ .. 55 ..
15.1.d:
एवं स द्विजमुख्यैश्च संपृष्टो दैत्यसत्तमः ..
प्रणम्य ब्राह्मणान्सर्वान्भक्त्या संहृष्टमानसः .. 55 ..
15.1.m:
Thus questioned by the eminent twice-born, that best of Daityas,
having bowed to all the brahmins with devotion, with a heart overflowing with joy,

15.1.s:
sa namaskṛtya devebhyo brahmaṇe paramātmane ..
bhagavadbhaktiryuktaḥ sanvyāharttumupacakrame .. 56 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kalibhītamaharṣibhirbrahmavacanātprahlādasaṃnidhau kaliyuge bhagavatsthitiviṣaye praśnakaraṇavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 1 ..
15.1.d:
स नमस्कृत्य देवेभ्यो ब्रह्मणे परमात्मने ..
भगवद्भक्तिर्युक्तः सन्व्याहर्त्तुमुपचक्रमे .. 56 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये कलिभीतमहर्षिभिर्ब्रह्मवचनात्प्रह्लादसंनिधौ कलियुगे भगवत्स्थितिविषये प्रश्नकरणवर्णनंनाम प्रथमोऽध्यायः .. 1 ..
15.1.m:
bowing down to the gods and to Brahman, the Supreme Self,
endowed with devotion to the Blessed Lord, began to speak:
Thus ends the first chapter, named 'Description of the Inquiry regarding the Lord’s Abode in the Kali Age Made before Prahlāda by the Great Seers Terrified of Kali at the Word of Brahmā', in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [part] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [book] of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 1.

15.2.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
sarveṣāmapi bhūtānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām ..
bhavanto vai pūjyatamā devādīnāṃ tathaiva ca ..1..
15.2.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
सर्वेषामपि भूतानां दैत्यदानवरक्षसाम् ..
भवन्तो वै पूज्यतमा देवादीनां तथैव च ..1..
15.2.m: Prahlāda said: / Among all living beings, Daityas, Dānavas, and Rākṣasas, / you are indeed most worthy of worship, and so too among the gods and others.

15.2.s:
anujñayā tu yuṣmākaṃ prasādātkeśavasya hi ..
adhiṣṭhānaṃ bhagavataḥ kathayāmi nibodhata .. 2 ..
15.2.d:
अनुज्ञया तु युष्माकं प्रसादात्केशवस्य हि ..
अधिष्ठानं भगवतः कथयामि निबोधत .. 2 ..
15.2.m: By your permission, however, and indeed by the grace of Keśava, / I shall tell of the abode of the Lord; listen!

15.2.s:
paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya tiṣṭhati ..
kuśasthalīti yā pūrvaṃ kuśena sthāpitā purī .. 3 ..
15.2.d:
पश्चिमस्य समुद्रस्य तीरमाश्रित्य तिष्ठति ..
कुशस्थलीति या पूर्वं कुशेन स्थापिता पुरी .. 3 ..
15.2.m: Resting on the shore of the western ocean, / there stands the city known formerly as Kuśasthalī, founded by Kuśa.

15.2.s:
vahate gomatī yatra sāgareṇa samaṃtataḥ ..
dvārāvatīti sā viprā ānartteṣu prakīrttitā .. 4 ..
15.2.d:
वहते गोमती यत्र सागरेण समंततः ..
द्वारावतीति सा विप्रा आनर्त्तेषु प्रकीर्त्तिता .. 4 ..
15.2.m: Where the Gomatī flows into the ocean on every side, / that [city] is renowned among the Ānartas as Dvārāvatī, O brahmins.

15.2.s:
tasyāṃ vasati viśvātmā sarvakāmaprado hariḥ ..
kalā ṣoḍaśasaṃyukto mūrtiṃ dvādaśakānvitaḥ.. 5 ..
15.2.d:
तस्यां वसति विश्वात्मा सर्वकामप्रदो हरिः ..
कला षोडशसंयुक्तो मूर्तिं द्वादशकान्वितः.. 5 ..
15.2.m: In it dwells Hari, the Self of all, the granter of all desires, / endowed with sixteen digits [and] having twelve forms.

15.2.s:
tadeva paramaṃ dhāma tadeva paramaṃ padam ..
dvārakā sā ca vai dhanyā yatrā''ste madhusūdanaḥ .. 6 ..
15.2.d:
तदेव परमं धाम तदेव परमं पदम् ..
द्वारका सा च वै धन्या यत्रा'ऽस्ते मधुसूदनः .. 6 ..
15.2.m: That indeed is the supreme abode, that indeed is the supreme step. / Blessed indeed is that Dvārakā where Madhusūdana resides,

15.2.s:
yatra kṛṣṇaścaturbāhuḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ..
narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti tatra gatvā kalau yuge .. 7 ..
15.2.d:
यत्र कृष्णश्चतुर्बाहुः शंखचक्रगदाधरः ..
नरा मुक्तिं प्रयास्यंति तत्र गत्वा कलौ युगे .. 7 ..
15.2.m: where Kṛṣṇa is four-armed, holding the conch, discus, and mace. / Having gone there in the Kali age, men will attain liberation.

15.2.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ ..
vismayāviṣṭamanasasta- mūcurmunisattamāḥ .. 8 ..
15.2.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्य प्रह्लादस्य महात्मनः ..
विस्मयाविष्टमनसस्त- मूचुर्मुनिसत्तमाः .. 8 ..
15.2.m: Having heard those words of that great-souled Prahlāda, / the best of sages, their minds filled with wonder, said to him:

15.2.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
kṣayaṃ yadukule yāte bhāre copahṛte bhuvaḥ ..
prabhāse yādavaśreṣṭhaḥ svasthānamagamaddhariḥ .. 9 ..
15.2.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
क्षयं यदुकुले याते भारे चोपहृते भुवः ..
प्रभासे यादवश्रेष्ठः स्वस्थानमगमद्धरिः .. 9 ..
15.2.m: The seers said: / When the Yadu lineage met its destruction and the burden of the earth was removed, / Hari, the best of the Yādavas, went to his own abode at Prabhāsa.

15.2.s:
dvārāvatyā plāvitāyāṃ samaṃtātsāgareṇa hi ..
kathaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra kalau daitya prakīrtyate .. 7.4.2.10 ..
15.2.d:
द्वारावत्या प्लावितायां समंतात्सागरेण हि ..
कथं स भगवांस्तत्र कलौ दैत्य प्रकीर्त्यते .. 7.4.2.10 ..
15.2.m: When Dvārāvatī was inundated on all sides by the ocean, / how is that Lord said to be there in the Kali age, O Daitya?

15.2.s:
kathayasva suraśreṣṭha kathaṃ viṣṇurmahītale ..
sthitaścānarttaviṣaya etadvistarato vada.. 11..
15.2.d:
कथयस्व सुरश्रेष्ठ कथं विष्णुर्महीतले ..
स्थितश्चानर्त्तविषय एतद्विस्तरतो वद.. 11..
15.2.m: Tell [us], O best of gods, how Viṣṇu has remained on earth / in the territory of Ānarta; explain this in detail!

15.2.s:
ugrasene narapatau praśāsati vasundharām ..
kṛṣṇo yadupurīmetāṃ śobhayāmāsa sarvataḥ ..12..
15.2.d:
उग्रसेने नरपतौ प्रशासति वसुन्धराम् ..
कृष्णो यदुपुरीमेतां शोभयामास सर्वतः ..12..
15.2.m: While King Ugrasena was ruling the earth, / Kṛṣṇa embellished this city of the Yadus in every way.

15.2.s:
ramamāṇe ramānāthe rāmābhiramaṇe harau ..
ekadā tu samāsīne sabhāyāṃ yadusattame 13 ..
15.2.d:
रममाणे रमानाथे रामाभिरमणे हरौ ..
एकदा तु समासीने सभायां यदुसत्तमे 13 ..
15.2.m: While Hari, the Lord of Ramā, was sporting with women, / once, as that best of the Yadus was seated in the assembly,

15.2.s:
kathābhiḥ kriyamāṇābhirvicitrābhiranekadhā ..
uddhavaḥ kathayāmāsa pracāraṃ yadunaṃdanam .. 14 ..
15.2.d:
कथाभिः क्रियमाणाभिर्विचित्राभिरनेकधा ..
उद्धवः कथयामास प्रचारं यदुनंदनम् .. 14 ..
15.2.m: as various wondrous tales were being related in many ways, / Uddhava reported the movement [of a guest] to the delighter of the Yadus:

15.2.s:
yātrāyāmanusaṃprāptaṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam ..
sthitaṃ taṃ gomatītīre cakratīrthasamīpataḥ .. 15 ..
15.2.d:
यात्रायामनुसंप्राप्तं दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् ..
स्थितं तं गोमतीतीरे चक्रतीर्थसमीपतः .. 15 ..
15.2.m: "The sinless Durvāsas, having arrived on a pilgrimage, / is staying on the bank of the Gomatī near the Cakra sacred ford."

15.2.s:
tacchrutvā sahasotthāya bhagavānrukmiṇīgṛham ..
jagāma hṛṣṭamanasā viśvaśaktiradhokṣajaḥ .. 16 ..
15.2.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा सहसोत्थाय भगवान्रुक्मिणीगृहम् ..
जगाम हृष्टमनसा विश्वशक्तिरधोक्षजः .. 16 ..
15.2.m: Hearing that, the Lord Adhokṣaja, possessing the power of the universe, / rose up at once and went to Rukmiṇī's house with a glad mind.

15.2.s:
āgatyovāca vaidarbhīṃ saṃprāptamṛṣisattamam ..
taponirdhūta pāpmā'yamatriputro mahātapāḥ .. 17 ..
15.2.d:
आगत्योवाच वैदर्भीं संप्राप्तमृषिसत्तमम् ..
तपोनिर्धूत पाप्माऽयमत्रिपुत्रो महातपाः .. 17 ..
15.2.m: Having arrived, he said to the princess of Vidarbha: "The best of seers has arrived. / This son of Atri, of great austerities, has his sins shaken off by austerity.

15.2.s:
ātithyenārcito vipro dāsyate ca mahodayam..
gṛhiṇī na gṛhe yasya satpātrāgamanaṃ vṛthā .. 18 ..
15.2.d:
आतिथ्येनार्चितो विप्रो दास्यते च महोदयम्..
गृहिणी न गृहे यस्य सत्पात्रागमनं वृथा .. 18 ..
15.2.m: Honored with hospitality, the brahmin will grant great prosperity. / In whose house there is no housewife, the arrival of a worthy recipient is in vain.

15.2.s:
tasya devā na gṛhṇaṃti pitaraśca tathodakam..
tadāgacchasva gacchāmo nimaṃtrayitumatrijam .. 19 ..
15.2.d:
तस्य देवा न गृह्णंति पितरश्च तथोदकम्..
तदागच्छस्व गच्छामो निमंत्रयितुमत्रिजम् .. 19 ..
15.2.m: The gods and the ancestors do not accept his water. / Therefore come, let us go to invite the son of Atri."

15.2.s:
tathetyuktvā tu sā devī rathamāruruhe satī ..
rathamāruhya deveśo rukmiṇyā sahito hariḥ ..
jagāma tatra yatrāste durvāsā munisattamaḥ .. 7.4.2.20 ..
15.2.d:
तथेत्युक्त्वा तु सा देवी रथमारुरुहे सती ..
रथमारुह्य देवेशो रुक्मिण्या सहितो हरिः ..
जगाम तत्र यत्रास्ते दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः .. 7.4.2.20 ..
15.2.m: Having said, "So be it," that virtuous queen mounted the chariot. / Having mounted the chariot, Hari, the Lord of gods, together with Rukmiṇī, / went to where the best of sages, Durvāsas, was residing.

15.2.s:
dṛṣṭvā jvalaṃtaṃ tapasā kūle nadanadīpateḥ ..
kāpālikasya purataḥ susnātaṃ varasīkaraiḥ .. 21 ..
15.2.d:
दृष्ट्वा ज्वलंतं तपसा कूले नदनदीपतेः ..
कापालिकस्य पुरतः सुस्नातं वरसीकरैः .. 21 ..
15.2.m: Having seen him blazing with austerity on the shore of the lord of rivers, / in front of [the shrine of] Kāpālika, well bathed by the excellent spray,

15.2.s:
praṇamya bhagavānbhaktyā papracchā'nāmayaṃ tataḥ ..
paścādvidarbhatanayā rukmiṇī praṇanāma tam .. 22 ..
15.2.d:
प्रणम्य भगवान्भक्त्या पप्रच्छाऽनामयं ततः ..
पश्चाद्विदर्भतनया रुक्मिणी प्रणनाम तम् .. 22 ..
15.2.m: the Lord bowed with devotion and then inquired after his health. / Afterwards Rukmiṇī, the daughter of Vidarbha, bowed to him.

15.2.s:
durvāsāścāpi tau dṛṣṭvā darśanārthamupāgatau ..
papraccha kuśalaṃ tatra svāgatenābhinaṃdya ca ..23..
15.2.d:
दुर्वासाश्चापि तौ दृष्ट्वा दर्शनार्थमुपागतौ ..
पप्रच्छ कुशलं तत्र स्वागतेनाभिनंद्य च ..23..
15.2.m: And Durvāsas also, seeing the two arrived for darśana, / welcomed them with greetings and inquired about their welfare there.

15.2.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
kuśalaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvatra kutra vāsastavā'dhunā ..
kati dārā dhanāpatyametadvistarato vada .. 24 ..
15.2.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
कुशलं कृष्ण सर्वत्र कुत्र वासस्तवाऽधुना ..
कति दारा धनापत्यमेतद्विस्तरतो वद .. 24 ..
15.2.m: Durvāsas said: / Is all well with you everywhere, O Kṛṣṇa? Where is your residence now? / How many wives, how much wealth and offspring [do you have]? Tell this in detail!

15.2.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
samudreṇa pradattā me bhūbhirdvādaśayojanā ..
tasyāṃ nivasato brahmanpurī hemamayī mama .. 25 ..
15.2.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
समुद्रेण प्रदत्ता मे भूभिर्द्वादशयोजना ..
तस्यां निवसतो ब्रह्मन्पुरी हेममयी मम .. 25 ..
15.2.m: Glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / Twelve yojanas of land were given to me by the ocean. / In it, O brahmin, is my city made of gold, where I reside.

15.2.s:
prāsādāstatra sauvarṇā navalakṣāṇi saṃkhyayā ..
tasyāṃ vasāmi saṃhṛṣṭastvatprasādātsunirbhayaḥ .. 26 ..
15.2.d:
प्रासादास्तत्र सौवर्णा नवलक्षाणि संख्यया ..
तस्यां वसामि संहृष्टस्त्वत्प्रसादात्सुनिर्भयः .. 26 ..
15.2.m: There are nine hundred thousand golden palaces in number there; / I live in it rejoiced and completely fearless by your grace.

15.2.s:
tacchutvā vacanaṃ tasya vismayāviṣṭamānasaḥ ..
pratyuvāca sa durvāsāḥ prahasya madhusūdanam..27..
15.2.d:
तच्छुत्वा वचनं तस्य विस्मयाविष्टमानसः ..
प्रत्युवाच स दुर्वासाः प्रहस्य मधुसूदनम्..27..
15.2.m: Hearing those words of his, his mind filled with wonder, / that Durvāsas smiled and replied to Madhusūdana:

15.2.s:
vasaṃti tāvakā ye ca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā vadasva bhoḥ ..
yāvatyaśca mahiṣyaste putrāḥ parijanāstathā ..28..
15.2.d:
वसंति तावका ये च तेषां संख्या वदस्व भोः ..
यावत्यश्च महिष्यस्ते पुत्राः परिजनास्तथा ..28..
15.2.m: "Tell [me], good sir, the number of those people of yours who live there, / and how many wives, sons, and attendants you have."

15.2.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
brahmanṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ bhāryyāścāṣṭādhikā mama..
tāsāṃ madhye'bhīṣṭatamā vidarbhādhipateḥ sutā .. 29 ..
15.2.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
ब्रह्मन्षोडशसाहस्रं भार्य्याश्चाष्टाधिका मम..
तासां मध्येऽभीष्टतमा विदर्भाधिपतेः सुता .. 29 ..
15.2.m: Glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / O brahmin, I have sixteen thousand and eight wives. / Among them, the most beloved is the daughter of the king of Vidarbha.

15.2.s:
ekaikasyā daśa sutāḥ kanyā caikā tathā mune ..
ṣaṭpaṃcāśadyadūnāṃ tu koṭyaḥ parijano mama.. 7.4.2.30 ..
15.2.d:
एकैकस्या दश सुताः कन्या चैका तथा मुने ..
षट्पंचाशद्यदूनां तु कोट्यः परिजनो मम.. 7.4.2.30 ..
15.2.m: Each one has ten sons and one daughter, O sage. / Fifty-six crores of Yadus constitute my retinue,

15.2.s:
śeṣāḥ prakṛtayo brahmaṃsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate ..
tacchrutvā ciṃtayāmāsa kimetaditi vismitaḥ .. 31 ..
15.2.d:
शेषाः प्रकृतयो ब्रह्मंस्तेषां संख्या न विद्यते ..
तच्छ्रुत्वा चिंतयामास किमेतदिति विस्मितः .. 31 ..
15.2.m: and the remaining subjects, O brahmin—of them there is no reckoning. / Hearing that, he pondered, astonished, "What is this?"

15.2.s:
aho hyanaṃtavīryasya māyāmāśritya tiṣṭhataḥ ..
anaṃtā sarvakartṛtve pravṛttirdṛśyatāmiya m..32..
15.2.d:
अहो ह्यनंतवीर्यस्य मायामाश्रित्य तिष्ठतः ..
अनंता सर्वकर्तृत्वे प्रवृत्तिर्दृश्यतामिय म्..32..
15.2.m: "Ah, of him whose power is infinite, who abides relying on his māyā, / behold this infinite activity in his role as the doer of everything!"

15.2.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
svāgataṃ te mahābāho brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te ..
darśanena tvadīyena prītimeti ca me manaḥ..33..
15.2.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
स्वागतं ते महाबाहो ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते ..
दर्शनेन त्वदीयेन प्रीतिमेति च मे मनः..33..
15.2.m: Durvāsas said: / Welcome to you, O mighty-armed one! Tell me, what shall I do for you? / My mind attains delight by the darśana of you.

15.2.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca.. ..
yadi prasanno bhagavāṃstadāgacchasva me gṛham..
śirasā dhāryya pādāṃbu prayāsyāmi pavitratām.. 34..
15.2.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच.. ..
यदि प्रसन्नो भगवांस्तदागच्छस्व मे गृहम्..
शिरसा धार्य्य पादांबु प्रयास्यामि पवित्रताम्.. 34..
15.2.m: Glorious Kṛṣṇa said: / If the lord is pleased, then come to my house; / bearing the water of your feet upon my head, I shall attain purity.

15.2.s:
durvāsā uvāca..
akṣamāsārasarvasvaṃ kiṃ māṃ nayasi mādhava..
naya māṃ yadi madvākyaṃ karoṣi saha bhāryayā..35..
15.2.d:
दुर्वासा उवाच..
अक्षमासारसर्वस्वं किं मां नयसि माधव..
नय मां यदि मद्वाक्यं करोषि सह भार्यया..35..
15.2.m: Durvāsas said: / Why do you lead me, whose very essence is impatience, O Mādhava? / Take me, if you will carry out my word together with your wife!

15.2.s:
prahlāda uvāca..
evamastviti coktvā sa prasthitaḥ svarathena hi.
taṃ dṛṣṭvā prasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ prahasyovāca bhartsayan.. 36 ..
15.2.d:
प्रह्लाद उवाच..
एवमस्त्विति चोक्त्वा स प्रस्थितः स्वरथेन हि.
तं दृष्ट्वा प्रस्थितं विष्णुं प्रहस्योवाच भर्त्सयन्.. 36 ..
15.2.m: Prahlāda said: / Having said, "So be it," he departed in his own chariot. / Seeing Viṣṇu departed, [Durvāsas] laughed and said reproachfully:

15.2.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
durvāsasaṃ na jānāsi muñcemānhayasattamān ..
tvaṃ ca bhāryā tathā ceyaṃ vahataṃ svarathena mām .. 37 ..
15.2.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
दुर्वाससं न जानासि मुञ्चेमान्हयसत्तमान् ..
त्वं च भार्या तथा चेयं वहतं स्वरथेन माम् .. 37 ..

15.2.s:
..śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
bhagavanyathā prabravīṣi vipra kartāsmi tattathā ..
tvayā kṛpālunā brahmanpārito'haṃ sabāṃdhavaḥ.. 38 ..
15.2.d:
..श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
भगवन्यथा प्रब्रवीषि विप्र कर्तास्मि तत्तथा ..
त्वया कृपालुना ब्रह्मन्पारितोऽहं सबांधवः.. 38 ..
15.2.m:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
“O holy one, just as you say, O brahmin, so will I do.
By you, who are compassionate, O brāhmaṇa, I along with my kinsmen have been preserved.”

15.2.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca.. ..
tau tathā ṛṣivaryyo'sau yuktāṃ devīṃ rathe svake ..
tathaiva puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ yāhi yāhītyabhāṣata.. 39 ..
15.2.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच.. ..
तौ तथा ऋषिवर्य्योऽसौ युक्तां देवीं रथे स्वके ..
तथैव पुण्डरीकाक्षं याहि याहीत्यभाषत.. 39 ..
15.2.m:
Prahlāda said:
Seeing the two of them so—the goddess yoked to her own chariot,
and likewise the lotus-eyed one—that best of seers said: “Go! Go!”

15.2.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ sarvā vahamānaṃ rathaṃ harim ..
sādhusādhviti bhāṣaṃta ūcuḥ sarve parasparam .. 7.4.2.40 ..
15.2.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा देवताः सर्वा वहमानं रथं हरिम् ..
साधुसाध्विति भाषंत ऊचुः सर्वे परस्परम् .. 7.4.2.40 ..
15.2.m:
Seeing Hari bearing the chariot,
all the deities, saying “Well done! Well done!”, spoke to one another:

15.2.s:
aho brahmaṇyadevasya parāṃ bhaktiṃ prapaśyata ..
skandhe kṛtvā dhuraṃ yo hi vahate bhāryyayā saha .. 41 ..
15.2.d:
अहो ब्रह्मण्यदेवस्य परां भक्तिं प्रपश्यत ..
स्कन्धे कृत्वा धुरं यो हि वहते भार्य्यया सह .. 41 ..
15.2.m:
“Ah, behold the supreme devotion of the deity kind to brahmins,
who indeed, placing the yoke upon his shoulder, draws it along with his wife!”

15.2.s:
vikīryamāṇaḥ kusumaiḥ surasaṃghairjanārdanaḥ ..
jagāma sa rathaṃ gṛhya sabhāryo dvārakāṃ prati .. .. 42 ..
15.2.d:
विकीर्यमाणः कुसुमैः सुरसंघैर्जनार्दनः ..
जगाम स रथं गृह्य सभार्यो द्वारकां प्रति .. .. 42 ..
15.2.m:
Strewed with flowers by the hosts of gods, Janārdana,
taking the chariot along with his wife, set out toward Dvārakā.

15.2.s:
uhyamāne rathe tasminrukmiṇī tṛṣitā'bhavat ..
uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ vaidarbhī śramavyākulalocanā .. 43 ..
15.2.d:
उह्यमाने रथे तस्मिन्रुक्मिणी तृषिताऽभवत् ..
उवाच कृष्णं वैदर्भी श्रमव्याकुललोचना .. 43 ..
15.2.m:
As that chariot was being pulled along, Rukmiṇī became thirsty.
The daughter of Vidarbha, her eyes wild with exhaustion, spoke to Kṛṣṇa:

15.2.s:
śrāntā bhāraparikliṣṭā vahatī kopanaṃ dvijam ..
pāyayitvodakaṃ kānta naya māṃ mandiraṃ svakam .. 44 ..
15.2.d:
श्रान्ता भारपरिक्लिष्टा वहती कोपनं द्विजम् ..
पाययित्वोदकं कान्त नय मां मन्दिरं स्वकम् .. 44 ..
15.2.m:
“Fatigued, distressed by the burden of carrying the irascible twice-born one,
give me water to drink, beloved, and take me to your abode.”

15.2.s:
tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ pādākrāntyā dharātalāt ..
ānayāmāsa bhagavāngagāṃ tripathagāṃ śubhām .. 45 ..
15.2.d:
तच्छ्रुत्वा वचनं तस्याः पादाक्रान्त्या धरातलात् ..
आनयामास भगवान्गगां त्रिपथगां शुभाम् .. 45 ..
15.2.m:
Hearing her words, by striking the surface of the earth with his foot,
the Lord brought forth the auspicious Gaṅgā, the river of three courses.

15.2.s:
taddṛṣṭvā nirmalaṃ śītaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā ..
papau pipāsitā devī rukmiṇī jāhnavījalam .. 46..
15.2.d:
तद्दृष्ट्वा निर्मलं शीतं सुगंधं पावनं तथा ..
पपौ पिपासिता देवी रुक्मिणी जाह्नवीजलम् .. 46..
15.2.m:
Seeing that clear, cool, fragrant, and purifying water of the Jāhnavī,
the thirsty goddess Rukmiṇī drank [it].

15.2.s:
pītaṃ tayā jalaṃ dṛṣṭvā cukopa ṛṣisattamaḥ ..
jajvāla jvalanaprakhyaḥ śaśāpa parameśvarīm .. 47 ..
15.2.d:
पीतं तया जलं दृष्ट्वा चुकोप ऋषिसत्तमः ..
जज्वाल ज्वलनप्रख्यः शशाप परमेश्वरीम् .. 47 ..
15.2.m:
Seeing that the water was drunk by her, the best of seers became enraged.
Blazing like fire, he cursed the supreme goddess:

15.2.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca ..
māmapṛṣṭvā jalaṃ yasmātpītavatyasi rukmiṇī..
tasmātpānaratā nityaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ.. 48..
15.2.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच ..
मामपृष्ट्वा जलं यस्मात्पीतवत्यसि रुक्मिणी..
तस्मात्पानरता नित्यं भविष्यसि न संशयः.. 48..
15.2.m:
Durvāsas said:
“Because you drank water without asking me, O Rukmiṇī,
therefore you will constantly be devoted to drinking [intoxicants]; there is no doubt.

15.2.s:
aviyuktā rathādyasmānmāmapṛṣṭvā jalaṃ tvayā..
pītaṃ tasmācca kṛṣṇena viyuktā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi .. 49 ..
15.2.d:
अवियुक्ता रथाद्यस्मान्मामपृष्ट्वा जलं त्वया..
पीतं तस्माच्च कृष्णेन वियुक्ता त्वं भविष्यसि .. 49 ..
15.2.m:
Because water was drunk by you without being unhitched from the chariot and without asking me,
therefore you will become separated from Kṛṣṇa.”

15.2.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ ..
parityajya rathaṃ vipro bhūmāvevāvatiṣṭhati .. 7.4.2.50 ..
15.2.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनः ..
परित्यज्य रथं विप्रो भूमावेवावतिष्ठति .. 7.4.2.50 ..
15.2.m:
Prahlāda said:
Having spoken just these words, his eyes reddened with fury,
the brahmin abandoned the chariot and stood upon the ground.

15.2.s:
evaṃ śaptā tadā devī rudodātīva vihvalā ..
uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ karuṇaṃ kathaṃ sthāsye tvayā vinā .. 51 ..
15.2.d:
एवं शप्ता तदा देवी रुदोदातीव विह्वला ..
उवाच कृष्णं करुणं कथं स्थास्ये त्वया विना .. 51 ..
15.2.m:
Thus cursed at that time, the goddess, exceedingly perturbed, wept,
and plaintively said to Kṛṣṇa: “How shall I stay without you?”

15.2.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
āyāsye pratyahaṃ devi dvikālaṃ bhavanaṃ tava ..
yo māṃ paśyati cātrasthaṃ sa tvāmeva prapaśyati .. 52 ..
15.2.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
आयास्ये प्रत्यहं देवि द्विकालं भवनं तव ..
यो मां पश्यति चात्रस्थं स त्वामेव प्रपश्यति .. 52 ..
15.2.m:
The venerable Kṛṣṇa said:
“I will come daily, O goddess, twice a day, to your abode.
Whoever sees me situated here, sees only you.

15.2.s:
māṃ hi dṛṣṭvā naro yastu tvāṃ na paśyati bhaktitaḥ ..
arddhṃ yātrā phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ .. 53 ..
15.2.d:
मां हि दृष्ट्वा नरो यस्तु त्वां न पश्यति भक्तितः ..
अर्द्ध्ं यात्रा फलं तस्य भविष्यति न संशयः .. 53 ..
15.2.m:
For that person who, having seen me, does not behold you with devotion,
half the fruit of his pilgrimage will perish; of this there is no doubt.”

15.2.s:
āśvāsya ca priyāmevaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yadunandanaḥ ..
tataḥ prasādayāmāsa durvāsasamakalmaṣam .. 54 ..
15.2.d:
आश्वास्य च प्रियामेवं ब्राह्मणं यदुनन्दनः ..
ततः प्रसादयामास दुर्वाससमकल्मषम् .. 54 ..
15.2.m:
Having thus comforted his beloved, the delight of the Yadus
then propitiated the sinless brahmin Durvāsas.

15.2.s:
bāhyo pavanamadhye tu pūjayāmāsa taṃ tathā ..
avanijya svayaṃ pādau viprapādāvanejanam ..
dhārayāmāsa śirasā jagataḥ pāvano hariḥ .. 55 ..
15.2.d:
बाह्यो पवनमध्ये तु पूजयामास तं तथा ..
अवनिज्य स्वयं पादौ विप्रपादावनेजनम् ..
धारयामास शिरसा जगतः पावनो हरिः .. 55 ..

15.2.s:
dattvārghyaṃ gāṃ ca viprāya madhuparkaṃ sa bhaktitaḥ ..
vidhivadbhojayāmāsa ṣaḍrasena dvijottamam .. 56 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye durvāso dvārakānayana durvāsodatta rukmiṇīśāpavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ..2..
15.2.d:
दत्त्वार्घ्यं गां च विप्राय मधुपर्कं स भक्तितः ..
विधिवद्भोजयामास षड्रसेन द्विजोत्तमम् .. 56 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये दुर्वासो द्वारकानयन दुर्वासोदत्त रुक्मिणीशापवृत्तान्तवर्णनं नाम द्वितीयोऽध्यायः..2..
15.2.m:
Having offered water of respect, a cow, and a honey-mixture to the brahmin with devotion,
he fed the best of the twice-born with six flavors according to the rule.
Thus ends the second chapter, titled “The Description of the Bringing of Durvāsas to Dvārakā and the Curse Bestowed on Rukmiṇī by Durvāsas”, in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, the fourth [sub-section] of the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, the seventh [part] of the eighty-one-thousand-verse collection in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa.

15.3.s:
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ..
aho brahmaṇyadevasya kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ ..
mahimā yadayaṃ naiva mṛṣā cakre munervacaḥ .. 1 ..
15.3.d:
ऋषय ऊचुः..
अहो ब्रह्मण्यदेवस्य कृष्णस्यामिततेजसः ..
महिमा यदयं नैव मृषा चक्रे मुनेर्वचः .. 1 ..
15.3.m:
The seers said:
“Ah, the majesty of Kṛṣṇa of boundless splendor, the deity kind to brahmins,
since he in no way rendered false the seer's word!

15.3.s:
tena cakre na roṣaṃ sa setupālo janārdanaḥ ..
bhṛgoryaścaraṇāghātaṃ dadhāra hṛdi lāñchanam .. 2 ..
15.3.d:
तेन चक्रे न रोषं स सेतुपालो जनार्दनः ..
भृगोर्यश्चरणाघातं दधार हृदि लाञ्छनम् .. 2 ..
15.3.m:
Therefore Janārdana, the protector of order, bore no anger;
he who bore the kick of Bhṛgu’s foot upon his chest as an adornment.

15.3.s:
sā tu devī kathaṃ tena preyasā viprayojitā ..
ekākinī sthitā tatra kathyatāmasureśvara .. 3 ..
15.3.d:
सा तु देवी कथं तेन प्रेयसा विप्रयोजिता ..
एकाकिनी स्थिता तत्र कथ्यतामसुरेश्वर .. 3 ..
15.3.m:
Yet how did that goddess, separated from her beloved,
remain there alone? Tell [us], O lord of the Asuras.

15.3.s:
utkaṇṭhitā ati vayaṃ śrotuṃ dvāravatīṃ mudā ..
idamādau bubhutsāmaścittakhedāpanuttaye .. 4 ..
15.3.d:
उत्कण्ठिता अति वयं श्रोतुं द्वारवतीं मुदा ..
इदमादौ बुभुत्सामश्चित्तखेदापनुत्तये .. 4 ..
15.3.m:
We are exceedingly eager to hear with joy about Dvāravatī;
we wish to learn this first, for dispelling distress of mind.”

15.3.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ...
śrūyatāmṛṣayaḥ sarve gadato mama vistarāt ..
yathā śāpodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ mumoca harivallabhā ..5..
15.3.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ...
श्रूयतामृषयः सर्वे गदतो मम विस्तरात् ..
यथा शापोद्भवं दुःखं मुमोच हरिवल्लभा ..5..
15.3.m:
Prahlāda said:
“Listen, all seers, as I speak in detail
of how the beloved of Hari relinquished the sorrow born of the curse.

15.3.s:
atha durvāsasaḥ śāpamavāpyāruntudaṃ tadā..
yādavendrasya gṛhiṇī sahasā paryadevayat ..6.. ..
15.3.d:
अथ दुर्वाससः शापमवाप्यारुन्तुदं तदा..
यादवेन्द्रस्य गृहिणी सहसा पर्यदेवयत् ..6.. ..
15.3.m:
Then, having incurred the agonising curse of Durvāsas,
the mistress of the lord of the Yādavas immediately lamented:

15.3.s:
.. rukmiṇyuvāca .. ..
kalyāṇī bata vāṇīyaṃ laukikī saṃvibhāvyate ..
kūpake caiva sindhau ca pramāṇānnādhikaṃ jalam .. 7 ..
15.3.d:
.. रुक्मिण्युवाच .. ..
कल्याणी बत वाणीयं लौकिकी संविभाव्यते ..
कूपके चैव सिन्धौ च प्रमाणान्नाधिकं जलम् .. 7 ..
15.3.m:
Rukmiṇī said:
‘Ah, this worldly saying is rightly understood as auspicious:
in a small well as in the ocean, water does not exceed its measure.

15.3.s:
yāsāhaṃ bhūribhāgyā vai prāpya nāthaṃ jagatpatim..
iyamekākinī jātā paulastyāddevahelanāt .. 8 ..
15.3.d:
यासाहं भूरिभाग्या वै प्राप्य नाथं जगत्पतिम्..
इयमेकाकिनी जाता पौलस्त्याद्देवहेलनात् .. 8 ..
15.3.m:
I, who, being of great fortune, attained the protector, the lord of the universe,
have become this solitary one through slighting a god, just like [Sītā] from the descendant of Pulastya.

15.3.s:
kva maṃgalālayaḥ śrīmānanavadyaguṇo hariḥ ..
alpapuṇyā susaṃbādhā kāminī kvāticañcalā .. 9 ..
15.3.d:
क्व मंगलालयः श्रीमाननवद्यगुणो हरिः ..
अल्पपुण्या सुसंबाधा कामिनी क्वातिचञ्चला .. 9 ..
15.3.m:
Where is Hari, the abode of auspiciousness, glorious, endowed with flawless virtues,
and where am I, a woman of little merit, exceedingly distressed, and most fickle?

15.3.s:
tathāpi ghaṭayāmāsa dhātā vaṃcanakovidaḥ ..
vidhānamaśubhāyā me viyogaviṣamavyatham .. 7.4.3.10 ..
15.3.d:
तथापि घटयामास धाता वंचनकोविदः ..
विधानमशुभाया मे वियोगविषमव्यथम् .. 7.4.3.10 ..
15.3.m:
Even so, the Creator, skilled in deceit,
arranged for unblest me the decree whose pain is the poison of separation.

15.3.s:
anyathā varṇaguravaḥ snātāstraividyavartmani ..
kathaṃ nu śaptumarhanti svayaṃ khinnāmanāgasam .. 11 ..
15.3.d:
अन्यथा वर्णगुरवः स्नातास्त्रैविद्यवर्त्मनि ..
कथं नु शप्तुमर्हन्ति स्वयं खिन्नामनागसम् .. 11 ..
15.3.m:
Otherwise, how could the teachers of the classes, bathed in the path of the three Vedas,
ever be fit to curse me, who was weary herself and innocent?

15.3.s:
vidadhe vajramayaṃ tu kiṃ nvidaṃ hṛdayaṃ me'tikaṭhorameva hi ..
śatadhā na vidīryate yato virahe durviṣahe madhudviṣaḥ .. 12 ..
15.3.d:
विदधे वज्रमयं तु किं न्विदं हृदयं मेऽतिकठोरमेव हि ..
शतधा न विदीर्यते यतो विरहे दुर्विषहे मधुद्विषः .. 12 ..
15.3.m:
Did [the Creator] indeed fashion this heart of mine out of adamantine thunderbolt, so very hard,
since it does not shatter into a hundred pieces in the unbearable separation from the enemy of Madhu?

15.3.s:
adhikṛtya suduścaraṃ tapaḥ pratilabdhaḥ prathamaṃ mayātmajaḥ ..
tanayena vinākṛtā'pyahaṃ na mṛtā paṃcasu vāsareṣviha .. 13 ..
15.3.d:
अधिकृत्य सुदुश्चरं तपः प्रतिलब्धः प्रथमं मयात्मजः ..
तनयेन विनाकृताऽप्यहं न मृता पंचसु वासरेष्विह .. 13 ..
15.3.m:
Having undertaken severe austerity, a son was first obtained by me;
yet, deprived of that son, I did not die within five days in this world.

15.3.s:
upalabhya sudāruṇāmimāmapi pīḍāmavitāsmyahaṃ tadā ..
yadidaṃ vidhunoti kalmaṣaṃ khalu tanmāṃ samupetya lakṣavṛddhim .. 14 ..
15.3.d:
उपलभ्य सुदारुणामिमामपि पीडामवितास्म्यहं तदा ..
यदिदं विधुनोति कल्मषं खलु तन्मां समुपेत्य लक्षवृद्धिम् .. 14 ..
15.3.m:
Having experienced even this very severe affliction, I shall be preserved then,
because this sin, which surely shakes me, has reached a hundred-thousand-fold increase.

15.3.s:
iti sā'tivilapya duḥkhitārthā kurarītulyatayā śuśoca vegāt ..
viraheṇa vighūrṇitāśayā dvijaśāpāpahatā mumūrccha sadyaḥ .. 15 ..
15.3.d:
इति साऽतिविलप्य दुःखितार्था कुररीतुल्यतया शुशोच वेगात् ..
विरहेण विघूर्णिताशया द्विजशापापहता मुमूर्च्छ सद्यः .. 15 ..
15.3.m:
Having thus lamented exceedingly, being afflicted, she grieved violently like an osprey;
her mind reeling with separation, struck by the twice-born's curse, she fainted at once.

15.3.s:
atha durvāsasā śaptā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā ..
mūrcchanāmāpa tatraiva hyājagāma payonidhiḥ .. 16 ..
15.3.d:
अथ दुर्वाससा शप्ता रुक्मिणी कृष्णवल्लभा ..
मूर्च्छनामाप तत्रैव ह्याजगाम पयोनिधिः .. 16 ..
15.3.m:
Then, cursed by Durvāsas, Rukmiṇī, the beloved of Kṛṣṇa,
fell into a swoon right there, and the Ocean of Waters arrived.

15.3.s:
sudhāśīkaragarbheṇa padmakiṃjalkavāyunā ..
nyavījayadimāṃ devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām.. 17 ..
15.3.d:
सुधाशीकरगर्भेण पद्मकिंजल्कवायुना ..
न्यवीजयदिमां देवीं रुक्मिणीं कृष्णवल्लभाम्.. 17 ..
15.3.m:
With a breeze from the lotus-filaments holding drops of nectar,
he fanned this goddess Rukmiṇī, the beloved of Kṛṣṇa.

15.3.s:
etasminnantare tatra vyomamārgeṇa nāradaḥ ..
gāyanguṇānbhagavato vīṇāpāṇiḥ samāgataḥ .. 18 ..
15.3.d:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे तत्र व्योममार्गेण नारदः ..
गायन्गुणान्भगवतो वीणापाणिः समागतः .. 18 ..
15.3.m:
In the meantime, Nārada, holding a vīṇā in his hand,
came through the celestial path, singing the praises of the Lord.

15.3.s:
sa dṛṣṭvā siṃdhunā''śvāsyamānāṃ viśvasya mātaram ..
avatīrya śrutakatho bodhayāmāsa nāradaḥ .. 19 ..
15.3.d:
स दृष्ट्वा सिंधुना'ऽश्वास्यमानां विश्वस्य मातरम् ..
अवतीर्य श्रुतकथो बोधयामास नारदः .. 19 ..
15.3.m:
Seeing the mother of the universe being comforted by the Ocean,
Nārada, having descended, having heard the account, awakened her.

15.3.s:
.. nārada uvāca .. ..
mā khedaṃ deva deveśi devi tvadadhipe patau ..
dūrīkṛte vipraśāpātkuru kalyāṇi dhīratām .. 7.4.3.20 ..
15.3.d:
.. नारद उवाच .. ..
मा खेदं देव देवेशि देवि त्वदधिपे पतौ ..
दूरीकृते विप्रशापात्कुरु कल्याणि धीरताम् .. 7.4.3.20 ..
15.3.m:
Nārada said:
Do not grieve, O goddess, queen of gods, O divine one, over your lord and husband / being separated from you by the curse of a brahmin; take courage, O auspicious one!

15.3.s:
tvaṃ hi sākṣādbhagavatī kṛṣṇaśca puruṣottamaḥ ..
avatīrṇo dharābhāramapanetuṃ yadṛcchayā .. 21 ..
15.3.d:
त्वं हि साक्षाद्भगवती कृष्णश्च पुरुषोत्तमः ..
अवतीर्णो धराभारमपनेतुं यदृच्छया .. 21 ..
15.3.m: For you are the Goddess incarnate, and Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Person, / descended by his own free will to remove the earth's burden.

15.3.s:
devo hyasau paraṃ brahma sadā'nirviṇṇamānasaḥ ..
māyāśaktistvametasya sargasthityantakāriṇaḥ .. 22 ..
15.3.d:
देवो ह्यसौ परं ब्रह्म सदाऽनिर्विण्णमानसः ..
मायाशक्तिस्त्वमेतस्य सर्गस्थित्यन्तकारिणः .. 22 ..
15.3.m: For this god is the supreme Brahman, whose mind is ever unperturbed; / and you are the power of illusion belonging to him, the maker of creation, preservation, and dissolution.

15.3.s:
saṃhṛtya nikhilaṃ śete yayā'sau kalayā svarāṭ ..
tadāpi na viyujyeta tvayā viśvapatiḥ prabhuḥ .. 23 ..
15.3.d:
संहृत्य निखिलं शेते ययाऽसौ कलया स्वराट् ..
तदापि न वियुज्येत त्वया विश्वपतिः प्रभुः .. 23 ..
15.3.m: Even when, having drawn everything back in, that self-ruling lord sleeps by his portion, / even then the almighty lord of the universe is never separated from you.

15.3.s:
aviyuktastvayā nityaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ ..
līlāvatāreṣvetasya sarveṣu tvaṃ sahāyinī .. 24 ..
15.3.d:
अवियुक्तस्त्वया नित्यं देवदेवो जगत्पतिः ..
लीलावतारेष्वेतस्य सर्वेषु त्वं सहायिनी .. 24 ..
15.3.m: The god of gods, the lord of the world, is never separated from you; / in all his playful incarnations, you are his companion.

15.3.s:
yogaṃ viyogaṃ ca tathā na yātyeṣa tvayā'naghe ..
viḍaṃbayati bhūtānāmupakārāya ceśvaraḥ .. 25 ..
15.3.d:
योगं वियोगं च तथा न यात्येष त्वयाऽनघे ..
विडंबयति भूतानामुपकाराय चेश्वरः .. 25 ..
15.3.m: O sinless one, he undergoes neither union nor separation from you; / the Lord merely feigns this for the benefit of living beings.

15.3.s:
ārādhanīyāḥ satataṃ bhūdevā bhūtimīpsatā ..
prakopanīyā naivaite tattvajñā hi tapasvinaḥ .. 26 ..
15.3.d:
आराधनीयाः सततं भूदेवा भूतिमीप्सता ..
प्रकोपनीया नैवैते तत्त्वज्ञा हि तपस्विनः .. 26 ..
15.3.m: One who desires prosperity should always honor the gods on earth; / these ascetics who know the truth must never be angered.

15.3.s:
ityevaṃ śikṣayam̐llokaṃ viyogaṃ te'numanyate ..
muni śāpāddhariḥ sākṣādgūḍhaḥ kapaṭamānuṣaḥ .. 27..
15.3.d:
इत्येवं शिक्षयम्̐ल्लोकं वियोगं तेऽनुमन्यते ..
मुनि शापाद्धरिः साक्षाद्गूढः कपटमानुषः .. 27..
15.3.m: Thus instructing the world, Hari, directly manifest though disguised as a human, / accepts separation from you because of a sage's curse.

15.3.s:
api smarasi kalyāṇi jāto raghukule svayam..
lokānugrahamanvicchanbhūbhāraharaṇotsukaḥ .. 28 ..
15.3.d:
अपि स्मरसि कल्याणि जातो रघुकुले स्वयम्..
लोकानुग्रहमन्विच्छन्भूभारहरणोत्सुकः .. 28 ..
15.3.m: Do you not remember, O auspicious one, when he was born himself into Raghu's clan, / seeking to show grace to the world and eager to remove the earth's burden?

15.3.s:
taṃ hariṃ jagatāmīśaṃ rukmiṇi tvaṃ na vetsi kim..
prāṇebhyo'pi garīyāṃsamayaṃ devaḥ sa eva hi .. 29 ..
15.3.d:
तं हरिं जगतामीशं रुक्मिणि त्वं न वेत्सि किम्..
प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयांसमयं देवः स एव हि .. 29 ..
15.3.m: Do you not recognize that Hari, the lord of the worlds, O Rukmiṇī, / who is dearer to you than life itself? This god is indeed that very one!

15.3.s:
yenedaṃ pūritaṃ viśvaṃ bahirantaśca suvrate ..
asaṃgasya vibhoḥ saṃgaḥ kathaṃ syāditi manmatiḥ .. 7.4.3.30 ..
15.3.d:
येनेदं पूरितं विश्वं बहिरन्तश्च सुव्रते ..
असंगस्य विभोः संगः कथं स्यादिति मन्मतिः .. 7.4.3.30 ..
15.3.m: By him this whole universe is pervaded inside and out, O lady of good vows; / how could there be attachment or detachment for that all-pervading, unattached Lord? Such is my thought.

15.3.s:
tayā tvayā niyukto'sāviti pratyemi sarvaśaḥ ..
tadvimuñcā''dhimatyarthamātmānamanusaṃsmara..
prasīda mātaḥ saṃdhehi dhīratāṃ svamanīṣayā .. 31 ..
15.3.d:
तया त्वया नियुक्तोऽसाविति प्रत्येमि सर्वशः ..
तद्विमुञ्चा'ऽधिमत्यर्थमात्मानमनुसंस्मर..
प्रसीद मातः संधेहि धीरतां स्वमनीषया .. 31 ..
15.3.m: I fully understand that he was directed by you in this way. / Therefore abandon this excessive mental anguish and remember your true self. / Be gracious, O Mother; compose yourself with courage through your own wisdom!

15.3.s:
iti bruvati devarṣāvavasāne nadīpatiḥ ..
provāca vacanaṃ tasyai vācā mṛdusuvarṇayā .. 32 .. ..
15.3.d:
इति ब्रुवति देवर्षाववसाने नदीपतिः ..
प्रोवाच वचनं तस्यै वाचा मृदुसुवर्णया .. 32 .. ..
15.3.m: When the celestial seer had spoken thus to the end, the lord of rivers / addressed words to her in a gentle and charming voice:

15.3.s:
.. samudra uvāca .. ..
yadāha devi devarṣirnatvā tvāṃ satyameva tat ..
gīyase tvaṃ hi vedeṣu nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ sahāyinī .. 33 ..
15.3.d:
.. समुद्र उवाच .. ..
यदाह देवि देवर्षिर्नत्वा त्वां सत्यमेव तत् ..
गीयसे त्वं हि वेदेषु नित्यं विष्णुः सहायिनी .. 33 ..
15.3.m:
The Ocean said:
What the celestial seer has said, having bowed to you, O goddess, is entirely true; / for you are sung in the Vedas as the eternal companion of Viṣṇu.

15.3.s:
paraḥ pumāneva nirastavigraho gūḍho'dhipaste vidadhāti bhūyaḥ ..
viśvaṃ vyavasthāpayati svarociṣā tvayā sahāyena bibharti mūrtim .. 34 ..
15.3.d:
परः पुमानेव निरस्तविग्रहो गूढोऽधिपस्ते विदधाति भूयः ..
विश्वं व्यवस्थापयति स्वरोचिषा त्वया सहायेन बिभर्ति मूर्तिम् .. 34 ..
15.3.m: The Supreme Person himself, devoid of material form, your hidden lord, creates again and again; / he orders the universe by his own light, and bearing a form, has you as his companion.

15.3.s:
tadeṣa parikhedaste na manāgapi yujyate ..
vakṣaḥsthalasthā bhavatī nityaṃ śrīvatsalakṣmaṇaḥ .. 35 ..
15.3.d:
तदेष परिखेदस्ते न मनागपि युज्यते ..
वक्षःस्थलस्था भवती नित्यं श्रीवत्सलक्ष्मणः .. 35 ..
15.3.m: Therefore, this grief of yours is not at all appropriate, / since you dwell eternally on the chest of the one marked with the śrīvatsa.

15.3.s:
iyaṃ bhāgīrathī devī madādeśādupāgatā ..
vinodayiṣyatyaniśaṃ tvāṃ hi devi śarīriṇī .. 36 ..
15.3.d:
इयं भागीरथी देवी मदादेशादुपागता ..
विनोदयिष्यत्यनिशं त्वां हि देवि शरीरिणी .. 36 ..
15.3.m: This divine goddess Bhāgīrathī, who has arrived at my command, / will constantly divert you, O goddess, in bodily form.

15.3.s:
etasyāḥ syānmṛdu svādu payaḥ pūropaśobhitam ..
pradeśo'yamaśeṣo'pi bhavitā tvatsukhapradaḥ .. 37 ..
15.3.d:
एतस्याः स्यान्मृदु स्वादु पयः पूरोपशोभितम् ..
प्रदेशोऽयमशेषोऽपि भविता त्वत्सुखप्रदः .. 37 ..
15.3.m: Her water shall be soft and sweet, adorned with overflowing streams; / this entire region shall bring about your happiness.

15.3.s:
nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nikuṃjairupaśobhitam ..
mātaṃgaiśca samājuṣṭaṃ maṃjuguṃjanmadhuvratam.. 38 ..
15.3.d:
नानाद्रुमलताकीर्णं निकुंजैरुपशोभितम् ..
मातंगैश्च समाजुष्टं मंजुगुंजन्मधुव्रतम्.. 38 ..
15.3.m: Abounding in various trees and creepers, adorned with bowers, / frequented by elephants, with bees sweetly humming,

15.3.s:
navapallavabhaṅgībhiḥ kusumastabakaiḥ śubhaiḥ ..
phalairamṛtakalpaiśca maṃjarī rājibhistathā .. 39 ..
15.3.d:
नवपल्लवभङ्गीभिः कुसुमस्तबकैः शुभैः ..
फलैरमृतकल्पैश्च मंजरी राजिभिस्तथा .. 39 ..
15.3.m: with the graceful curves of fresh sprouts, with auspicious clusters of blossoms, / with fruits akin to nectar, and likewise with rows of flower-spikes,

15.3.s:
naṃdanasya śriyā juṣṭaṃ manonayananandanam..
vanaṃ ramyataraṃ cātra hyacireṇa bhaviṣyati .. 7.4.3.40 ..
15.3.d:
नंदनस्य श्रिया जुष्टं मनोनयननन्दनम्..
वनं रम्यतरं चात्र ह्यचिरेण भविष्यति .. 7.4.3.40 ..
15.3.m: endowed with the splendor of the Nandana garden, delighting mind and eye, / a most delightful forest will very soon arise here.

15.3.s:
tvayā saṃbodhanīyāḥ sma vayaṃ mātaḥ sadaiva hi ..
agamyarūpā vidyā tvamasmābhirbodhyase katham .. 41 ..
15.3.d:
त्वया संबोधनीयाः स्म वयं मातः सदैव हि ..
अगम्यरूपा विद्या त्वमस्माभिर्बोध्यसे कथम् .. 41 ..
15.3.m: It is we who ought always to be enlightened by you, O Mother; / how can you, knowledge whose form is incomprehensible, be instructed by us?

15.3.s:
tadā vāmanujānīhi prasīda parameśvari ..
namaste viśvajanani bhūyo 'pi ca namonamaḥ .. 42 ..
15.3.d:
तदा वामनुजानीहि प्रसीद परमेश्वरि ..
नमस्ते विश्वजननि भूयो ऽपि च नमोनमः .. 42 ..
15.3.m: Therefore give us leave; be gracious, O supreme goddess! / Homage to you, mother of the universe; again and again, homage, homage!

15.3.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā jagaddhātrīṃ jagmatustau yathāgatam ..
ājagāma ca tatraiva devī bhāgīrathī svayam .. 43 ..
15.3.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा जगद्धात्रीं जग्मतुस्तौ यथागतम् ..
आजगाम च तत्रैव देवी भागीरथी स्वयम् .. 43 ..
15.3.m:
Prahlāda said:
Having spoken thus to the mother of the world, those two departed as they had come; / and there the goddess Bhāgīrathī herself arrived.

15.3.s:
vanaṃ samabhavattatra divyabhūruhasevitam ..
sevyaṃ samastalokānāṃ phalapuṣpasamṛddhimat ... 44 ..
15.3.d:
वनं समभवत्तत्र दिव्यभूरुहसेवितम् ..
सेव्यं समस्तलोकानां फलपुष्पसमृद्धिमत् ... 44 ..
15.3.m: A forest arose there, frequented by celestial trees, / worthy to be resorted to by all people, rich in fruits and flowers.

15.3.s:
prasādena ca bhūtānāṃ gaṃgā'śeṣāghahāriṇī ..
bhūṣayāmāsa taddeśaṃ sā ca viṣṇupadī sarit .. 45..
15.3.d:
प्रसादेन च भूतानां गंगाऽशेषाघहारिणी ..
भूषयामास तद्देशं सा च विष्णुपदी सरित् .. 45..
15.3.m: And by her grace toward living beings, the Gaṅgā, who removes all sin, / that river flowing from the foot of Viṣṇu, adorned that region.

15.3.s:
devo ca munivākyena gaṃgāyāśca vinodanāt ..
saundaryā tasya deśasya kiñcitsvāsthyamavāpa ha .. 46 ..
15.3.d:
देवो च मुनिवाक्येन गंगायाश्च विनोदनात् ..
सौन्दर्या तस्य देशस्य किञ्चित्स्वास्थ्यमवाप ह .. 46 ..
15.3.m: And the goddess, through the sage's words, the diversion of the Gaṅgā, / and the beauty of that region, attained a measure of peace.

15.3.s:
atha viṣṇupadīṃ devīṃ śrutvā sāgarasaṃgatām ..
itastataḥ samājagmuḥ śraddadhānāḥ payasvinīm ..47..
15.3.d:
अथ विष्णुपदीं देवीं श्रुत्वा सागरसंगताम् ..
इतस्ततः समाजग्मुः श्रद्दधानाः पयस्विनीम् ..47..
15.3.m: Then, hearing of that divine river flowing from the foot of Viṣṇu, joined to the ocean, / devout people came from here and there to that milk-sweet stream.

15.3.s:
dvārakāvāsinaścaiva janāḥ kānanaśobhayā ..
hṛṣṭacittāḥ samājagmuraniśaṃ rukmiṇīvanam ..48..
15.3.d:
द्वारकावासिनश्चैव जनाः काननशोभया ..
हृष्टचित्ताः समाजग्मुरनिशं रुक्मिणीवनम् ..48..
15.3.m: And the inhabitants of Dvārakā, their hearts delighted by the beauty of the woods, / came continually to the forest of Rukmiṇī.

15.3.s:
śrutvā tadakhilaṃ sarvaṃ durvāsāḥ śāṃbhavī kalā ..
cukopa smayamānaśca bhūya etadabhāṣata .. 49 ..
15.3.d:
श्रुत्वा तदखिलं सर्वं दुर्वासाः शांभवी कला ..
चुकोप स्मयमानश्च भूय एतदभाषत .. 49 ..
15.3.m: Hearing all that, Durvāsas, a portion of Śiva, / grew enraged and, smiling [bitterly], spoke this further:

15.3.s:
.. durvāsā uvāca .. ..
kaḥ prabhustriṣu lokeṣu mahyaṃ vacanamanyathā ..
vidhātumapi devānāmādyo lokapitāmahaḥ .. 7.4.3.50 ..
15.3.d:
.. दुर्वासा उवाच .. ..
कः प्रभुस्त्रिषु लोकेषु मह्यं वचनमन्यथा ..
विधातुमपि देवानामाद्यो लोकपितामहः .. 7.4.3.50 ..
15.3.m:
Durvāsas said:
Who in the three worlds has the power to alter my word, / even the first of the gods, the grandfather of the worlds?

15.3.s:
kiṃ na jānāti loko'yaṃ mayi roṣakaṣāyite ..
śakraṃ prati tribhuvanaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīkamabhūttadā ..51 ..
15.3.d:
किं न जानाति लोकोऽयं मयि रोषकषायिते ..
शक्रं प्रति त्रिभुवनं भ्रष्टश्रीकमभूत्तदा ..51 ..
15.3.m: Does this world not know that when I am red-eyed with wrath, / the three worlds, beginning with Indra, lost their splendor?

15.3.s:
mama śāpamavijñāya nandanapratime vane ..
kathaṃ sā rukmiṇī tatra ramate janasevite .. 52 ..
15.3.d:
मम शापमविज्ञाय नन्दनप्रतिमे वने ..
कथं सा रुक्मिणी तत्र रमते जनसेविते .. 52 ..
15.3.m: Ignoring my curse, how can that Rukmiṇī / delight there in a grove like Nandana, frequented by people?

15.3.s:
tadete taravaḥ sarve saṃtvabhojyaphalā nṛṇām ..
vibhraṣṭasarvasaubhāgyāḥ kusumastabakojjhitāḥ .. 53 ..
15.3.d:
तदेते तरवः सर्वे संत्वभोज्यफला नृणाम् ..
विभ्रष्टसर्वसौभाग्याः कुसुमस्तबकोज्झिताः .. 53 ..
15.3.m: Therefore let all these trees bear fruits inedible to men; / let them be stripped of all beauty and devoid of flower clusters!

15.3.s:
iyaṃ tu śāpanirdagdhā haracūḍāmaṇiḥ sarit ..
vāryasyāḥ syādapeyaṃ tu naiveha sthātumarhati ..54..
15.3.d:
इयं तु शापनिर्दग्धा हरचूडामणिः सरित् ..
वार्यस्याः स्यादपेयं तु नैवेह स्थातुमर्हति ..54..
15.3.m: And this river, the crest-jewel of Hara, consumed by my curse, / its water shall become undrinkable, and it ought not to remain here at all!

15.3.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
tadā sarvamabhūttatra yadyadāha ca vai muniḥ ..
vāci vīryaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ nirmitaṃ viṣṇunā svayam .. 55 ..
15.3.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
तदा सर्वमभूत्तत्र यद्यदाह च वै मुनिः ..
वाचि वीर्यं हि विप्राणां निर्मितं विष्णुना स्वयम् .. 55 ..
15.3.m:
Prahlāda said:
Then everything happened there just as the sage had said; / for the power in the speech of brahmins was fashioned by Viṣṇu himself.

15.3.s:
sā tu devī tathā vṛttamavekṣya bhṛśaduḥkhitā ..
mene duratyayaṃ daivamāpatattatpunaḥpunaḥ .. 56 ..
15.3.d:
सा तु देवी तथा वृत्तमवेक्ष्य भृशदुःखिता ..
मेने दुरत्ययं दैवमापतत्तत्पुनःपुनः .. 56 ..
15.3.m: Seeing what had occurred, the goddess was deeply sorrowful; / she considered fate to be insurmountable as it struck again and again.

15.3.s:
tatastu sā viniścitya maraṇaṃ duḥkhabheṣajam ..
uttarīyāṃbareṇaiva bahiḥ kiñcitprabaddhya tu .. ...57..
15.3.d:
ततस्तु सा विनिश्चित्य मरणं दुःखभेषजम् ..
उत्तरीयांबरेणैव बहिः किञ्चित्प्रबद्ध्य तु .. ...57..
15.3.m: Thereupon, having resolved upon death as the remedy for sorrow, / she tied her upper garment [to a branch] outside,

15.3.s:
athāvabudhya tatsarvaṃ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ ..
tāṃ jñātvā satvaraṃ cā''gātsuparṇena dayānidhiḥ ..58 ..
15.3.d:
अथावबुध्य तत्सर्वं सर्वभूतगुहाशयः ..
तां ज्ञात्वा सत्वरं चा'ऽगात्सुपर्णेन दयानिधिः ..58 ..
15.3.m: Then, realizing all that, the dweller in the secret cave of all beings, / knowing her [intent], came swiftly on Suparṇa, that ocean of compassion.

15.3.s:
dadarśa tādṛśīṃ devīṃ kaṇṭhapāśakarāṃ vibhuḥ ..
adhastāttaruśākhāyāṃ nimīlitavilocanām .. 59 ..
15.3.d:
ददर्श तादृशीं देवीं कण्ठपाशकरां विभुः ..
अधस्तात्तरुशाखायां निमीलितविलोचनाम् .. 59 ..
15.3.m: The Lord beheld the goddess in such a state, making a noose around her neck / beneath the branch of a tree, her eyes closed,

15.3.s:
vibhraṣṭabhūṣaṇagaṇāṃ kṛśadehavallīṃ mlānānanāṃbujarucaṃ maraṇe prasaktām ..
mene sa vigrahavatīṃ karuṇāṃ kṛpālustāṃ saukhyadāṃ guṇavatīṃ praṇatārtihantrīm .. 7.4.3.60 ..
15.3.d:
विभ्रष्टभूषणगणां कृशदेहवल्लीं म्लानाननांबुजरुचं मरणे प्रसक्ताम् ..
मेने स विग्रहवतीं करुणां कृपालुस्तां सौख्यदां गुणवतीं प्रणतार्तिहन्त्रीम् .. 7.4.3.60 ..
15.3.m: her ornaments cast aside, her vine-like body emaciated, the luster of her lotus face faded, intent on death; / the compassionate one regarded that virtuous lady, giver of happiness and destroyer of distress in those bowed to her, as compassion itself incarnate.

15.3.s:
saṃśrutya sā'pi patagādhipate ravaṃ vai pronmīlya netrakamale'tha dadarśa kṛṣṇam ..
sāmanyata trikavivartitalocanābjaṃ prāptaṃ tamiṣṭasuhṛdaṃ nijajīvanātham .. 61 ..
15.3.d:
संश्रुत्य साऽपि पतगाधिपते रवं वै प्रोन्मील्य नेत्रकमलेऽथ ददर्श कृष्णम् ..
सामन्यत त्रिकविवर्तितलोचनाब्जं प्राप्तं तमिष्टसुहृदं निजजीवनाथम् .. 61 ..
15.3.m: Hearing the cry of the lord of birds, she opened her lotus eyes and beheld Kṛṣṇa; / turning her lotus eyes toward him, she recognized that beloved friend and lord of her life who had arrived.

15.3.s:
sā romaharṣavivaśā trapayā parītā kopānurāgakaluṣā kṛtavipralāpā ..
saṃvarddhitadviguṇaśokabharā ca devī nānārasaṃ bata dṛśorviṣayaṃ prapede .. 62 ..
15.3.d:
सा रोमहर्षविवशा त्रपया परीता कोपानुरागकलुषा कृतविप्रलापा ..
संवर्द्धितद्विगुणशोकभरा च देवी नानारसं बत दृशोर्विषयं प्रपेदे .. 62 ..
15.3.m: Helpless with horripilation, overcome with shame, turbid with anger and affection, lamenting aloud, / and with the burden of her grief doubled and redoubled, the goddess became an object of manifold emotions before his eyes.

15.3.s:
tasyāḥ sasādhvasavisargacikīrṣitāyāḥ pāśaṃ vyapohya karacāru saroruheṇa ..
ādāya pāṇimamṛtopamayā ca vācā saṃjīvayannidamudāramudājahāra .. 63 ..
15.3.d:
तस्याः ससाध्वसविसर्गचिकीर्षितायाः पाशं व्यपोह्य करचारु सरोरुहेण ..
आदाय पाणिममृतोपमया च वाचा संजीवयन्निदमुदारमुदाजहार .. 63 ..
15.3.m: As she sought to cast off [her life] in terror, he removed the noose with his lotus-like hand, / and taking her hand, reviving her with words resembling nectar, spoke this noble utterance:

15.3.s:
.. śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca .. ..
kimetatsāhasaṃ bhīru cikīrṣatyavicāritam ..
nanu devi mamācakṣva kiṃ nu te khedakāraṇam .. 64 ..
15.3.d:
.. श्रीकृष्ण उवाच .. ..
किमेतत्साहसं भीरु चिकीर्षत्यविचारितम् ..
ननु देवि ममाचक्ष्व किं नु ते खेदकारणम् .. 64 ..
15.3.m: The venerable Kṛṣṇa said: / 'What is this rash act that you wish to do without reflection, O timid one? / Indeed, tell me, O goddess: what is the cause of your sorrow?

15.3.s:
tvaṃ vidyā'haṃ paro bodhastvaṃ māyā ceśvarastvaham ..
tvaṃ ca buddhirahaṃ jīvo viyogaḥ kathamāvayoḥ .. 65 ..
15.3.d:
त्वं विद्याऽहं परो बोधस्त्वं माया चेश्वरस्त्वहम् ..
त्वं च बुद्धिरहं जीवो वियोगः कथमावयोः .. 65 ..
15.3.m: You are knowledge, I am supreme consciousness; you are Māyā and I am Īśvara; / you are the intellect, and I am the individual soul: how could there be separation between us two?

15.3.s:
tvayā vimohitātmāno bhrāmyantyajabhavādayaḥ ..
sā kathaṃ kṣubhyasi tvaṃ tu kiṃ svadhāma na budhyase .. 66 ..
15.3.d:
त्वया विमोहितात्मानो भ्राम्यन्त्यजभवादयः ..
सा कथं क्षुभ्यसि त्वं तु किं स्वधाम न बुध्यसे .. 66 ..
15.3.m: Deluded in soul by you, Brahmā, Śiva, and the others wander about. / As such, why do you become agitated? Do you not recognize your own nature?

15.3.s:
tvayā hi baddhā ṛṣayaste carantīha karmabhiḥ ..
tāṃ tvāṃ kathamṛṣiḥ śaptuṃ śaknuyādvaravarṇini .. 67 ..
15.3.d:
त्वया हि बद्धा ऋषयस्ते चरन्तीह कर्मभिः ..
तां त्वां कथमृषिः शप्तुं शक्नुयाद्वरवर्णिनि .. 67 ..
15.3.m: Bound by you, indeed, those seers wander here through their actions. / How could a seer be able to curse you, O fair-complexioned one?

15.3.s:
śikṣārthaṃ tviha lokānāmevaṃ me devi ceṣṭitam ..
manmāyayā samāviṣṭaḥ kurute vivaśaḥ pumān ..
paśya kopaparītātmā yaḥ sa śānto munīśvaraḥ .. 68 ..
15.3.d:
शिक्षार्थं त्विह लोकानामेवं मे देवि चेष्टितम् ..
मन्मायया समाविष्टः कुरुते विवशः पुमान् ..
पश्य कोपपरीतात्मा यः स शान्तो मुनीश्वरः .. 68 ..
15.3.m: Yet this conduct of mine here is for instructing the worlds, O goddess: / possessed by my Māyā, a person acts helplessly. / Behold that lord of sages, who was tranquil, [now] filled with anger!'

15.3.s:
.. prahlāda uvāca .. ..
so'bhyetya bhaktinamro'tha durvāsā munisattamaḥ ..
vicārya manasā sarvaṃ paścāttāpānupāśrayat .. 69 ..
15.3.d:
.. प्रह्लाद उवाच .. ..
सोऽभ्येत्य भक्तिनम्रोऽथ दुर्वासा मुनिसत्तमः ..
विचार्य मनसा सर्वं पश्चात्तापानुपाश्रयत् .. 69 ..
15.3.m: Prahlāda said: / Then Durvāsas, the best of sages, approached, bowed in devotion; / reflecting upon everything in his mind, he resorted to repentance.

15.3.s:
kiṃ mayā kṛtamityuktvā tatsamīpamupāgamat ..
apatadviluṭhanbhūmau daṇḍavaccāśrusaṃplutaḥ .. 7.4.3.70 ..
15.3.d:
किं मया कृतमित्युक्त्वा तत्समीपमुपागमत् ..
अपतद्विलुठन्भूमौ दण्डवच्चाश्रुसंप्लुतः .. 7.4.3.70 ..
15.3.m: Saying, 'What have I done?', he came near him. / Falling and rolling on the ground like a stick, he was bathed in tears.

15.3.s:
pitarau jagato devau kṣāmayāmāsa dīnavat ..
tuṣṭāva sūktavākyaistu rahasyairbhaktisaṃyutaḥ .. 71 ..
15.3.d:
पितरौ जगतो देवौ क्षामयामास दीनवत् ..
तुष्टाव सूक्तवाक्यैस्तु रहस्यैर्भक्तिसंयुतः .. 71 ..
15.3.m: Like a wretched man, he begged forgiveness from the two deities, the parents of the universe; / filled with devotion, he praised them with secret hymnic words.

15.3.s:
āha cedaṃ jagannāthaṃ yadi mayyastyanugrahaḥ ..
tadā pureva saṃyogo deva devyā vidhīyatām .. 72 ..
15.3.d:
आह चेदं जगन्नाथं यदि मय्यस्त्यनुग्रहः ..
तदा पुरेव संयोगो देव देव्या विधीयताम् .. 72 ..
15.3.m: And he said this to the lord of the universe: 'If you have grace toward me, / then, O god, let union with the goddess be ordained just as before.'

15.3.s:
atha prahasya govindastamāha munisattamam..
na hi te vacanaṃ jātu mṛṣā bhavitumarhati .. 73 ..
15.3.d:
अथ प्रहस्य गोविन्दस्तमाह मुनिसत्तमम्..
न हि ते वचनं जातु मृषा भवितुमर्हति .. 73 ..
15.3.m: Then Govinda, smiling, said to that best of sages: / 'Indeed, your word must never become false.

15.3.s:
mayaivaṃ vihitaḥ setuḥ kathamucchedyatāṃ dvija ..
sadbhirācaritaḥ setuḥ siddho lokasya pālakaḥ .. 74 ..
15.3.d:
मयैवं विहितः सेतुः कथमुच्छेद्यतां द्विज ..
सद्भिराचरितः सेतुः सिद्धो लोकस्य पालकः .. 74 ..
15.3.m: How can the boundary ordained by me be broken, O twice-born one? / A boundary maintained by the virtuous is established as the protector of the world.

15.3.s:
dinedine dvikālaṃ ca āyāsye munisattama ..
vinodayiṣye tāṃ tāṃ tu munikanyāṃ ca kāmyayā .. 75 ..
15.3.d:
दिनेदिने द्विकालं च आयास्ये मुनिसत्तम ..
विनोदयिष्ये तां तां तु मुनिकन्यां च काम्यया .. 75 ..
15.3.m: Day after day, twice a day, I will come, O best of sages; / and with affection I will delight her, that daughter of a sage.

15.3.s:
tuṣyāmi sādhanairnānyairmatkathākathanairapi ..
yathā saṃpūjya māmatra mama prītirbhaviṣyati .. 76 ..
15.3.d:
तुष्यामि साधनैर्नान्यैर्मत्कथाकथनैरपि ..
यथा संपूज्य मामत्र मम प्रीतिर्भविष्यति .. 76 ..
15.3.m: I am not so pleased by other spiritual practices or by narrating stories of me, / as my pleasure shall be when I am worshipped here.

15.3.s:
yadā ca mayi vai(?)kuṇṭhamadhirūḍhe mahāmune ..
pravekṣyati tadā tejo mama sarvaṃ trivikrame .. 77 ..
15.3.d:
यदा च मयि वै(?)कुण्ठमधिरूढे महामुने ..
प्रवेक्ष्यति तदा तेजो मम सर्वं त्रिविक्रमे .. 77 ..
15.3.m: And when I ascend to Vaikuṇṭha, O great sage, / then all my splendor will enter into Trivikrama.

15.3.s:
rukmiṇīyaṃ ca manmūrteḥ saṃyogaṃ punareṣyati ..
iyaṃ bhāgīrathī cāpi sāgareṇa samā guṇaiḥ ..
tyaktvā hyaśeṣaduḥkhāni sukhaṃ caiva gamiṣyati .. 78 ..
15.3.d:
रुक्मिणीयं च मन्मूर्तेः संयोगं पुनरेष्यति ..
इयं भागीरथी चापि सागरेण समा गुणैः ..
त्यक्त्वा ह्यशेषदुःखानि सुखं चैव गमिष्यति .. 78 ..
15.3.m: And this Rukmiṇī will once again attain union with my form. / And this Bhāgīrathī too, equal to the ocean in virtues, / abandoning all sorrows, will go to happiness.'

15.3.s:
anugrahaṃ vidhāyaivamṛṣiṇā saha keśavaḥ ..
viveśa svapurīṃ tatra vidhāyopāṃtikaṃ munim .. 79 ..
15.3.d:
अनुग्रहं विधायैवमृषिणा सह केशवः ..
विवेश स्वपुरीं तत्र विधायोपांतिकं मुनिम् .. 79 ..
15.3.m: Having thus bestowed grace, Keśava, accompanied by the seer, / entered his own city, having established the sage nearby.

15.3.s:
sāpi devī ca saṃbudhya tadā tasya viceṣṭitam..
anugrahādbhagavato babhūva vigata jvarā .. 7.4.3.80 ..
15.3.d:
सापि देवी च संबुध्य तदा तस्य विचेष्टितम्..
अनुग्रहाद्भगवतो बभूव विगत ज्वरा .. 7.4.3.80 ..
15.3.m: The goddess too, having then understood his deed, / became free of distress through the grace of the Lord.

15.3.s:
yataśca muktā duḥkhena tatra devī haripriyā..
tato bhāgīrathī sā tu gaditā duḥkhamocinī .. 81 ..
15.3.d:
यतश्च मुक्ता दुःखेन तत्र देवी हरिप्रिया..
ततो भागीरथी सा तु गदिता दुःखमोचिनी .. 81 ..
15.3.m: And because the goddess, beloved of Hari, was liberated from sorrow there, / therefore that Bhāgīrathī is called the releaser of sorrow.

15.3.s:
amāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yastasyāḥ saṃgame śubhe ..
snāyādaśeṣaduḥkhāttu sa naraḥ parimucyate .. 82 ..
15.3.d:
अमावास्यां पौर्णमास्यां यस्तस्याः संगमे शुभे ..
स्नायादशेषदुःखात्तु स नरः परिमुच्यते .. 82 ..
15.3.m: He who bathes at its auspicious confluence on the new moon or on the full moon day / is freed from all sorrow.

15.3.s:
aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ cāvalokitā ..
narāṇāṃ rukmiṇī devī sarvānkāmā nprayacchati .. 83 ..
15.3.d:
अष्टम्यां च चतुर्दश्यां नवम्यां चावलोकिता ..
नराणां रुक्मिणी देवी सर्वान्कामा न्प्रयच्छति .. 83 ..
15.3.m: Beheld on the eighth, the fourteenth, and the ninth [tithis], / goddess Rukmiṇī grants all desires to mortals.

15.3.s:
ityetatkathitaṃ devyā ṛṣayo duḥkhamocanam ..
anugrahaśca devasya kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha .. 84 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye rukmiṇīduḥkhamocanavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ..3.. ..7...
15.3.d:
इत्येतत्कथितं देव्या ऋषयो दुःखमोचनम् ..
अनुग्रहश्च देवस्य किं भूयः श्रोतुमिच्छथ .. 84 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे चतुर्थे द्वारकामाहात्म्ये रुक्मिणीदुःखमोचनवर्णनंनाम तृतीयोऽध्यायः ..3.. ..7...
15.3.m:
Thus has the release of the goddess from sorrow been told to you, O seers, / as well as the grace of the god. What more do you wish to hear?
Thus ends the third chapter, named 'The Description of the Release of Rukmiṇī from Sorrow,' in the Dvārakāmāhātmya, in the fourth [part of] the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.
